```python
import sqlite3
c = sqlite3.connect("subtitler.db")
print("integrity:", c.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0])
print("journal_mode:", c.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode").fetchone()[0])
for (name,) in c.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'").fetchall():
    try:
        cnt = c.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [{name}]").fetchone()[0]
        print(f"table {name}: {cnt} rows")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"table {name}: ERROR {e}")
c.close()
try:
    c2 = sqlite3.connect("subtitler.db.corrupt.20261110_072451.bak")
    print("bak integrity:", c2.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0])
except Exception as e:
    print("bak unreadable:", e)
```

```python
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Tuple, Dict, Any, Optional

class MediaIdentifier:
    """Identifies media title, episode, season, year, and type from file paths."""
    
    def identify_media_info(self, file_path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Extract detailed media info from filename."""
        raw_name = Path(file_path).stem
        
        # 1. Strip ReleaseGroup [XXX] at start
        cleaned = re.sub(r'^\[.*?\]\s*', '', raw_name)
        
        # 2. TV Series: S01E05 or S1E5
        s_e_match = re.search(r'(?i)\b[sS](\d+)[eE](\d+)\b', cleaned)
        if s_e_match:
            title = cleaned[:s_e_match.start()]
            return {
                "title": self.clean_title(title),
                "episode": s_e_match.group(2),
                "season": s_e_match.group(1),
                "media_type": "tv",
                "year": None
            }
            
        # 3. TV Series: 1x05 or 01x05
        x_match = re.search(r'(?i)\b(\d{1,2})x(\d{1,2})\b', cleaned)
        if x_match:
            title = cleaned[:x_match.start()]
            return {
                "title": self.clean_title(title),
                "episode": x_match.group(2),
                "season": x_match.group(1),
                "media_type": "tv",
                "year": None
            }
            
        # 4. Anime style _E05 or - E05
        e_match = re.search(r'(?i)[_ -]E(\d+)\b', cleaned)
        if e_match:
            title = cleaned[:e_match.start()]
            return {
                "title": self.clean_title(title),
                "episode": e_match.group(1),
                "season": None,
                "media_type": "anime",
                "year": None
            }
            
        # 5. Anime dash style: ' - 05'
        dash_match = re.search(r'\s+-\s+(\d+)\b', cleaned)
        if dash_match:
            title = cleaned[:dash_match.start()]
            return {
                "title": self.clean_title(title),
                "episode": dash_match.group(1),
                "season": None,
                "media_type": "anime",
                "year": None
            }

        # 6. Movie: Year in title (1920-2099)
        year_match = re.search(r'[\s\.\(\[\-_](19\d\d|20\d\d)[\s\.\)\]\-_]', cleaned)
        if year_match:
            title = cleaned[:year_match.start()]
            return {
                "title": self.clean_title(title),
                "episode": "",
                "season": None,
                "media_type": "movie",
                "year": year_match.group(1)
            }
            
        # 7. Fallback
        return {
            "title": self.clean_title(cleaned),
            "episode": "",
            "season": None,
            "media_type": "unknown",
            "year": None
        }

    def identify_from_path(self, file_path: str) -> Tuple[str, str]:
        """Extract clean title and episode string from filename (backwards compatibility)."""
        info = self.identify_media_info(file_path)
        return info["title"], info["episode"]

    def clean_title(self, title: str) -> str:
        """Removes brackets, resolution tags, codecs, scene tags, clean delimiters."""
        # Replace dots and underscores with spaces if it looks like a scene release
        if "." in title and " " not in title:
            title = title.replace(".", " ")
        title = title.replace("_", " ")

        # Remove trailing resolution tags like (1080p), [720p], 2160p, 4k
        title = re.sub(r'(?i)[\[\(]?\b(2160p|1080p|720p|480p|4k|uhd)\b[\]\)]?', '', title)
        
        # Remove audio and video format tags
        title = re.sub(r'(?i)\b(bluray|bdrip|brrip|web-?dl|webrip|hdtv|dvdrip|x264|x265|hevc|h\.?264|h\.?265|10bit|aac|ddp5\.1|ac3|dts)\b.*', '', title)
        
        # Remove any remaining brackets and parentheses
        title = re.sub(r'[\[\(].*?[\]\)]', '', title)
        
        # Remove trailing scene release group tags e.g. -YTS, -PSA, -EVO
        title = re.sub(r'-[a-zA-Z0-9]+$', '', title)
        
        # Collapse multiple spaces and strip trailing hyphens
        title = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', title)
        title = re.sub(r'[-\s]+$', '', title).strip()
        return title

AnimeIdentifier = MediaIdentifier
```

```python
import logging
import asyncio
from typing import Tuple, List, Optional
import httpx
from app.anime.identifier import MediaIdentifier, AnimeIdentifier
from app.anime.sources.base import create_shared_http_client
from app.anime.sources.anilist import AniListSource
from app.anime.sources.jikan import JikanSource
from app.anime.sources.kitsu import KitsuSource
from app.anime.sources.tvmaze import TVMazeSource
from app.anime.sources.cinemeta import CinemetaSource
from app.anime.sources.tmdb import TMDBSource
from app.character.database import CharacterRepository
from app.models.anime import MediaInfo, AnimeInfo, CharacterProfile
from app.core.database import DatabaseManager
from app.core.config import get_settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class MediaMetadataService:
    """Service orchestrating anime, movie, and TV show metadata retrieval across all sources."""

    def __init__(self, db: DatabaseManager):
        self.db = db
        self.identifier = MediaIdentifier()
        self._shared_client: Optional[httpx.AsyncClient] = None
        self._client_loop_id: Optional[int] = None
        self.char_repo = CharacterRepository(db)

        self.anilist = AniListSource()
        self.jikan = JikanSource()
        self.kitsu = KitsuSource()
        self.tvmaze = TVMazeSource()
        self.cinemeta = CinemetaSource()

        settings = get_settings()
        tmdb_key = getattr(settings, "tmdb_api_key", "")
        self.tmdb = TMDBSource(api_key=tmdb_key)

    def _sources(self):
        return (self.anilist, self.jikan, self.kitsu, self.tvmaze, self.cinemeta, self.tmdb)

    def _ensure_shared_client(self) -> httpx.AsyncClient:
        """Creates or reuses a single persistent HTTP/2-capable client across all metadata sources."""
        try:
            cur_loop_id = id(asyncio.get_running_loop())
        except RuntimeError:
            cur_loop_id = None

        if (
            self._shared_client is None
            or getattr(self._shared_client, "is_closed", False)
            or self._client_loop_id != cur_loop_id
        ):
            self._shared_client = create_shared_http_client()
            self._client_loop_id = cur_loop_id
            for src in self._sources():
                src.set_shared_client(self._shared_client)
        return self._shared_client

    async def aclose(self) -> None:
        """Closes the shared HTTP connection pool cleanly."""
        if self._shared_client is not None:
            try:
                if not getattr(self._shared_client, "is_closed", False):
                    await self._shared_client.aclose()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._shared_client = None
            self._client_loop_id = None
            for src in self._sources():
                src.set_shared_client(None)

    def persist_media_and_characters(
        self,
        media: Optional[MediaInfo],
        characters: List[CharacterProfile],
    ) -> Tuple[Optional[MediaInfo], List[CharacterProfile]]:
        """Persists resolved media & characters into relational SQLite tables (anime, anime_sources, characters, character_aliases)."""
        if not media or not self.db:
            return media, characters
        try:
            anime_id = self.char_repo.save_anime(media)
            if anime_id and anime_id > 0 and characters:
                self.char_repo.save_characters_for_anime(anime_id, characters)
        except Exception as ex:
            logger.debug(f"Could not persist media/characters to DB tables: {ex}")
        return media, characters

    async def resolve_media_and_characters(
        self, file_path: str, user_title: Optional[str] = None
    ) -> Tuple[Optional[MediaInfo], List[CharacterProfile]]:
        """Identify media title and type from filename and resolve characters."""
        self._ensure_shared_client()

        info = self.identifier.identify_media_info(file_path)
        search_title = user_title.strip() if user_title else info["title"]
        media_type = info["media_type"]

        if not search_title:
            return None, []

        # Check database cache first
        cache_key = f"media_meta_{search_title.lower().strip()}"
        try:
            cached = self.db.get_cache(cache_key)
            if cached and isinstance(cached, dict):
                media_data = cached.get("anime") or cached.get("media")
                chars_data = cached.get("characters", [])
                cached_media = MediaInfo(**media_data) if media_data else None
                cached_chars = [CharacterProfile(**c) for c in chars_data]
                if cached_media and cached_chars:
                    if cached_media.id is None:
                        self.persist_media_and_characters(cached_media, cached_chars)
                    else:
                        try:
                            db_chars = self.char_repo.get_characters_for_anime(cached_media.id)
                            if db_chars:
                                cached_chars = db_chars
                        except Exception:
                            pass
                    logger.info(f"Loaded media metadata from local DB cache for: {search_title}")
                    return cached_media, cached_chars
        except Exception as ex:
            logger.debug(f"Cache lookup failed: {ex}")

        # Determine source priority based on media type
        sources_to_try = []
        if media_type == "tv":
            sources_to_try = [self.tvmaze]
            if self.tmdb.api_key:
                sources_to_try.append(self.tmdb)
            sources_to_try.extend([self.cinemeta, self.anilist, self.jikan])
        elif media_type == "movie":
            if self.tmdb.api_key:
                sources_to_try.append(self.tmdb)
            sources_to_try.extend([self.cinemeta, self.tvmaze, self.anilist])
        elif media_type == "anime":
            sources_to_try = [self.anilist, self.jikan, self.kitsu, self.tvmaze, self.cinemeta]
        else:  # unknown
            sources_to_try = [self.anilist, self.tvmaze, self.cinemeta]
            if self.tmdb.api_key:
                sources_to_try.append(self.tmdb)
            sources_to_try.extend([self.jikan, self.kitsu])

        media: Optional[MediaInfo] = None
        characters: List[CharacterProfile] = []

        for source in sources_to_try:
            try:
                results = await source.search_anime(search_title)
                if results:
                    candidate = results[0]
                    chars = await source.get_characters(candidate.source_id)
                    if chars:
                        media = candidate
                        characters = chars
                        break
                    elif not media:
                        media = candidate
            except Exception as e:
                logger.debug(f"Source {source.__class__.__name__} failed for {search_title}: {e}")

        # Persist to relational DB tables & api_cache on success
        if media:
            self.persist_media_and_characters(media, characters)

        if media and characters:
            try:
                self.db.set_cache(
                    cache_key,
                    {
                        "media": media.model_dump(),
                        "anime": media.model_dump(),
                        "characters": [c.model_dump() for c in characters]
                    },
                    source="MediaMetadataService",
                    ttl_seconds=86400 * 14
                )
            except Exception as ex:
                logger.debug(f"Failed to cache media metadata: {ex}")

        return media, characters

    # Backward compatibility
    resolve_anime_and_characters = resolve_media_and_characters

    async def search_multiple_media(
        self, search_title: str, filter_type: str = "all"
    ) -> List[MediaInfo]:
        """Search across providers for movies, TV series, and anime."""
        self._ensure_shared_client()
        if not search_title or not search_title.strip():
            return []

        results: List[MediaInfo] = []
        clean_title = search_title.strip()
        tasks = []

        # Update TMDB api key dynamically from settings
        settings = get_settings()
        self.tmdb.api_key = getattr(settings, "tmdb_api_key", "")

        if filter_type in ("all", "tv"):
            tasks.append(self.tvmaze.search_shows(clean_title))
        if filter_type in ("all", "movie", "tv"):
            tasks.append(self.cinemeta.search_media(clean_title, media_type="all" if filter_type == "all" else filter_type))
            if self.tmdb.api_key:
                tasks.append(self.tmdb.search_media(clean_title, media_type="all" if filter_type == "all" else filter_type))
        if filter_type in ("all", "anime"):
            tasks.append(self.anilist.search_anime(clean_title))

        gathered = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        seen_keys = set()

        for res in gathered:
            if isinstance(res, list):
                for item in res:
                    key = (item.title.lower().strip(), item.year, item.format.lower())
                    if key not in seen_keys:
                        seen_keys.add(key)
                        results.append(item)

        return results

    # Backward compatibility
    search_multiple_anime = search_multiple_media

    async def get_characters_for_media(self, media: MediaInfo) -> List[CharacterProfile]:
        """Get characters for a specific media based on its source."""
        self._ensure_shared_client()
        try:
            chars: List[CharacterProfile] = []
            if media.source_name == "TVMaze":
                chars = await self.tvmaze.get_characters(media.source_id)
            elif media.source_name == "Cinemeta":
                chars = await self.cinemeta.get_characters(media.source_id)
            elif media.source_name == "TMDB":
                chars = await self.tmdb.get_characters(media.source_id)
            elif media.source_name == "AniList":
                chars = await self.anilist.get_characters(media.source_id)
            elif media.source_name == "Jikan":
                chars = await self.jikan.get_characters(media.source_id)
            elif media.source_name == "Kitsu":
                chars = await self.kitsu.get_characters(media.source_id)

            if chars:
                self.persist_media_and_characters(media, chars)
            return chars
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to fetch characters from {media.source_name}: {e}")
        return []

    # Backward compatibility
    get_characters_for_anime = get_characters_for_media


# Backward compatibility alias
AnimeMetadataService = MediaMetadataService
```

```python
import httpx
from typing import List
from app.models.anime import AnimeInfo, CharacterProfile, GenderEnum
from app.anime.sources.base import BaseAnimeSource
from app.core.exceptions import ProviderError

class AniListSource(BaseAnimeSource):
    """AniList GraphQL API source for anime metadata."""
    
    URL = "https://graphql.anilist.co"
    
    async def search_anime(self, query: str) -> List[AnimeInfo]:
        graphql_query = """
        query ($search: String) {
          Page(page: 1, perPage: 10) {
            media(search: $search, type: ANIME) {
              id
              title {
                romaji
                english
                native
              }
              episodes
              format
              status
              coverImage {
                large
              }
            }
          }
        }
        """
        headers = {
            'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:123.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/123.0',
            'Accept': 'application/json',
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Origin': 'https://anilist.co',
            'Referer': 'https://anilist.co/'
        }
        try:
            client = await self.get_http_client()
            response = await client.post(
                self.URL,
                json={"query": graphql_query, "variables": {"search": query}},
                headers=headers,
            )
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()

            results = []
            for item in data.get("data", {}).get("Page", {}).get("media", []):
                title = item.get("title", {})
                results.append(AnimeInfo(
                    title_romaji=title.get("romaji", "") or "",
                    title_english=title.get("english", "") or "",
                    title_native=title.get("native", "") or "",
                    episodes=item.get("episodes"),
                    format=item.get("format", "") or "",
                    status=item.get("status", "") or "",
                    cover_image_url=item.get("coverImage", {}).get("large", ""),
                    source_name="AniList",
                    source_id=str(item.get("id"))
                ))
            return results
        except Exception as e:
            raise ProviderError(f"AniList search failed: {e}")

    async def get_characters(self, anime_id: str) -> List[CharacterProfile]:
        graphql_query = """
        query ($id: Int) {
          Media(id: $id) {
            characters {
              edges {
                role
                node {
                  id
                  name {
                    full
                    native
                    alternative
                  }
                  gender
                  age
                  description
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
        """
        headers = {
            'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:123.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/123.0',
            'Accept': 'application/json',
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Origin': 'https://anilist.co',
            'Referer': 'https://anilist.co/'
        }
        try:
            client = await self.get_http_client()
            response = await client.post(
                self.URL,
                json={"query": graphql_query, "variables": {"id": int(anime_id)}},
                headers=headers,
            )
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()

            results = []
            edges = data.get("data", {}).get("Media", {}).get("characters", {}).get("edges", [])
            for edge in edges:
                node = edge.get("node", {})
                name_obj = node.get("name", {})
                gender_str = node.get("gender", "")

                gender = GenderEnum.UNKNOWN
                if gender_str == "Male":
                    gender = GenderEnum.MALE
                elif gender_str == "Female":
                    gender = GenderEnum.FEMALE
                elif gender_str == "Non-binary":
                    gender = GenderEnum.NON_BINARY

                results.append(CharacterProfile(
                    canonical_name=name_obj.get("full", "") or "",
                    native_name=name_obj.get("native", "") or "",
                    aliases=name_obj.get("alternative", []) or [],
                    gender=gender,
                    gender_source="AniList",
                    gender_confidence=0.95 if gender != GenderEnum.UNKNOWN else 0.0,
                    role=edge.get("role", "") or "",
                    age=node.get("age", "") or "",
                    description=node.get("description", "") or ""
                ))
            return results
        except Exception as e:
            raise ProviderError(f"AniList character fetch failed: {e}")
```

```python
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
import asyncio
from typing import List, Optional
import httpx
from app.models.anime import AnimeInfo, CharacterProfile

try:
    import h2  # noqa: F401
    _HTTP2_AVAILABLE = True
except ImportError:
    _HTTP2_AVAILABLE = False


def create_shared_http_client() -> httpx.AsyncClient:
    """Creates a pooled httpx AsyncClient with automatic HTTP/2 support when `h2` is available."""
    return httpx.AsyncClient(
        timeout=10.0,
        http2=_HTTP2_AVAILABLE,
        limits=httpx.Limits(max_connections=20, max_keepalive_connections=10),
    )


class BaseAnimeSource(ABC):
    """Abstract base class for anime/media metadata sources with shared connection pooling."""

    def __init__(self, shared_client: Optional[httpx.AsyncClient] = None):
        self._shared_client: Optional[httpx.AsyncClient] = shared_client
        self._owns_client: bool = False
        self._client_loop_id: Optional[int] = None

    def set_shared_client(self, client: Optional[httpx.AsyncClient]) -> None:
        self._shared_client = client
        self._owns_client = False
        try:
            self._client_loop_id = id(asyncio.get_running_loop())
        except RuntimeError:
            self._client_loop_id = None

    async def get_http_client(self) -> httpx.AsyncClient:
        """Returns an active shared httpx.AsyncClient bound safely to the current event loop."""
        try:
            cur_loop_id = id(asyncio.get_running_loop())
        except RuntimeError:
            cur_loop_id = None

        if (
            self._shared_client is not None
            and not getattr(self._shared_client, "is_closed", False)
            and (not self._owns_client or self._client_loop_id == cur_loop_id)
        ):
            return self._shared_client

        # Close stale loop-bound owned client if loop changed
        if self._shared_client is not None and self._owns_client:
            try:
                await self._shared_client.aclose()
            except Exception:
                pass

        self._shared_client = create_shared_http_client()
        self._owns_client = True
        self._client_loop_id = cur_loop_id
        return self._shared_client

    async def aclose(self) -> None:
        """Closes owned shared HTTP client resources cleanly."""
        if self._shared_client is not None and self._owns_client:
            try:
                if not getattr(self._shared_client, "is_closed", False):
                    await self._shared_client.aclose()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._shared_client = None
            self._owns_client = False
            self._client_loop_id = None

    @abstractmethod
    async def search_anime(self, query: str) -> List[AnimeInfo]:
        """Search for anime by title query."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_characters(self, anime_id: str) -> List[CharacterProfile]:
        """Get characters for a specific anime ID."""
        pass
```

```python
import logging
from typing import List, Optional
from urllib.parse import quote_plus
import httpx
from app.anime.sources.base import BaseAnimeSource
from app.models.anime import MediaInfo, CharacterProfile, GenderEnum

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Common first names gender hint heuristic for actors when detailed bio isn't returned
COMMON_FEMALE_FIRSTNAMES = {
    "emily", "emma", "sarah", "jennifer", "scarlett", "natalie", "anne", "kate", "jessica",
    "margot", "florence", "zendaya", "anya", "ana", "gal", "elizabeth", "mary", "rachel",
    "sandra", "charlize", "zoe", "amy", "reese", "millie", "olivia", "halle", "cate", "meryl"
}
COMMON_MALE_FIRSTNAMES = {
    "cillian", "matt", "robert", "leonardo", "brad", "tom", "john", "michael", "david",
    "chris", "christian", "ryan", "george", "keanu", "samuel", "morgan", "harrison",
    "will", "denzel", "joaquin", "ben", "mark", "jake", "paul", "daniel", "hugh", "bruce"
}

class CinemetaSource(BaseAnimeSource):
    """Cinemeta metadata source for movies and series (Free, public Stremio API)."""
    BASE_URL = "https://v3-cinemeta.strem.io"

    async def search_anime(self, query: str) -> List[MediaInfo]:
        """Search movies and series via Cinemeta."""
        return await self.search_media(query)

    async def search_media(self, query: str, media_type: str = "movie") -> List[MediaInfo]:
        """Search movies or series using Cinemeta catalog."""
        if not query or not query.strip():
            return []
            
        clean_q = quote_plus(query.strip())
        results = []
        
        types_to_search = ["movie", "series"] if media_type == "all" else [media_type if media_type in ("movie", "series") else "movie"]
        
        client = await self.get_http_client()
        for m_type in types_to_search:
            url = f"{self.BASE_URL}/catalog/{m_type}/top/search={clean_q}.json"
            try:
                resp = await client.get(url)
                if resp.status_code != 200:
                    continue
                metas = resp.json().get("metas", [])
                for item in metas[:15]:
                    year_val = item.get("releaseInfo") or item.get("year")
                    year = int(str(year_val)[:4]) if year_val and str(year_val)[:4].isdigit() else None
                    
                    media = MediaInfo(
                        media_type="movie" if m_type == "movie" else "tv",
                        title=item.get("name") or "",
                        title_english=item.get("name") or "",
                        title_romaji=item.get("name") or "",
                        year=year,
                        format="Movie" if m_type == "movie" else "Series",
                        status="Released",
                        cover_image_url=item.get("poster") or "",
                        source_name="Cinemeta",
                        source_id=f"{m_type}:{item.get('id')}",
                        overview=item.get("description") or "",
                        genres=item.get("genres") or []
                    )
                    results.append(media)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"Cinemeta search failed for {m_type}: {e}")
                    
        return results

    async def get_characters(self, source_id: str) -> List[CharacterProfile]:
        """Get cast list for movie or series from Cinemeta."""
        m_type = "movie"
        imdb_id = source_id
        if ":" in source_id:
            m_type, imdb_id = source_id.split(":", 1)
            
        url = f"{self.BASE_URL}/meta/{m_type}/{imdb_id}.json"
        try:
            client = await self.get_http_client()
            resp = await client.get(url)
            if resp.status_code != 200:
                return []
            meta = resp.json().get("meta", {})
            cast = meta.get("cast", []) or []
            
            characters = []
            for actor in cast:
                if not actor or not isinstance(actor, str):
                    continue
                actor_clean = actor.strip()
                first_name = actor_clean.split(" ")[0].lower() if " " in actor_clean else actor_clean.lower()
                
                gender = GenderEnum.UNKNOWN
                confidence = 0.0
                if first_name in COMMON_FEMALE_FIRSTNAMES:
                    gender = GenderEnum.FEMALE
                    confidence = 0.85
                elif first_name in COMMON_MALE_FIRSTNAMES:
                    gender = GenderEnum.MALE
                    confidence = 0.85
                    
                profile = CharacterProfile(
                    canonical_name=actor_clean,
                    first_name=actor_clean.split(" ")[0] if " " in actor_clean else actor_clean,
                    last_name=actor_clean.split(" ")[-1] if " " in actor_clean else "",
                    gender=gender,
                    gender_source="Cinemeta (Cast)",
                    gender_confidence=confidence,
                    role="MAIN",
                    voice_actor=actor_clean,
                    description=f"Cast member in {meta.get('name', 'Media')}"
                )
                characters.append(profile)
            return characters
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Cinemeta get_characters failed: {e}")
            return []
```

```python
import re
import asyncio
from typing import List, Tuple
from app.models.anime import AnimeInfo, CharacterProfile, GenderEnum
from app.anime.sources.base import BaseAnimeSource
from app.core.exceptions import ProviderError


class JikanSource(BaseAnimeSource):
    """Jikan REST API source for anime metadata."""

    BASE_URL = "https://api.jikan.moe/v4"
    MAX_CHARACTER_DETAIL_FETCHES = 15

    async def _rate_limit_delay(self):
        # Delay 0.35s to respect 3 req/sec limit
        await asyncio.sleep(0.35)

    @staticmethod
    def parse_gender_from_about(about: str) -> Tuple[GenderEnum, float]:
        """Extracts character gender and confidence from Jikan character biography text."""
        if not about:
            return GenderEnum.UNKNOWN, 0.0

        about_lower = about.lower()

        # Explicit structured field (common in MAL character bios: "Gender: Female")
        m_explicit = re.search(r'\b(?:gender|sex)\s*:\s*(female|male)\b', about_lower)
        if m_explicit:
            return (
                GenderEnum.FEMALE if m_explicit.group(1) == "female" else GenderEnum.MALE,
                0.95,
            )

        female_subject = len(re.findall(r'\bshe\b', about_lower))
        male_subject = len(re.findall(r'\bhe\b', about_lower))
        female_other = len(re.findall(
            r'\b(her|hers|herself|woman|girl|female|daughter|sister|princess|queen|wife|mother|goddess|lady|maiden|heroine|empress|witch|priestess|nun|aunt|grandmother|niece)\b',
            about_lower,
        ))
        male_other = len(re.findall(
            r'\b(him|his|himself|man|boy|male|son|brother|prince|king|husband|father|god|hero|emperor|wizard|priest|monk|uncle|grandfather|nephew|knight|lord)\b',
            about_lower,
        ))

        female_matches = (female_subject * 2) + female_other
        male_matches = (male_subject * 2) + male_other

        if female_matches > male_matches:
            return GenderEnum.FEMALE, min(0.95, 0.60 + (female_matches - male_matches) * 0.05)
        if male_matches > female_matches:
            return GenderEnum.MALE, min(0.95, 0.60 + (male_matches - female_matches) * 0.05)
        return GenderEnum.UNKNOWN, 0.0

    async def search_anime(self, query: str) -> List[AnimeInfo]:
        url = f"{self.BASE_URL}/anime"
        headers = {
            'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) GPTSubtitler/2.0',
            'Accept': 'application/json',
            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        }

        last_error = None
        for attempt in range(3):
            await self._rate_limit_delay()
            try:
                client = await self.get_http_client()
                response = await client.get(url, params={"q": query, "limit": 10}, headers=headers)
                response.raise_for_status()
                data = response.json()

                results = []
                for item in data.get("data", []):
                    results.append(AnimeInfo(
                        title_romaji=item.get("title", "") or "",
                        title_english=item.get("title_english", "") or "",
                        title_native=item.get("title_japanese", "") or "",
                        episodes=item.get("episodes"),
                        format=item.get("type", "") or "",
                        status=item.get("status", "") or "",
                        cover_image_url=item.get("images", {}).get("jpg", {}).get("large_image_url", ""),
                        source_name="Jikan",
                        source_id=str(item.get("mal_id"))
                    ))
                return results
            except Exception as e:
                last_error = e
                await asyncio.sleep(1)

        raise ProviderError(f"Jikan search failed after 3 attempts: {last_error}")

    async def get_characters(self, anime_id: str) -> List[CharacterProfile]:
        url = f"{self.BASE_URL}/anime/{anime_id}/characters"
        headers = {
            'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) GPTSubtitler/2.0',
            'Accept': 'application/json',
            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        }

        last_error = None
        for attempt in range(3):
            await self._rate_limit_delay()
            try:
                client = await self.get_http_client()
                response = await client.get(url, headers=headers)
                response.raise_for_status()
                data = response.json()

                items = data.get("data", []) or []
                # Prioritize Main characters first when fetching individual character bios for gender
                prioritized = sorted(
                    items,
                    key=lambda it: 0 if str(it.get("role", "")).lower() == "main" else 1
                )

                results = []
                detail_fetches = 0
                for item in prioritized:
                    char = item.get("character", {}) or {}
                    about = char.get("about", "") or ""
                    aliases = list(char.get("nicknames", []) or [])
                    native_name = char.get("name_kanji", "") or ""
                    mal_id = char.get("mal_id")

                    # /anime/{id}/characters omits 'about'; fetch /characters/{mal_id} lazily for top roles
                    if not about and mal_id and detail_fetches < self.MAX_CHARACTER_DETAIL_FETCHES:
                        detail_fetches += 1
                        try:
                            await self._rate_limit_delay()
                            detail_url = f"{self.BASE_URL}/characters/{mal_id}"
                            detail_resp = await client.get(detail_url, headers=headers)
                            if detail_resp.status_code == 429:
                                await asyncio.sleep(0.75)
                                detail_resp = await client.get(detail_url, headers=headers)
                            if detail_resp.status_code == 200:
                                c_data = detail_resp.json().get("data", {}) or {}
                                about = c_data.get("about", "") or ""
                                if not aliases:
                                    aliases = [n for n in (c_data.get("nicknames") or []) if isinstance(n, str) and n.strip()]
                                if not native_name:
                                    native_name = c_data.get("name_kanji", "") or ""
                        except Exception:
                            pass

                    gender, confidence = self.parse_gender_from_about(about)

                    results.append(CharacterProfile(
                        canonical_name=char.get("name", "") or "",
                        native_name=native_name,
                        aliases=aliases,
                        gender=gender,
                        gender_source="Jikan (Parsed)",
                        gender_confidence=confidence,
                        role=item.get("role", "") or "",
                        description=about
                    ))
                return results
            except Exception as e:
                last_error = e
                await asyncio.sleep(1)

        raise ProviderError(f"Jikan character fetch failed after 3 attempts: {last_error}")
```

```python
import httpx
from typing import List
from app.models.anime import AnimeInfo, CharacterProfile, GenderEnum
from app.anime.sources.base import BaseAnimeSource
from app.core.exceptions import ProviderError

class KitsuSource(BaseAnimeSource):
    """Kitsu REST API source for anime metadata."""
    
    BASE_URL = "https://kitsu.io/api/edge"
    
    async def search_anime(self, query: str) -> List[AnimeInfo]:
        url = f"{self.BASE_URL}/anime"
        headers = {
            'Accept': 'application/vnd.api+json',
            'Content-Type': 'application/vnd.api+json'
        }
        try:
            client = await self.get_http_client()
            response = await client.get(
                url,
                params={"filter[text]": query, "page[limit]": 10},
                headers=headers,
            )
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()

            results = []
            for item in data.get("data", []):
                attr = item.get("attributes", {})
                titles = attr.get("titles", {})
                results.append(AnimeInfo(
                    title_romaji=titles.get("en_jp") or attr.get("canonicalTitle", ""),
                    title_english=titles.get("en") or "",
                    title_native=titles.get("ja_jp") or "",
                    episodes=attr.get("episodeCount"),
                    format=attr.get("subtype", ""),
                    status=attr.get("status", ""),
                    cover_image_url=attr.get("posterImage", {}).get("large", ""),
                    source_name="Kitsu",
                    source_id=str(item.get("id"))
                ))
            return results
        except Exception as e:
            raise ProviderError(f"Kitsu search failed: {e}")

    async def get_characters(self, anime_id: str) -> List[CharacterProfile]:
        url = f"{self.BASE_URL}/anime/{anime_id}/characters"
        headers = {
            'Accept': 'application/vnd.api+json',
            'Content-Type': 'application/vnd.api+json'
        }
        try:
            client = await self.get_http_client()
            # Kitsu relationships don't include character details directly in this endpoint.
            # It requires 'include=character' to get the actual character details.
            response = await client.get(
                url,
                params={"include": "character", "page[limit]": 20},
                headers=headers,
            )
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()

            results = []

            # Characters are in 'included' array
            included = data.get("included", [])
            char_map = {item["id"]: item["attributes"] for item in included if item["type"] == "characters"}

            for item in data.get("data", []):
                attr = item.get("attributes", {})
                role = attr.get("role", "")

                char_id = item.get("relationships", {}).get("character", {}).get("data", {}).get("id")
                if not char_id or char_id not in char_map:
                    continue

                char_attr = char_map[char_id]
                name = char_attr.get("canonicalName", "")
                about = char_attr.get("description", "") or ""

                # Count pronoun frequencies in bio text to determine majority
                import re
                gender = GenderEnum.UNKNOWN
                confidence = 0.0
                about_lower = about.lower()

                female_matches = len(re.findall(r'\b(she|her|hers|woman|girl|female)\b', about_lower))
                male_matches = len(re.findall(r'\b(he|him|his|man|boy|male)\b', about_lower))

                if female_matches > male_matches:
                    gender = GenderEnum.FEMALE
                    confidence = min(0.95, 0.60 + (female_matches - male_matches) * 0.05)
                elif male_matches > female_matches:
                    gender = GenderEnum.MALE
                    confidence = min(0.95, 0.60 + (male_matches - female_matches) * 0.05)

                results.append(CharacterProfile(
                    canonical_name=name,
                    gender=gender,
                    gender_source="Kitsu (Parsed)",
                    gender_confidence=confidence,
                    role=role,
                    description=about
                ))
            return results
        except Exception as e:
            raise ProviderError(f"Kitsu character fetch failed: {e}")
```

```python
import logging
from typing import List, Optional
from urllib.parse import quote_plus
import httpx
from app.anime.sources.base import BaseAnimeSource
from app.models.anime import MediaInfo, CharacterProfile, GenderEnum

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class TMDBSource(BaseAnimeSource):
    """The Movie Database (TMDB) metadata provider for movies and TV shows."""
    BASE_URL = "https://api.themoviedb.org/3"
    IMAGE_BASE_URL = "https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/w500"

    def __init__(self, api_key: str = "", shared_client: Optional[httpx.AsyncClient] = None):
        super().__init__(shared_client=shared_client)
        self.api_key = api_key

    async def search_anime(self, query: str) -> List[MediaInfo]:
        """Search media using TMDB."""
        return await self.search_media(query)

    async def search_media(self, query: str, media_type: str = "all", api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> List[MediaInfo]:
        """Search movies and TV shows via TMDB multi-search."""
        key = api_key or self.api_key
        if not key or not query or not query.strip():
            return []

        clean_q = quote_plus(query.strip())
        endpoint = "search/multi"
        if media_type == "movie":
            endpoint = "search/movie"
        elif media_type in ("tv", "series"):
            endpoint = "search/tv"

        url = f"{self.BASE_URL}/{endpoint}?api_key={key}&query={clean_q}&include_adult=false"
        try:
            client = await self.get_http_client()
            resp = await client.get(url)
            if resp.status_code != 200:
                return []
            data = resp.json()
            results = []
            for item in data.get("results", [])[:15]:
                item_type = item.get("media_type") or media_type
                if item_type not in ("movie", "tv"):
                    if "title" in item:
                        item_type = "movie"
                    elif "name" in item:
                        item_type = "tv"
                    else:
                        continue

                title = item.get("title") or item.get("name") or ""
                date_val = item.get("release_date") or item.get("first_air_date") or ""
                year = int(date_val[:4]) if len(date_val) >= 4 and date_val[:4].isdigit() else None
                poster = f"{self.IMAGE_BASE_URL}{item.get('poster_path')}" if item.get("poster_path") else ""

                media = MediaInfo(
                    media_type="movie" if item_type == "movie" else "tv",
                    title=title,
                    title_english=title,
                    title_romaji=title,
                    year=year,
                    format="Movie" if item_type == "movie" else "TV",
                    status="Released",
                    cover_image_url=poster,
                    source_name="TMDB",
                    source_id=f"{item_type}:{item.get('id')}",
                    overview=item.get("overview") or "",
                    genres=[]
                )
                results.append(media)
            return results
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"TMDB search failed: {e}")
            return []

    async def get_characters(self, source_id: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> List[CharacterProfile]:
        """Fetch cast and characters with genders from TMDB."""
        key = api_key or self.api_key
        if not key:
            return []

        item_type = "movie"
        tmdb_id = source_id
        if ":" in source_id:
            item_type, tmdb_id = source_id.split(":", 1)

        url = f"{self.BASE_URL}/{item_type}/{tmdb_id}/credits?api_key={key}"
        try:
            client = await self.get_http_client()
            resp = await client.get(url)
            if resp.status_code != 200:
                return []
            data = resp.json()
            cast = data.get("cast", [])
            characters = []
            for member in cast[:25]:
                char_name = (member.get("character") or "").strip()
                actor_name = (member.get("name") or "").strip()
                if not char_name and not actor_name:
                    continue

                canonical = char_name or actor_name
                aliases = [actor_name] if actor_name and actor_name != canonical else []

                # TMDB gender: 1=Female, 2=Male, 3=Non-binary, 0=Unknown
                g_code = member.get("gender", 0)
                if g_code == 1:
                    gender = GenderEnum.FEMALE
                    confidence = 0.98
                elif g_code == 2:
                    gender = GenderEnum.MALE
                    confidence = 0.98
                elif g_code == 3:
                    gender = GenderEnum.NON_BINARY
                    confidence = 0.95
                else:
                    gender = GenderEnum.UNKNOWN
                    confidence = 0.0

                profile = CharacterProfile(
                    canonical_name=canonical,
                    gender=gender,
                    gender_source="TMDB",
                    gender_confidence=confidence,
                    role="MAIN" if member.get("order", 99) < 8 else "SUPPORTING",
                    voice_actor=actor_name,
                    aliases=aliases,
                    description=f"Played by {actor_name}" if actor_name else ""
                )
                characters.append(profile)
            return characters
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"TMDB get_characters failed: {e}")
            return []
```

```python
import logging
import re
from typing import List, Optional
from urllib.parse import quote_plus
import httpx
from app.anime.sources.base import BaseAnimeSource
from app.models.anime import MediaInfo, CharacterProfile, GenderEnum

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class TVMazeSource(BaseAnimeSource):
    """TVMaze metadata source for TV series and miniseries (Free, public API, no key required)."""
    BASE_URL = "https://api.tvmaze.com"

    async def search_anime(self, query: str) -> List[MediaInfo]:
        """Search TV series using TVMaze."""
        return await self.search_shows(query)

    async def search_shows(self, query: str) -> List[MediaInfo]:
        """Search TV series and return MediaInfo list."""
        if not query or not query.strip():
            return []
        url = f"{self.BASE_URL}/search/shows?q={quote_plus(query.strip())}"
        try:
            client = await self.get_http_client()
            resp = await client.get(url)
            if resp.status_code != 200:
                return []
            items = resp.json()
            results = []
            for item in items:
                show = item.get("show", {})
                if not show:
                    continue
                premiered = show.get("premiered") or ""
                year = int(premiered[:4]) if len(premiered) >= 4 and premiered[:4].isdigit() else None
                image = show.get("image") or {}
                cover = image.get("medium") or image.get("original") or ""
                
                genres = show.get("genres") or []
                summary = show.get("summary") or ""
                clean_summary = re.sub(r'<.*?>', '', summary).strip()

                media = MediaInfo(
                    media_type="tv",
                    title=show.get("name") or "",
                    title_english=show.get("name") or "",
                    title_romaji=show.get("name") or "",
                    year=year,
                    format=show.get("type") or "Scripted",
                    status=show.get("status") or "",
                    cover_image_url=cover,
                    source_name="TVMaze",
                    source_id=str(show.get("id")),
                    overview=clean_summary,
                    genres=genres
                )
                results.append(media)
            return results
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"TVMaze search failed: {e}")
            return []

    async def get_characters(self, show_id: str) -> List[CharacterProfile]:
        """Get character and cast members with genders for a show ID."""
        url = f"{self.BASE_URL}/shows/{show_id}/cast"
        try:
            client = await self.get_http_client()
            resp = await client.get(url)
            if resp.status_code != 200:
                return []
            cast = resp.json()
            characters = []
            for entry in cast:
                char_obj = entry.get("character") or {}
                person_obj = entry.get("person") or {}
                
                char_name = char_obj.get("name") or ""
                actor_name = person_obj.get("name") or ""
                
                if not char_name and not actor_name:
                    continue
                
                canonical = char_name or actor_name
                aliases = [actor_name] if actor_name and actor_name != canonical else []
                
                gender_str = (person_obj.get("gender") or "").strip().lower()
                if gender_str == "male":
                    gender = GenderEnum.MALE
                elif gender_str == "female":
                    gender = GenderEnum.FEMALE
                else:
                    gender = GenderEnum.UNKNOWN
                    
                profile = CharacterProfile(
                    canonical_name=canonical,
                    gender=gender,
                    gender_source="TVMaze",
                    gender_confidence=0.95 if gender != GenderEnum.UNKNOWN else 0.0,
                    role="MAIN",
                    voice_actor=actor_name,
                    aliases=aliases,
                    description=f"Played by {actor_name}" if actor_name else ""
                )
                characters.append(profile)
            return characters
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"TVMaze get_characters failed: {e}")
            return []
```

```python
from typing import List, Optional, Dict
from app.core.database import DatabaseManager
from app.models.anime import MediaInfo, CharacterProfile, GenderEnum


class CharacterRepository:
    """Repository for Anime and Character persistence (characters, aliases, anime, anime_sources)."""

    def __init__(self, db: DatabaseManager):
        self.db = db

    def save_anime(self, media: MediaInfo) -> int:
        """Upserts a MediaInfo record into anime and anime_sources tables and returns anime_id."""
        if not media:
            return -1

        existing_id: Optional[int] = None
        if media.source_name and media.source_id:
            src_row = self.db.fetch_one(
                "SELECT anime_id FROM anime_sources WHERE source_name = ? AND source_id = ? LIMIT 1",
                (media.source_name, str(media.source_id)),
            )
            if src_row:
                existing_id = src_row["anime_id"]

        if existing_id is None:
            cand_title = (media.title_romaji or media.title or media.title_english or "").strip()
            if cand_title:
                t_row = self.db.fetch_one(
                    "SELECT id FROM anime WHERE LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(title_romaji, ''))) = LOWER(?) OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(title_english, ''))) = LOWER(?) LIMIT 1",
                    (cand_title, cand_title),
                )
                if t_row:
                    existing_id = t_row["id"]

        t_romaji = media.title_romaji or media.title or ""
        t_english = media.title_english or media.title or ""
        t_native = media.title_native or ""
        t_user = media.title_user or ""

        if existing_id is not None:
            self.db.execute(
                """
                UPDATE anime
                SET title_romaji = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), title_romaji),
                    title_english = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), title_english),
                    title_native = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), title_native),
                    title_user = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), title_user),
                    episodes = COALESCE(?, episodes),
                    format = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), format),
                    status = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), status),
                    cover_image_url = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), cover_image_url),
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                WHERE id = ?
                """,
                (
                    t_romaji, t_english, t_native, t_user,
                    media.episodes, media.format or "", media.status or "",
                    media.cover_image_url or "", existing_id,
                ),
            )
            anime_id = existing_id
        else:
            cursor = self.db.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO anime (
                    title_romaji, title_english, title_native, title_user,
                    episodes, format, status, cover_image_url
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                """,
                (
                    t_romaji, t_english, t_native, t_user,
                    media.episodes, media.format or "", media.status or "",
                    media.cover_image_url or "",
                ),
            )
            anime_id = cursor.lastrowid

        if media.source_name and media.source_id and anime_id:
            existing_src = self.db.fetch_one(
                "SELECT id FROM anime_sources WHERE anime_id = ? AND source_name = ? LIMIT 1",
                (anime_id, media.source_name),
            )
            if existing_src:
                self.db.execute(
                    "UPDATE anime_sources SET source_id = ? WHERE id = ?",
                    (str(media.source_id), existing_src["id"]),
                )
            else:
                self.db.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO anime_sources (anime_id, source_name, source_id, source_url) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                    (anime_id, media.source_name, str(media.source_id), ""),
                )

        media.id = anime_id
        return anime_id

    def get_anime_by_source(self, source_name: str, source_id: str) -> Optional[MediaInfo]:
        row = self.db.fetch_one(
            """
            SELECT a.*, s.source_name, s.source_id
            FROM anime a
            JOIN anime_sources s ON a.id = s.anime_id
            WHERE s.source_name = ? AND s.source_id = ?
            LIMIT 1
            """,
            (source_name, str(source_id)),
        )
        if not row:
            return None
        return MediaInfo(
            id=row["id"],
            title=row["title_romaji"] or row["title_english"] or "",
            title_romaji=row["title_romaji"] or "",
            title_english=row["title_english"] or "",
            title_native=row["title_native"] or "",
            title_user=row["title_user"] or "",
            episodes=row["episodes"],
            format=row["format"] or "",
            status=row["status"] or "",
            cover_image_url=row["cover_image_url"] or "",
            source_name=row["source_name"] or "",
            source_id=row["source_id"] or "",
        )

    def get_anime_by_id(self, anime_id: int) -> Optional[MediaInfo]:
        row = self.db.fetch_one("SELECT * FROM anime WHERE id = ?", (anime_id,))
        if not row:
            return None
        src_row = self.db.fetch_one(
            "SELECT source_name, source_id FROM anime_sources WHERE anime_id = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1",
            (anime_id,),
        )
        return MediaInfo(
            id=row["id"],
            title=row["title_romaji"] or row["title_english"] or "",
            title_romaji=row["title_romaji"] or "",
            title_english=row["title_english"] or "",
            title_native=row["title_native"] or "",
            title_user=row["title_user"] or "",
            episodes=row["episodes"],
            format=row["format"] or "",
            status=row["status"] or "",
            cover_image_url=row["cover_image_url"] or "",
            source_name=src_row["source_name"] if src_row else "",
            source_id=src_row["source_id"] if src_row else "",
        )

    def save_character(self, profile: CharacterProfile) -> int:
        sql = """
            INSERT INTO characters (
                anime_id, canonical_name, first_name, last_name, native_name, 
                arabic_name, gender, gender_source, gender_confidence, role, 
                age, description, voice_actor, speech_style, translation_notes, is_user_override
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        """
        params = (
            profile.anime_id, profile.canonical_name, profile.first_name, profile.last_name,
            profile.native_name, profile.arabic_name, profile.gender.value,
            profile.gender_source, profile.gender_confidence, profile.role,
            profile.age, profile.description, profile.voice_actor,
            profile.speech_style, profile.translation_notes, int(profile.is_user_override)
        )
        cursor = self.db.execute(sql, params)
        char_id = cursor.lastrowid
        profile.id = char_id
        for alias in (profile.aliases or []):
            if alias and alias.strip():
                self.add_alias(char_id, alias.strip())
        return char_id

    def save_characters_for_anime(self, anime_id: int, characters: List[CharacterProfile]) -> List[CharacterProfile]:
        """Upserts all characters and aliases for a given anime_id, preserving user overrides."""
        existing_rows = self.db.fetch_all("SELECT * FROM characters WHERE anime_id = ?", (anime_id,))
        existing_by_name: Dict[str, object] = {}
        for row in existing_rows:
            cname = (row["canonical_name"] or "").strip().lower()
            if cname:
                existing_by_name[cname] = row

        for profile in characters:
            profile.anime_id = anime_id
            cname_key = (profile.canonical_name or "").strip().lower()
            existing = existing_by_name.get(cname_key) if cname_key else None
            if existing:
                char_id = existing["id"]
                profile.id = char_id
                if not bool(existing["is_user_override"]):
                    self.db.execute(
                        """
                        UPDATE characters
                        SET first_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), first_name),
                            last_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), last_name),
                            native_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), native_name),
                            arabic_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), arabic_name),
                            gender = CASE WHEN ? != 'UNKNOWN' THEN ? ELSE gender END,
                            gender_source = CASE WHEN ? != 'UNKNOWN' THEN ? ELSE gender_source END,
                            gender_confidence = CASE WHEN ? > gender_confidence THEN ? ELSE gender_confidence END,
                            role = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), role),
                            age = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), age),
                            description = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), description),
                            voice_actor = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), voice_actor),
                            speech_style = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), speech_style),
                            translation_notes = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), translation_notes),
                            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                        WHERE id = ?
                        """,
                        (
                            profile.first_name, profile.last_name, profile.native_name,
                            profile.arabic_name, profile.gender.value, profile.gender.value,
                            profile.gender.value, profile.gender_source,
                            profile.gender_confidence, profile.gender_confidence,
                            profile.role, profile.age, profile.description, profile.voice_actor,
                            profile.speech_style, profile.translation_notes, char_id,
                        ),
                    )
                for alias in (profile.aliases or []):
                    if alias and alias.strip():
                        self.add_alias(char_id, alias.strip())
            else:
                self.save_character(profile)

        return characters

    def get_character_by_id(self, id: int) -> Optional[CharacterProfile]:
        sql = "SELECT * FROM characters WHERE id = ?"
        row = self.db.fetch_one(sql, (id,))
        if not row:
            return None
        alias_rows = self.db.fetch_all(
            "SELECT alias FROM character_aliases WHERE character_id = ?",
            (id,),
        )
        aliases = [ar["alias"] for ar in alias_rows if ar["alias"]]
        return self._map_row(row, aliases=aliases)

    def get_characters_for_anime(self, anime_id: int) -> List[CharacterProfile]:
        sql = "SELECT * FROM characters WHERE anime_id = ?"
        rows = self.db.fetch_all(sql, (anime_id,))
        if not rows:
            return []
        alias_rows = self.db.fetch_all(
            """
            SELECT ca.character_id, ca.alias
            FROM character_aliases ca
            JOIN characters c ON c.id = ca.character_id
            WHERE c.anime_id = ?
            """,
            (anime_id,),
        )
        aliases_map: Dict[int, List[str]] = {}
        for ar in alias_rows:
            if ar["alias"]:
                aliases_map.setdefault(ar["character_id"], []).append(ar["alias"])
        return [self._map_row(r, aliases=aliases_map.get(r["id"], [])) for r in rows]

    def add_alias(self, character_id: int, alias: str) -> None:
        clean_alias = (alias or "").strip()
        if not clean_alias:
            return
        existing = self.db.fetch_one(
            "SELECT id FROM character_aliases WHERE character_id = ? AND LOWER(alias) = LOWER(?) LIMIT 1",
            (character_id, clean_alias),
        )
        if existing:
            return
        sql = "INSERT INTO character_aliases (character_id, alias, alias_type) VALUES (?, ?, ?)"
        self.db.execute(sql, (character_id, clean_alias, "alternative"))

    def set_user_override(self, character_id: int, arabic_name: str, gender: GenderEnum, notes: str) -> None:
        sql = """
            UPDATE characters 
            SET arabic_name = ?, gender = ?, translation_notes = ?, is_user_override = 1 
            WHERE id = ?
        """
        self.db.execute(sql, (arabic_name, gender.value, notes, character_id))

    def _map_row(self, row, aliases: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> CharacterProfile:
        row_keys = set(row.keys()) if hasattr(row, "keys") else set()
        return CharacterProfile(
            id=row["id"],
            anime_id=row["anime_id"],
            canonical_name=row["canonical_name"] or "",
            first_name=row["first_name"] or "",
            last_name=row["last_name"] or "",
            native_name=row["native_name"] or "",
            arabic_name=row["arabic_name"] or "",
            aliases=list(aliases or []),
            gender=GenderEnum(row["gender"]) if row["gender"] else GenderEnum.UNKNOWN,
            gender_source=row["gender_source"] or "",
            gender_confidence=row["gender_confidence"] or 0.0,
            role=row["role"] or "",
            age=row["age"] or "",
            description=row["description"] or "",
            voice_actor=row["voice_actor"] or "",
            speech_style=(row["speech_style"] or "") if "speech_style" in row_keys else "",
            translation_notes=(row["translation_notes"] or "") if "translation_notes" in row_keys else "",
            is_user_override=bool(row["is_user_override"])
        )
```

```python
from app.models.anime import GenderEnum

class GenderResolver:
    """Resolves character gender using source hierarchy."""
    
    def resolve_gender(self, user_gender: GenderEnum, anilist_gender: GenderEnum, mal_gender: GenderEnum) -> GenderEnum:
        # Hierarchy: User Override > AniList > MAL
        
        if user_gender != GenderEnum.UNKNOWN:
            return user_gender
            
        # Detect conflict
        if (anilist_gender == GenderEnum.MALE and mal_gender == GenderEnum.FEMALE) or \
           (anilist_gender == GenderEnum.FEMALE and mal_gender == GenderEnum.MALE):
            return GenderEnum.CONFLICT
            
        if anilist_gender != GenderEnum.UNKNOWN:
            return anilist_gender
            
        if mal_gender != GenderEnum.UNKNOWN:
            return mal_gender
            
        return GenderEnum.UNKNOWN
```

```python
from typing import List, Optional
from rapidfuzz import fuzz
from app.models.anime import CharacterProfile, CharacterMatch
from app.models.subtitle import SubtitleEvent

class CharacterResolver:
    """Resolves speaker names to Character Profiles."""
    
    def __init__(self, profiles: List[CharacterProfile]):
        self.profiles = profiles

    def resolve_speaker(self, speaker_name: str) -> Optional[CharacterMatch]:
        if not speaker_name or not self.profiles:
            return None
            
        best_match = None
        highest_score = 0.0
        
        name_lower = speaker_name.lower()

        for profile in self.profiles:
            # 1. Exact Match
            names = [
                profile.canonical_name, 
                profile.first_name, 
                profile.last_name, 
                profile.native_name
            ]
            for n in names:
                if n and speaker_name == n:
                    return CharacterMatch(profile=profile, score=100.0, match_type="exact", matched_against=n)
                    
            # 2. Case-insensitive Match
            for n in names:
                if n and name_lower == n.lower():
                    return CharacterMatch(profile=profile, score=95.0, match_type="case_insensitive", matched_against=n)
                    
            # 3. Alias Match
            for alias in profile.aliases:
                if name_lower == alias.lower():
                    return CharacterMatch(profile=profile, score=90.0, match_type="alias", matched_against=alias)
                    
            # 4. Rapidfuzz Match
            for n in names + profile.aliases:
                if not n:
                    continue
                ratio = max(
                    fuzz.ratio(name_lower, n.lower()),
                    fuzz.token_sort_ratio(name_lower, n.lower())
                )
                if ratio > highest_score:
                    highest_score = ratio
                    best_match = CharacterMatch(profile=profile, score=ratio, match_type="fuzzy", matched_against=n)
                    
        if best_match and best_match.score >= 80.0:
            return best_match
            
        return None

    def get_batch_characters(self, events: List[SubtitleEvent]) -> List[CharacterProfile]:
        """Find all unique speakers in batch events, resolve them, return used character profiles."""
        unique_speakers = {e.speaker.strip() for e in events if e.speaker and e.speaker.strip()}
        
        resolved_profiles = {}
        for spk in unique_speakers:
            match = self.resolve_speaker(spk)
            if match and match.profile:
                # Deduplicate by canonical_name or id
                key = match.profile.canonical_name or str(match.profile.id or id(match.profile))
                resolved_profiles[key] = match.profile
                
        return list(resolved_profiles.values())
```

```python
from typing import Set
from app.models.subtitle import SubtitleDocument

class SpeakerExtractor:
    """Extracts speakers from subtitles."""
    
    def extract_speakers(self, document: SubtitleDocument) -> Set[str]:
        """Extract unique non-empty Name fields from events."""
        speakers = set()
        for event in document.events:
            speaker = event.speaker.strip()
            if speaker:
                speakers.add(speaker)
        return speakers
```

```python
    custom_url: str = Field(default="https://api.openai.com/v1")

    custom_model: str = Field(default="")

    temperature: float = Field(default=0.1)
    top_p: float = Field(default=0.85)
    min_p: float = Field(default=0.05)
    repetition_penalty: float = Field(default=1.0)

    max_events_per_batch: int = Field(default=30)
    context_prev_lines: int = Field(default=4)
    context_next_lines: int = Field(default=3)
    
    source_lang: str = Field(default="✨ كشف تلقائي للغة (Auto Detect)")
    target_lang: str = Field(default="Arabic (العربية الفصحى)")

    # Smart Auto-Healing & Quality Settings
    auto_improve: bool = Field(default=False)
    enable_smart_healing: bool = Field(default=True)
    enable_arabic_punct: bool = Field(default=True)
    enable_latin_clean: bool = Field(default=True)
    enable_quote_fix: bool = Field(default=True)
    protect_tags: bool = Field(default=True)
    skip_visual_effects: bool = Field(default=True)
    separate_inline_effects: bool = Field(default=True)
    deduplicate_identical_lines: bool = Field(default=True)
    play_sound_on_finish: bool = Field(default=True)
    story_notes: str = Field(default="")
    
    db_path: str = Field(default="subtitler.db")
    log_level: str = Field(default="INFO")

    def save_to_file(self, path: str | Path = CONFIG_FILE_PATH) -> None:
        """Save current settings to a JSON file."""
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(self.model_dump_json(indent=4))

    @classmethod
    def load_from_file(cls, path: str | Path = CONFIG_FILE_PATH) -> "AppSettings":
        """Load settings from a JSON file."""
        p = Path(path)
        if p.exists():
            try:
                with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    data = json.load(f)
                return cls(**data)
            except Exception:
                pass
        return cls()

_settings_instance = None

def get_settings() -> AppSettings:
    """Returns a singleton instance of AppSettings."""
    global _settings_instance
    if _settings_instance is None:
        _settings_instance = AppSettings.load_from_file()
    return _settings_instance
```
