```python
import re
from typing import List, Tuple, Dict, Any, Optional
from app.models.subtitle import SubtitleEvent, SubtitleDocument, SubtitleFormat


class EffectSeparator:
    """
    Intelligent separator for subtitle lines that combine on-screen visual effects,
    signs, drawings, or SFX with human dialogue in the same line.
    
    Provides:
    1. Detection of mixed effect-dialogue lines.
    2. Event-level separation: splits mixed lines into distinct synchronized events
       (FX events for signs/effects, dialogue events for spoken lines).
    3. Document-level processing with sequential ID re-indexing.
    4. Inline vector drawing and SFX delimiter protection.
    """

    @classmethod
    def is_effect_segment(cls, seg: str) -> bool:
        """Determines if a string segment represents an on-screen effect, sign, drawing, or SFX."""
        s = seg.strip()
        if not s:
            return False

        # 1. Vector drawings: {\p1}...
        if re.search(r'\\p[1-9]', s):
            return True

        # 2. Clean text check (strip all ASS override tags)
        clean = re.sub(r'\{[^{}]*\}', '', s).strip()
        if not clean:
            return True

        # 3. No readable linguistic letters (just symbols, coordinates, numbers, or dividers)
        if not re.search(r'[A-Za-zء-ي\u3040-\u30ff\u4e00-\u9faf]', clean):
            return True

        # 4. Karaoke timing tags (\k, \K, \kf, \ko)
        if re.search(r'\{\\[kK][fo]?\d+', s):
            return True

        # 5. Explicit signs or SFX label prefixes (with or without brackets/asterisks)
        if re.match(
            r'^(?:\[|\(|\*|\b)?(?:SFX|سFX|مؤثر|صوت|Sign|لوحة|Sound|Audio|Music|Noise)[\:\s\-\]]',
            clean,
            re.IGNORECASE
        ):
            return True

        # 6. Standalone onomatopoeia / sound effect in asterisks or brackets
        if re.match(r'^\*[^*]+\*$', clean):
            return True
        if re.match(
            r'^\[(?:Sound|Audio|Music|Noise|SFX|Silence|Laughter|Sigh|Gasp|Cough|Footsteps|Applause|Gunfire|Explosion|Door|Phone|Whistle|Chuckle|Scream|Chant)[^\]]*\]$',
            clean,
            re.IGNORECASE
        ):
            return True
        if re.match(
            r'^\((?:Sound|Audio|Music|Noise|SFX|Silence|Laughter|Sigh|Gasp|Cough|Footsteps|Applause|Gunfire|Explosion|Door|Phone|Whistle|Chuckle|Scream|Chant)[^\)]*\)$',
            clean,
            re.IGNORECASE
        ):
            return True

        # 7. Explicit signs, titles, chapters, staff, notes
        if re.match(
            r'^(?:\[|\(|\*|\b)?(?:Title|عنوان|Chapter|فصل|Episode|حلقة|Staff|طاقم|Credits?|حقوق|Typesetting|تايبست|Note|ملاحظة|T/N|TL/N|TN)[\:\s\-\]]',
            clean,
            re.IGNORECASE
        ):
            return True

        # 8. Explicit signs accompanied by positioning / alignment tags (\an[4-9], \pos, \move, \clip, \org, \fad)
        has_pos_or_align = bool(re.search(r'\\(?:an[4-9]|pos|move|clip|iclip|org|fad)', s))
        if has_pos_or_align:
            clean_upper = clean.upper()
            sign_keywords = (
                "SIGN", "TITLE", "CREDIT", "LOGO", "STAFF", "SPONSOR", "NOTE",
                "CHAPTER", "EPISODE", "WARNING", "DANGER", "CAUTION", "HOSPITAL",
                "POLICE", "STATION", "ROOM", "OFFICE", "STORE", "SCHOOL", "LIBRARY",
                "ENTRANCE", "EXIT", "NOTICE", "NEWS", "BREAKING"
            )
            if any(k in clean_upper for k in sign_keywords):
                return True
            # Uppercase English text (signs) with non-dialogue alignment or 3D transform
            if re.match(r'^[A-Z0-9\s\-\:\.\,\!\?\'\"]+$', clean) and len(clean.split()) <= 6:
                if re.search(r'\\an[4-9]', s) or re.search(r'\\(fr[xyz]-?[1-9]|clip\(|iclip\()', s):
                    return True

        # 9. Style resets to a blocked style ({\rSign}, {\rStaff}, etc.)
        r_match = re.search(r'\{\\r([^}]*)\}', s)
        if r_match:
            r_style = r_match.group(1).strip()
            if SubtitleEvent.is_style_blocked(r_style):
                return True

        return False

    @classmethod
    def is_dialogue_segment(cls, seg: str) -> bool:
        """Determines if a string segment represents human speech/dialogue."""
        s = seg.strip()
        if not s:
            return False
        if cls.is_effect_segment(s):
            return False
        clean = re.sub(r'\{[^{}]*\}', '', s).strip()
        return bool(re.search(r'[A-Za-zء-ي\u3040-\u30ff\u4e00-\u9faf]', clean))

    @classmethod
    def split_raw_into_segments(cls, raw: str) -> List[str]:
        """
        Splits a raw subtitle line into its visual component segments based on:
        - Linebreaks (\\N, \\n)
        - Vector drawings ending in {\\p0}
        - Style resets (\\r)
        - Mid-line effect positioning tags (\\pos, \\an4-9, etc.)
        - Inline effect cues at start or end of dialogue
        """
        if not raw:
            return []

        # 1. Primary boundary: \\N or \\n
        if r'\N' in raw or r'\n' in raw or '\n' in raw:
            initial_parts = [p.strip() for p in re.split(r'\\N|\\n|\n', raw)]
        else:
            initial_parts = [raw.strip()]

        segments: List[str] = []
        for part in initial_parts:
            if not part:
                continue

            # Sub-split 2: Vector drawing ending in {\p0} followed by text
            m_p0 = re.search(r'(\{\\p0\})\s*(.+)', part)
            if m_p0:
                segments.append(part[:m_p0.end(1)].strip())
                segments.append(m_p0.group(2).strip())
                continue

            # Sub-split 3: Style reset {\r...} separating two parts
            m_r = re.search(r'([^\\])\s*(\{\\r[^{}]*\}.+)', part)
            if m_r:
                segments.append(part[:m_r.start(2)].strip())
                segments.append(m_r.group(2).strip())
                continue

            # Sub-split 4: Mid-sentence effect positioning tag
            m_pos = re.search(r'([^\\])\s*(\{\\(?:pos|an[4-9]|move|org|clip|fad)[^{}]*\}.+)', part)
            if m_pos:
                segments.append(part[:m_pos.start(2)].strip())
                segments.append(m_pos.group(2).strip())
                continue

            # Sub-split 5: Inline effect cue at START of line followed by dialogue
            # Example: {\pos(100,200)}[SFX: EXPLOSION] هل الجميع بخير؟
            # Or: [SFX: BOOM] - انتبه!
            # Or: *Gasp* What was that?
            # Or: {\fs14}SFX: rumble{\fs20} انتبه يا صديقي
            m_start_fx = re.match(
                r'^((?:\{[^{}]*\}\s*)*)(\[(?:SFX|سFX|مؤثر|صوت|Sound|Audio)[^\]]*\]|\*[^*]+\*|(?:SFX|سFX|مؤثر|صوت|Sign|لوحة)[\:\s\-][A-Za-z0-9_\s\.\!\?\-]+?)(?:\\N|\\n|\s*(\{\\r[^{}]*\}|\{\\fs\d+\})|\s+)([\u0600-\u06FF\-\"].+)$',
                part,
                re.IGNORECASE
            )
            if m_start_fx:
                lead_tags = m_start_fx.group(1) or ""
                fx_text = m_start_fx.group(2)
                mid_tags = m_start_fx.group(3) or ""
                diag_text = m_start_fx.group(4)
                segments.append(f"{lead_tags}{fx_text}".strip())
                segments.append(f"{mid_tags} {diag_text}".strip() if mid_tags else diag_text.strip())
                continue

            # Sub-split 6: Inline effect cue at END of line following dialogue
            # Example: هل الجميع بخير؟ [صوت انفجار]
            # Or: Look out! *Crash*
            m_end_fx = re.match(
                r'^(.+?)(?:\s+|\\N|\\n)(\[(?:SFX|سFX|مؤثر|صوت|Sound|Audio|انفجار|صراخ)[^\]]*\]|\*[^*]+\*)$',
                part,
                re.IGNORECASE
            )
            if m_end_fx and cls.is_effect_segment(m_end_fx.group(2)):
                segments.append(m_end_fx.group(1).strip())
                segments.append(m_end_fx.group(2).strip())
                continue

            segments.append(part)

        return segments

    @classmethod
    def is_mixed_line(cls, event: SubtitleEvent) -> bool:
        """Returns True if the event combines both an effect and spoken dialogue in the same line."""
        if event.is_comment:
            return False

        # If the event is an English song lyric (e.g. ED1-En, ED2-En, OP1-En),
        # it is NOT a mixed line - it's a continuous song subtitle!
        if SubtitleEvent.is_style_translatable(event.style) and any(k in (event.style or "").lower() for k in ("-en", "-eng", "ed", "op", "song")):
            return False

        raw = event.original_text or event.text
        if not raw:
            return False

        segments = cls.split_raw_into_segments(raw)
        if len(segments) <= 1:
            return False

        has_fx = any(cls.is_effect_segment(s) for s in segments)
        has_dialogue = any(cls.is_dialogue_segment(s) for s in segments)
        return has_fx and has_dialogue

    @classmethod
    def separate_event(cls, event: SubtitleEvent) -> List[SubtitleEvent]:
        """
        Splits a mixed event into individual synchronized events:
        - Effect events: Marked with effect="fx" (classified as is_visual_effect()=True).
        - Dialogue events: Grouped dialogue lines with preserved multi-speaker linebreaks.
        Both retain identical start/end timing and layer for perfect on-screen synchronization.
        """
        if not cls.is_mixed_line(event):
            return [event]

        raw = event.original_text or event.text
        segments = cls.split_raw_into_segments(raw)
        result: List[SubtitleEvent] = []

        # Group segments into contiguous blocks, merging consecutive dialogue segments
        blocks: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        for seg in segments:
            is_fx = cls.is_effect_segment(seg)
            if blocks and blocks[-1]["is_fx"] is False and is_fx is False:
                blocks[-1]["segments"].append(seg)
            else:
                blocks.append({"is_fx": is_fx, "segments": [seg]})

        for block in blocks:
            is_fx = block["is_fx"]
            segs = block["segments"]

            if is_fx:
                for seg in segs:
                    clean_text = re.sub(r'\{[^{}]*\}', '', seg).strip()
                    seg_style = event.style
                    r_match = re.search(r'\{\\r([^}]*)\}', seg)
                    if r_match:
                        extracted_style = r_match.group(1).strip()
                        if extracted_style:
                            seg_style = extracted_style

                    fx_ev = SubtitleEvent(
                        id=event.id,
                        layer=event.layer,
                        start=event.start,
                        end=event.end,
                        style=seg_style,
                        speaker="",
                        margin_l=event.margin_l,
                        margin_r=event.margin_r,
                        margin_v=event.margin_v,
                        effect=event.effect or "fx",
                        original_text=seg,
                        text=clean_text,
                        is_comment=event.is_comment,
                        format_type=event.format_type
                    )
                    result.append(fx_ev)
            else:
                combined_orig = r"\N".join(segs)
                combined_clean = r"\N".join(
                    re.sub(r'\{[^{}]*\}', '', s).strip() for s in segs
                )
                diag_style = event.style
                for seg in segs:
                    r_match = re.search(r'\{\\r([^}]*)\}', seg)
                    if r_match:
                        extracted_style = r_match.group(1).strip()
                        if extracted_style:
                            diag_style = extracted_style
                            break

                diag_ev = SubtitleEvent(
                    id=event.id,
                    layer=event.layer,
                    start=event.start,
                    end=event.end,
                    style=diag_style,
                    speaker=event.speaker,
                    margin_l=event.margin_l,
                    margin_r=event.margin_r,
                    margin_v=event.margin_v,
                    effect="",
                    original_text=combined_orig,
                    text=combined_clean,
                    is_comment=event.is_comment,
                    format_type=event.format_type
                )
                result.append(diag_ev)

        return result

    @classmethod
    def separate_document(cls, doc: SubtitleDocument) -> SubtitleDocument:
        """
        Separates all mixed events in the document into distinct effect and dialogue events,
        and re-indexes event IDs sequentially.
        """
        if not doc or not doc.events:
            return doc

        new_events: List[SubtitleEvent] = []
        any_split = False

        for ev in doc.events:
            if cls.is_mixed_line(ev):
                split_events = cls.separate_event(ev)
                new_events.extend(split_events)
                any_split = True
            else:
                new_events.append(ev)

        if any_split:
            for i, ev in enumerate(new_events, 1):
                ev.id = i
            doc.events = new_events

        return doc

    @classmethod
    def has_translatable_text(cls, raw: str) -> bool:
        """Determines if a subtitle line/effect contains translatable human words."""
        return EffectPayloadIsolator.has_translatable_text(raw)

    @classmethod
    def extract_clean_payload(cls, raw: str) -> Tuple[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Extracts pure text for LLM without tags, and records effect skeleton."""
        return EffectPayloadIsolator.extract_clean_payload(raw)

    @classmethod
    def reconstruct_effect_text(cls, translated: str, skeleton: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        """Re-attaches original visual effects, styling, and positions to translation."""
        return EffectPayloadIsolator.reconstruct_effect_text(translated, skeleton)


class EffectPayloadIsolator:
    """
    Advanced Effect & Styling Payload Isolator.
    
    Extracts pure human dialogue and on-screen sign texts from lines containing
    heavy ASS styling tags, positions, and visual effects. Ensures that:
    1. ZERO effect/styling tags reach the model, cutting context token usage by up to 80%.
    2. Small context models (e.g. ALLaM 4096) are never overwhelmed by coordinate noise.
    3. Re-injects 100% of original ASS positions, fonts, colors, rotations, and animations
       into the translated text upon return.
    """

    @classmethod
    def has_translatable_text(cls, raw: str) -> bool:
        """
        Determines whether a subtitle line or visual effect contains genuine readable linguistic words
        (Latin letters, Arabic, Japanese Kanji/Kana, Cyrillic, etc.) that should be translated.
        Returns False for pure vector drawings, empty shapes, and standalone sound cues (*gasp*, [Music]).
        """
        if not raw or not raw.strip():
            return False

        # 1. Strip vector drawings {\p1}...{\p0}
        clean = re.sub(r'\{\\p[1-9]\}[^\\{]*\{\\p0\}', '', raw)

        # 2. Strip all ASS override tags
        clean = re.sub(r'\{[^}]*\}', '', clean)
        clean = clean.replace(r'\N', ' ').replace(r'\n', ' ').strip()
        if not clean:
            return False

        # 3. Check if raw vector coordinates without tags (e.g. 'm 163.375 -131.25 b ...')
        if re.match(r'^[mblsc]\s+[-0-9]', clean):
            return False

        # 4. Pure sound effects in asterisks or brackets: e.g. *gasp*, [Music], (sigh), SFX: BOOM
        if re.match(r'^\*[^*]+\*$', clean):
            return False
        if re.match(r'^\[(?:Music|Sound|Audio|Noise|SFX|Laughter|Sigh|Gasp|Cough|Chuckle|Footsteps|Applause|Gunfire)[^\]]*\]$', clean, re.IGNORECASE):
            return False
        if re.match(r'^\((?:Music|Sound|Audio|Noise|SFX|Laughter|Sigh|Gasp|Cough|Chuckle|Footsteps|Applause|Gunfire)[^\)]*\)$', clean, re.IGNORECASE):
            return False
        if re.match(r'^(?:SFX|سFX|مؤثر|صوت)[\:\s\-]+[A-Za-z0-9_\s\.\!\?\-]+$', clean, re.IGNORECASE):
            return False

        # 5. Check for genuine readable linguistic letters
        return bool(re.search(r'[A-Za-zء-ي\u3040-\u30ff\u4e00-\u9faf\uac00-\ud7af]', clean))

    @classmethod
    def extract_clean_payload(cls, raw: str) -> Tuple[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        Separates all visual effect tags and styling from the translatable text payload.
        
        Returns:
            clean_payload: Pure text containing ONLY the dialogue/sign words and natural linebreaks (\\N).
            skeleton: Dictionary storing leading tags, trailing tags, and inline formatting per segment.
        """
        if not raw:
            return "", {"segments": [], "drawings": [], "raw_original": ""}

        # 1. Extract and preserve any vector drawings {\p1}...{\p0}
        drawings = re.findall(r'\{\\p[1-9]\}[^\\{]*\{\\p0\}', raw)
        text_without_drawings = re.sub(r'\{\\p[1-9]\}[^\\{]*\{\\p0\}', '', raw)

        # 2. Split into structural segments by linebreaks to preserve line-specific styling
        raw_segments = re.split(r'\\N|\\n|\n', text_without_drawings)
        clean_segments: List[str] = []
        seg_meta: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

        for seg in raw_segments:
            # A. Extract leading override tags: e.g. {\pos(100,200)\fad(150,150)\c&HFFFFFF&}
            m_lead = re.match(r'^((?:\{[^{}]*\}\s*)+)(.*)$', seg)
            if m_lead:
                lead_tags = m_lead.group(1).strip()
                rem = m_lead.group(2)
            else:
                lead_tags = ""
                rem = seg

            # B. Extract trailing override tags: e.g. {\i0}
            m_trail = re.search(r'((?:\{[^{}]*\}\s*)+)$', rem)
            if m_trail:
                trail_tags = m_trail.group(1).strip()
                rem = rem[:m_trail.start(1)]
            else:
                trail_tags = ""

            # C. Extract any mid-line internal tags along with proportional positions in clean text
            raw_clean_parts: List[str] = []
            raw_tag_offsets: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
            clean_pos = 0
            last_idx = 0
            for m_int in re.finditer(r'\{[^{}]*\}', rem):
                chunk = rem[last_idx:m_int.start()]
                raw_clean_parts.append(chunk)
                clean_pos += len(chunk)
                raw_tag_offsets.append({"tag": m_int.group(0), "raw_offset": clean_pos})
                last_idx = m_int.end()
            raw_clean_parts.append(rem[last_idx:])
            untrimmed_clean = "".join(raw_clean_parts)
            lead_ws = len(untrimmed_clean) - len(untrimmed_clean.lstrip())
            clean_text = untrimmed_clean.strip()

            # D. Clean out optional subber note prefixes like 'Sign: ' or '[Sign] ' for pure translation
            m_sign_pref = re.match(r'^(?:\[?Sign\]?|\[?لوحة\]?|\[?Title\]?|\[?عنوان\]?)[\:\s\-]+\s*(.+)$', clean_text, re.IGNORECASE)
            sign_prefix = ""
            prefix_shift = 0
            if m_sign_pref:
                prefix_shift = m_sign_pref.start(1)
                sign_prefix = clean_text[:prefix_shift].strip()
                clean_text = m_sign_pref.group(1).strip()

            total_clean_len = max(1, len(clean_text))
            internal_tags: List[str] = []
            internal_spans: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
            for tp in raw_tag_offsets:
                tag_str = tp["tag"]
                internal_tags.append(tag_str)
                adj_off = max(0, min(total_clean_len, tp["raw_offset"] - lead_ws - prefix_shift))
                is_closing = bool(re.match(r'^\{\\(?:r|[ibu]0|[cf]s?\s*|\w*0)\}$', tag_str, re.IGNORECASE))
                internal_spans.append({
                    "tag": tag_str,
                    "rel_pos": adj_off / total_clean_len,
                    "is_closing": is_closing,
                })

            clean_segments.append(clean_text)
            seg_meta.append({
                "lead_tags": lead_tags,
                "trail_tags": trail_tags,
                "internal_tags": internal_tags,
                "internal_spans": internal_spans,
                "sign_prefix": sign_prefix,
                "orig_clean": clean_text
            })

        clean_payload = r"\N".join(clean_segments)
        skeleton = {
            "segments": seg_meta,
            "drawings": drawings,
            "raw_original": raw
        }
        return clean_payload, skeleton

    @staticmethod
    def _inject_internal_tags(t_clean: str, seg_meta: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        r"""
        Proportionally re-inserts internal override tags (e.g. color highlights {\c&H...&}...{\r},
        inline emphasis {\i1}...{\i0}) at whole-word boundaries in translated text. Idempotent.
        """
        if not t_clean:
            return t_clean

        spans = seg_meta.get("internal_spans")
        if not spans:
            raw_tags = seg_meta.get("internal_tags") or []
            if not raw_tags:
                return t_clean
            n = len(raw_tags)
            spans = [
                {
                    "tag": tag,
                    "rel_pos": (idx + 1) / (n + 1),
                    "is_closing": bool(re.match(r'^\{\\(?:r|[ibu]0)\}$', tag, re.IGNORECASE)) or (n == 2 and idx == 1),
                }
                for idx, tag in enumerate(raw_tags)
            ]

        missing = [sp for sp in spans if sp.get("tag") and sp["tag"] not in t_clean]
        if not missing:
            return t_clean

        words = list(re.finditer(r'\S+', t_clean))
        if not words:
            return t_clean

        text_len = len(t_clean)
        insertions: List[Tuple[int, int, str]] = []
        min_next_offset = 0

        for idx, sp in enumerate(missing):
            tag = sp["tag"]
            rel_pos = float(sp.get("rel_pos", 0.5))
            target_pos = rel_pos * text_len
            is_closing = bool(sp.get("is_closing")) or (len(missing) >= 2 and idx % 2 == 1 and rel_pos > 0.45)

            if is_closing:
                candidates = [w for w in words if w.end() >= min_next_offset]
                chosen = min(candidates or words, key=lambda w: abs(w.end() - target_pos))
                ins_pos = chosen.end()
                min_next_offset = max(min_next_offset, chosen.end())
            else:
                candidates = [w for w in words if w.start() >= min_next_offset]
                chosen = min(candidates or words, key=lambda w: abs(w.start() - target_pos))
                ins_pos = chosen.start()
                min_next_offset = max(min_next_offset, chosen.end())

            insertions.append((ins_pos, idx, tag))

        # Apply insertions cleanly from back to front preserving order for equal positions
        insertions.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[0], -item[1]))
        result = t_clean
        for pos, _, tag in insertions:
            result = result[:pos] + tag + result[pos:]
        return result

    @staticmethod
    def _strip_existing_outer_tags(t_seg: str, lead: str, trail: str) -> str:
        """Strips already-applied outer lead/trail tag sequences so reconstruction is strictly idempotent."""
        res = t_seg.strip()
        if lead and res.startswith(lead):
            res = res[len(lead):].lstrip()
        if trail and res.endswith(trail):
            res = res[:-len(trail)].rstrip()
        return res

    @classmethod
    def reconstruct_effect_text(cls, translated: str, skeleton: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        """
        Idempotently reconstructs the full ASS line by re-injecting translated text into
        the original effects skeleton, preserving drawings, outer tags, and mid-line internal tags.
        """
        if not skeleton or "segments" not in skeleton or not skeleton["segments"]:
            return translated

        working_trans = translated or ""
        drawings = [d for d in (skeleton.get("drawings") or []) if d]
        for d in drawings:
            while working_trans.startswith(d):
                working_trans = working_trans[len(d):]
            if d in working_trans:
                working_trans = working_trans.replace(d, "")

        segments = skeleton["segments"]
        trans_segments = re.split(r'\\N|\\n|\n', working_trans)

        rebuilt_segments: List[str] = []

        if len(trans_segments) == len(segments):
            for i, t_seg in enumerate(trans_segments):
                m = segments[i]
                lead = m["lead_tags"]
                trail = m["trail_tags"]
                t_clean = cls._strip_existing_outer_tags(t_seg, lead, trail)
                t_clean = cls._inject_internal_tags(t_clean, m)
                rebuilt_segments.append(f"{lead}{t_clean}{trail}")
        elif len(trans_segments) == 1 and len(segments) > 1:
            # Model collapsed multiple lines into one single line
            lead = segments[0]["lead_tags"]
            trail = segments[-1]["trail_tags"]
            merged_spans: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
            seg_count = len(segments)
            for si, m in enumerate(segments):
                for sp in (m.get("internal_spans") or []):
                    scaled = dict(sp)
                    scaled["rel_pos"] = (si + float(sp.get("rel_pos", 0.5))) / seg_count
                    merged_spans.append(scaled)
            t_clean = cls._strip_existing_outer_tags(working_trans, lead, trail)
            if merged_spans:
                t_clean = cls._inject_internal_tags(t_clean, {"internal_spans": merged_spans})
            rebuilt_segments.append(f"{lead}{t_clean}{trail}")
        else:
            # Mismatched line count: attach available tags sequentially
            for i, t_seg in enumerate(trans_segments):
                if i < len(segments):
                    m = segments[i]
                    lead = m["lead_tags"]
                    trail = m["trail_tags"]
                    t_clean = cls._strip_existing_outer_tags(t_seg, lead, trail)
                    t_clean = cls._inject_internal_tags(t_clean, m)
                    rebuilt_segments.append(f"{lead}{t_clean}{trail}")
                else:
                    rebuilt_segments.append(t_seg.strip())

        res = r"\N".join(rebuilt_segments)

        # Re-attach each preserved vector drawing block once
        for d in drawings:
            if d not in res:
                res = d + res

        # De-duplicate adjacent identical single or multi-tag clusters (e.g. {\an8}{\an8} -> {\an8})
        res = re.sub(r'(\{\\[^}]+\})\1+', r'\1', res)
        res = re.sub(r'((?:\{\\[^}]+\}){2,})\1+', r'\1', res)

        return res
```

```python
import re
from app.models.subtitle import SubtitleFormat, SubtitleDocument, SubtitleEvent, SubtitleStyle
from .base import SubtitleParser

class ASSParser(SubtitleParser):
    def parse_text(self, content: str) -> SubtitleDocument:
        doc = SubtitleDocument(format=SubtitleFormat.ASS)
        lines = content.splitlines()
        
        current_section = None
        format_order = []
        event_idx = 1
        
        for line in lines:
            line_str = line.strip()
            if not line_str:
                if current_section == "Script Info":
                    doc.raw_header_lines.append(line)
                continue
                
            if line_str.startswith('[') and line_str.endswith(']'):
                current_section = line_str[1:-1]
                if current_section.lower() == "script info":
                    doc.raw_header_lines.append(line)
                continue
                
            if current_section and current_section.lower() == "script info":
                if any(line_str.lower().startswith(k) for k in (
                    "last style storage:", "audio file:", "video file:", "video ar mode:",
                    "video aspect ratio:", "video zoom percent:", "scroll position:",
                    "active line:", "video position:"
                )):
                    continue
                doc.raw_header_lines.append(line)
                if ':' in line_str:
                    k, v = line_str.split(':', 1)
                    doc.script_info[k.strip()] = v.strip()
                    
            elif current_section and "styles" in current_section.lower():
                if line_str.startswith('Format:'):
                    pass
                elif line_str.startswith('Style:'):
                    style = SubtitleStyle(raw_line=line)
                    name_part = line_str.split(':', 1)[1]
                    parts = [p.strip() for p in name_part.split(',')]
                    if parts:
                        style.name = parts[0]
                    doc.styles.append(style)
                    
            elif current_section and "events" in current_section.lower():
                if line_str.startswith('Format:'):
                    format_str = line_str.split(':', 1)[1]
                    format_order = [f.strip().lower() for f in format_str.split(',')]
                elif line_str.startswith('Dialogue:') or line_str.startswith('Comment:'):
                    is_comment = line_str.startswith('Comment:')
                    data_str = line_str.split(':', 1)[1]
                    parts = data_str.split(',', len(format_order)-1)
                    
                    if len(parts) != len(format_order):
                        continue
                        
                    event_data = dict(zip(format_order, parts))
                    raw_text = event_data.get('text', '')
                    # Strip vector drawings {\p1}...{\p0} and any {...} tags/comments from clean_text while preserving raw_text
                    clean_text = re.sub(r'\{\\p[1-9]\}[^\\{]*\{\\p0\}', '', raw_text)
                    clean_text = re.sub(r'\{[^}]*\}', '', clean_text)
                    # Add spaces around \N and \n to prevent fusing with English words (e.g. \NI -> \N I)
                    clean_text = clean_text.replace('\\N', ' \\N ').replace('\\n', ' \\n ')
                    clean_text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', clean_text).strip()
                    
                    layer_s = event_data.get('layer', '0').strip()
                    ml_s = event_data.get('marginl', '0').strip()
                    mr_s = event_data.get('marginr', '0').strip()
                    mv_s = event_data.get('marginv', '0').strip()

                    event = SubtitleEvent(
                        id=event_idx,
                        layer=int(layer_s) if layer_s.isdigit() else 0,
                        start=event_data.get('start', '').strip(),
                        end=event_data.get('end', '').strip(),
                        style=event_data.get('style', 'Default').strip(),
                        speaker=event_data.get('name', '').strip(),
                        margin_l=int(ml_s) if ml_s.isdigit() else 0,
                        margin_r=int(mr_s) if mr_s.isdigit() else 0,
                        margin_v=int(mv_s) if mv_s.isdigit() else 0,
                        effect=event_data.get('effect', '').strip(),
                        original_text=raw_text,
                        text=clean_text,
                        is_comment=is_comment,
                        format_type=SubtitleFormat.ASS
                    )
                    doc.events.append(event)
                    event_idx += 1
                    
            elif current_section and current_section.lower() in ("fonts", "graphics"):
                if current_section not in doc.metadata:
                    doc.metadata[current_section] = []
                doc.metadata[current_section].append(line)
                
        return doc
```

```python
import os
import re
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from app.models.subtitle import SubtitleDocument

class SubtitleParser(ABC):
    def parse(self, file_path: str) -> SubtitleDocument:
        content = self._read_file(file_path)
        doc = self.parse_text(content)
        doc.file_path = file_path
        return doc

    @abstractmethod
    def parse_text(self, content: str) -> SubtitleDocument:
        pass

    def _read_file(self, file_path: str) -> str:
        """
        Reads subtitle file with resilient multi-encoding detection and clean normalization:
        1. Checks BOM signatures (UTF-8, UTF-16 LE/BE).
        2. Tries standard modern encodings (utf-8-sig, utf-8).
        3. Tries UTF-16 (le & be) and CP1256 (Arabic Windows) / ISO-8859-6.
        4. Tries charset_normalizer / chardet heuristic detection.
        5. Tries Shift_JIS (Japanese) and CP1252.
        6. Cleans null bytes and zero-width artifacts.
        """
        with open(file_path, 'rb') as f:
            raw_bytes = f.read()

        if not raw_bytes:
            return ""

        # 1. Check explicit BOM signatures
        if raw_bytes.startswith(b'\xef\xbb\xbf'):
            text = raw_bytes[3:].decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
            return self._sanitize_content(text)
        elif raw_bytes.startswith(b'\xff\xfe'):
            text = raw_bytes[2:].decode('utf-16le', errors='replace')
            return self._sanitize_content(text)
        elif raw_bytes.startswith(b'\xfe\xff'):
            text = raw_bytes[2:].decode('utf-16be', errors='replace')
            return self._sanitize_content(text)

        # 2. Try explicit common encodings
        candidate_encodings = [
            'utf-8-sig',
            'utf-8',
            'utf-16-le',
            'utf-16-be',
            'cp1256',     # Arabic Windows
            'iso-8859-6', # Arabic ISO
            'shift_jis',  # Japanese
            'cp1252',     # Western European
        ]

        for enc in candidate_encodings:
            try:
                decoded = raw_bytes.decode(enc)
                # If decoded text contains excessive null bytes, it was decoded with wrong 8-bit codec for 16-bit data
                if decoded.count('\x00') > 2:
                    continue
                return self._sanitize_content(decoded)
            except (UnicodeDecodeError, ValueError):
                continue

        # 3. Dynamic charset detection via charset_normalizer or chardet
        try:
            import charset_normalizer
            results = charset_normalizer.from_bytes(raw_bytes)
            best = results.best()
            if best and best.encoding:
                try:
                    decoded = raw_bytes.decode(best.encoding)
                    if decoded.count('\x00') <= 2:
                        return self._sanitize_content(decoded)
                except Exception:
                    pass
        except ImportError:
            try:
                import chardet
                det = chardet.detect(raw_bytes)
                if det and det.get('encoding') and (det.get('confidence', 0) or 0) > 0.6:
                    decoded = raw_bytes.decode(det['encoding'])
                    if decoded.count('\x00') <= 2:
                        return self._sanitize_content(decoded)
            except Exception:
                pass

        # 4. Final resilient fallback
        text = raw_bytes.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
        return self._sanitize_content(text)

    @staticmethod
    def _sanitize_content(content: str) -> str:
        """Removes null bytes and invisible unicode artifacts."""
        if not content:
            return ""
        # Strip null bytes and non-printable control chars except \t, \n, \r
        content = content.replace('\x00', '')
        # Standardize carriage returns
        content = content.replace('\r\n', '\n').replace('\r', '\n')
        return content
```

```python
from app.models.subtitle import SubtitleFormat, SubtitleDocument, SubtitleEvent
```

```python
class SBVParser(SubtitleParser):
    def parse_text(self, content: str) -> SubtitleDocument:
        doc = SubtitleDocument(format=SubtitleFormat.SBV)

            lines = block.split('\n')
            if lines and ',' in lines[0]:

                start, end = times[0].strip(), times[1].strip()
                text = '\n'.join(lines[1:])
                doc.events.append(SubtitleEvent(

                ))
                idx += 1
```

```python
import re
from app.models.subtitle import SubtitleFormat, SubtitleDocument, SubtitleEvent
from app.subtitle.timecode import extract_timecode_token, parse_timecode_ms
from .base import SubtitleParser

_SRT_TIME_LINE_RE = re.compile(r'^\s*(\S+?)\s*-->\s*([^\s]+)(?:\s+(.*))?$')


class SRTParser(SubtitleParser):
    def parse_text(self, content: str) -> SubtitleDocument:
        doc = SubtitleDocument(format=SubtitleFormat.SRT)
        normalized = (content or "").replace('\ufeff', '').replace('\r\n', '\n').replace('\r', '\n').strip()
        if not normalized:
            return doc

        blocks = re.split(r'\n[ \t]*\n+', normalized)
        fallback_idx = 1

        for block in blocks:
            lines = [ln.rstrip('\r') for ln in block.split('\n')]
            # Trim leading/trailing empty lines inside a block
            while lines and not lines[0].strip():
                lines.pop(0)
            while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
                lines.pop()
            if not lines:
                continue

            time_line_idx = -1
            idx = fallback_idx
            if len(lines) >= 2 and lines[0].strip().isdigit() and _SRT_TIME_LINE_RE.match(lines[1]):
                idx = int(lines[0].strip())
                time_line_idx = 1
            elif _SRT_TIME_LINE_RE.match(lines[0]):
                time_line_idx = 0

            if time_line_idx < 0:
                continue

            m = _SRT_TIME_LINE_RE.match(lines[time_line_idx])
            if not m:
                continue
            start = extract_timecode_token(m.group(1))
            end = extract_timecode_token(m.group(2))
            if parse_timecode_ms(start) is None or parse_timecode_ms(end) is None:
                continue

            raw_text = '\n'.join(lines[time_line_idx + 1:])
            clean_text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', raw_text)

            event = SubtitleEvent(
                id=idx,
                start=start,
                end=end,
                original_text=raw_text,
                text=clean_text,
                format_type=SubtitleFormat.SRT
            )
            doc.events.append(event)
            fallback_idx = max(fallback_idx + 1, idx + 1)
        return doc
```

```python
from .base import SubtitleParser

_VTT_TIME_LINE_RE = re.compile(r'^\s*(\S+?)\s*-->\s*([^\s]+)(?:\s+(.*))?$')
_VTT_SKIP_HEADERS = ("WEBVTT", "STYLE", "REGION")


class VTTParser(SubtitleParser):
    def parse_text(self, content: str) -> SubtitleDocument:
        doc = SubtitleDocument(format=SubtitleFormat.VTT)
        normalized = (content or "").replace('\ufeff', '').replace('\r\n', '\n').replace('\r', '\n').strip()
        if not normalized:
            return doc

        blocks = re.split(r'\n[ \t]*\n+', normalized)
        idx = 1

        for block in blocks:
            lines = [ln.rstrip('\r') for ln in block.split('\n')]
            while lines and not lines[0].strip():
                lines.pop(0)
            while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
                lines.pop()
            if not lines:
                continue

            head = lines[0].strip()
            if head == "NOTE" or head.startswith(("NOTE ", "NOTE\t")):
                continue
            if any(head == h or head.startswith((f"{h} ", f"{h}\t", f"{h}-", f"{h}:")) for h in _VTT_SKIP_HEADERS):
                continue

            time_line_idx = -1
            for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
                if _VTT_TIME_LINE_RE.match(ln):
                    time_line_idx = i
                    break

            if time_line_idx < 0:
                continue

            m = _VTT_TIME_LINE_RE.match(lines[time_line_idx])
            if not m:
                continue
            start = extract_timecode_token(m.group(1))
            end = extract_timecode_token(m.group(2))
            if parse_timecode_ms(start) is None or parse_timecode_ms(end) is None:
                continue

            text_lines = lines[time_line_idx + 1:]
            text = '\n'.join(text_lines)
            clean_text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', text)
            doc.events.append(SubtitleEvent(
                id=idx,
                start=start,
                end=end,
                original_text=text,
                text=clean_text,
                format_type=SubtitleFormat.VTT
            ))
            idx += 1
        return doc
```

```python
import re
from typing import Optional

# Matches either H+:MM:SS([.,]frac)? OR MM:SS[.,]frac (WebVTT without hours)
_STRICT_HMS_RE = re.compile(r"^(\d+):(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?:[.,](\d+))?$")
_STRICT_MS_RE = re.compile(r"^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})[.,](\d+)$")

# Matches leading timecode prefix inside cue lines (may be followed by cue settings)
_TOKEN_HMS_RE = re.compile(r"^(\d+:\d{1,2}:\d{1,2}(?:[.,]\d+)?)")
_TOKEN_MS_RE = re.compile(r"^(\d{1,2}:\d{1,2}[.,]\d+)")


def parse_timecode_ms(time_str: str) -> Optional[int]:
    """
    Strictly parses subtitle timecodes into integer milliseconds.

    Supported formats:
    - ASS / SSA: H:MM:SS.cc (e.g. '0:01:23.45')
    - SRT:       HH:MM:SS,mmm (or .mmm, with 1 to N fractional digits)
    - WebVTT:    HH:MM:SS.mmm or MM:SS.mmm (without hours)
    - Whole seconds: HH:MM:SS

    Returns None if the string is invalid, negative, or has out-of-range
    minutes (>= 60) or seconds (>= 60).
    """
    if not time_str or not isinstance(time_str, str):
        return None
    s = time_str.strip()
    if not s or s.startswith("-"):
        return None

    m_hms = _STRICT_HMS_RE.match(s)
    if m_hms:
        h_s, m_s, sec_s, frac_s = m_hms.groups()
        h = int(h_s)
        m = int(m_s)
        sec = int(sec_s)
    else:
        m_ms = _STRICT_MS_RE.match(s)
        if not m_ms:
            return None
        m_s, sec_s, frac_s = m_ms.groups()
        h = 0
        m = int(m_s)
        sec = int(sec_s)

    if m >= 60 or sec >= 60:
        return None

    frac_ms = 0
    if frac_s:
        # Handle arbitrary precision fractional digits cleanly (1 to N digits)
        # using exact integer arithmetic with half-up millisecond rounding.
        denom = 10 ** len(frac_s)
        frac_ms = (int(frac_s) * 1000 + denom // 2) // denom

    return (h * 3600 + m * 60 + sec) * 1000 + frac_ms


def parse_timecode_ms_safe(time_str: str, default: int = 0) -> int:
    """Parses a timecode to milliseconds, returning `default` if invalid."""
    val = parse_timecode_ms(time_str)
    return val if val is not None else default


def is_valid_timecode(time_str: str) -> bool:
    """Returns True if `time_str` is a valid subtitle timecode."""
    return parse_timecode_ms(time_str) is not None


def extract_timecode_token(raw_token: str) -> str:
    """
    Extracts the leading timecode substring from a cue field that may have
    trailing SRT coordinates (X1:...) or WebVTT cue settings (align:start line:90%).
    """
    if not raw_token:
        return ""
    s = raw_token.strip().split()[0]
    m = _TOKEN_HMS_RE.match(s) or _TOKEN_MS_RE.match(s)
    return m.group(1) if m else s


def format_ass_time(ms: int) -> str:
    """Formats milliseconds to strict ASS timestamp: H:MM:SS.cc (rounded centiseconds)."""
    ms = max(0, int(ms))
    total_cs = (ms + 5) // 10
    cs = total_cs % 100
    total_sec = total_cs // 100
    h = total_sec // 3600
    m = (total_sec % 3600) // 60
    s = total_sec % 60
    return f"{h}:{m:02d}:{s:02d}.{cs:02d}"


def format_srt_time(ms: int) -> str:
    """Formats milliseconds to strict SRT timestamp: HH:MM:SS,mmm."""
    ms = max(0, int(ms))
    rem_ms = ms % 1000
    total_sec = ms // 1000
    h = total_sec // 3600
    m = (total_sec % 3600) // 60
    s = total_sec % 60
    return f"{h:02d}:{m:02d}:{s:02d},{rem_ms:03d}"


def format_vtt_time(ms: int) -> str:
    """Formats milliseconds to strict WebVTT timestamp: HH:MM:SS.mmm."""
    ms = max(0, int(ms))
    rem_ms = ms % 1000
    total_sec = ms // 1000
    h = total_sec // 3600
    m = (total_sec % 3600) // 60
    s = total_sec % 60
    return f"{h:02d}:{m:02d}:{s:02d}.{rem_ms:03d}"


def detect_timecode_style(template_str: str, fallback_fmt: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    """Detects whether a template timecode is 'srt', 'vtt', or 'ass'."""
    t = (template_str or "").strip()
    fb = (fallback_fmt or "").strip().lower()
    if "," in t:
        return "srt"
    # SubtitleEvent initializes unpopulated times to '00:00:00.00'; defer to explicit container fallback format
    if t == "00:00:00.00" and fb in ("srt", "vtt", "ass"):
        return fb
    if "." in t:
        # VTT uses HH:MM:SS.mmm (3+ fractional digits) or MM:SS.mmm; ASS uses .cc (1-2 digits)
        if re.search(r"\.\d{3,}$", t) or _STRICT_MS_RE.match(t):
            return "vtt"
        return "ass"
    if fb in ("srt", "vtt", "ass"):
        return fb
    return "ass"


def format_timecode(
    ms: int,
    template_str: str = "",
    fmt: Optional[str] = None,
    force_fmt: bool = False,
) -> str:
    """
    Formats milliseconds while preserving the timecode precision/style of `template_str`
    when available, falling back to `fmt` ('srt', 'vtt', 'ass').
    Set `force_fmt=True` to unconditionally convert to `fmt`.
    """
    fmt_clean = (fmt or "").strip().lower()
    if force_fmt and fmt_clean in ("srt", "vtt", "ass"):
        target = fmt_clean
    else:
        target = detect_timecode_style(template_str, fallback_fmt=fmt_clean)

    if target == "srt":
        return format_srt_time(ms)
    elif target == "vtt":
        return format_vtt_time(ms)
    return format_ass_time(ms)


def normalize_timecode(
    time_str: str,
    template_str: str = "",
    fmt: Optional[str] = None,
    force_fmt: bool = False,
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Validates and normalizes a timecode string while preserving style from `template_str`
    (or `time_str` itself if `template_str` is empty), or returns None if invalid.
    """
    ms = parse_timecode_ms(time_str)
    if ms is None:
        return None
    has_real_template = bool(template_str and template_str != "00:00:00.00" and ("," in template_str or "." in template_str))
    if has_real_template:
        ref = template_str
    elif fmt:
        ref = ""
    else:
        ref = time_str
    return format_timecode(ms, template_str=ref, fmt=fmt, force_fmt=force_fmt)
```

```python
import math
import re
import subprocess
from typing import List, Optional, Tuple

from app.models.subtitle import SubtitleDocument, SubtitleEvent
from app.subtitle.timecode import format_timecode, parse_timecode_ms


class SubtitleTimingOptimizer:
    """
    Deterministic timing synchronization & Arabic readability optimizer.
    - Extends end_time within available gaps when Arabic text exceeds comfortable
      reading speed (CPS), strictly preserving start_time and inter-cue gaps.
    - Probes initial speech onset via FFmpeg silencedetect to detect fixed audio-subtitle offsets.
    """

    @staticmethod
    def _clean_readable_text(text: str) -> str:
        if not text:
            return ""
        cleaned = re.sub(r"\{[^{}]*\}", "", text)
        cleaned = cleaned.replace(r"\N", " ").replace(r"\n", " ").replace("\n", " ")
        cleaned = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", cleaned).strip()
        return cleaned

    @classmethod
    def optimize_arabic_cps(
        cls,
        document: SubtitleDocument,
        max_cps: float = 18.0,
        min_duration_ms: int = 1000,
        min_gap_ms: int = 80,
        max_extend_ms: int = 1200,
    ) -> int:
        """
        Extends end_time (lead-out) for dialogue cues whose reading speed exceeds
        `max_cps` characters/second or duration is below `min_duration_ms`.
        Guarantees:
        - NEVER shifts start_time.
        - NEVER shortens any subtitle duration.
        - NEVER creates overlaps or violates `min_gap_ms` before the next non-overlapping cue.
        - Skips comments, visual effects, and zero-placeholder mock timestamps (0 -> 0).
        """
        if not document or not document.events or max_cps <= 0:
            return 0

        fmt = getattr(getattr(document, "format", None), "value", None)
        timed_items: List[Tuple[int, int, SubtitleEvent]] = []
        for ev in document.events:
            if getattr(ev, "is_comment", False):
                continue
            if hasattr(ev, "is_visual_effect") and ev.is_visual_effect():
                continue
            s_ms = parse_timecode_ms(ev.start_time)
            e_ms = parse_timecode_ms(ev.end_time)
            if s_ms is None or e_ms is None:
                continue
            if s_ms == 0 and e_ms == 0:
                continue
            if e_ms <= s_ms:
                continue
            timed_items.append((s_ms, e_ms, ev))

        if not timed_items:
            return 0

        # Sort chronologically by start time to determine collision-free forward headroom
        timed_items.sort(key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1]))
        extended_count = 0

        for idx, (s_ms, e_ms, ev) in enumerate(timed_items):
            raw_txt = ev.translated_text or ev.original_text or ""
            clean_txt = cls._clean_readable_text(raw_txt)
            if not clean_txt:
                continue

            cur_dur = e_ms - s_ms
            req_dur = max(
                min_duration_ms,
                int(math.ceil((len(clean_txt) / float(max_cps)) * 1000.0)),
            )
            if req_dur <= cur_dur:
                continue

            # Only extend into genuine non-overlapping successor gap
            next_start_ms: Optional[int] = None
            for j in range(idx + 1, len(timed_items)):
                cand_start = timed_items[j][0]
                if cand_start >= e_ms:
                    next_start_ms = cand_start
                    break

            target_end = s_ms + min(req_dur, cur_dur + max(0, max_extend_ms))
            if next_start_ms is not None:
                max_safe_end = next_start_ms - max(0, min_gap_ms)
                if max_safe_end <= e_ms:
                    continue
                target_end = min(target_end, max_safe_end)

            if target_end > e_ms:
                ev.end_time = format_timecode(target_end, template_str=ev.end_time, fmt=fmt)
                setattr(ev, "_cached_cps", None)
                extended_count += 1

        return extended_count

    @staticmethod
    def detect_audio_speech_offset_ms(
        video_path: str,
        subtitle_events: List[SubtitleEvent],
        probe_seconds: int = 90,
        noise_db: str = "-35dB",
        min_silence_dur: float = 0.4,
    ) -> Optional[int]:
        """
        Inspects the first `probe_seconds` of video audio using FFmpeg silencedetect
        and compares initial audio onset (`silence_end`) against the earliest spoken
        subtitle cue start_ms.
        Returns suggested shift in milliseconds (audio_onset_ms - first_cue_ms), or None.
        """
        if not video_path or not subtitle_events:
            return None

        first_cue_ms: Optional[int] = None
        for ev in subtitle_events:
            if getattr(ev, "is_comment", False):
                continue
            if hasattr(ev, "is_visual_effect") and ev.is_visual_effect():
                continue
            s_ms = parse_timecode_ms(ev.start_time)
            e_ms = parse_timecode_ms(ev.end_time)
            if s_ms is None or e_ms is None or e_ms <= s_ms or (s_ms == 0 and e_ms == 0):
                continue
            if first_cue_ms is None or s_ms < first_cue_ms:
                first_cue_ms = s_ms

        if first_cue_ms is None:
            return None

        from app.subtitle.video_extractor import VideoSubtitleExtractor

        ffmpeg_bin = VideoSubtitleExtractor.get_ffmpeg_bin()
        cmd = [
            ffmpeg_bin,
            "-hide_banner",
            "-nostats",
            "-ss", "0",
            "-t", str(max(10, int(probe_seconds))),
            "-i", video_path,
            "-vn",
            "-af", f"silencedetect=noise={noise_db}:d={min_silence_dur}",
            "-f", "null",
            "-",
        ]
        try:
            res = subprocess.run(
                cmd,
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                startupinfo=VideoSubtitleExtractor._get_startupinfo(),
                creationflags=VideoSubtitleExtractor._get_creationflags(),
                text=True,
                encoding="utf-8",
                errors="ignore",
                timeout=30,
            )
            stderr = getattr(res, "stderr", "") or ""
            if not isinstance(stderr, str) or not stderr:
                return None

            m_start = re.search(r"silence_start:\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)", stderr)
            m_end = re.search(r"silence_end:\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)", stderr)
            if not m_start or not m_end:
                return None

            silence_start_s = float(m_start.group(1))
            silence_end_s = float(m_end.group(1))
            # Only trust leading silence beginning right near start of stream
            if silence_start_s > 0.25 or silence_end_s <= 0.0:
                return None

            audio_onset_ms = int(round(silence_end_s * 1000))
            delta_ms = audio_onset_ms - first_cue_ms
            if abs(delta_ms) > 15000:
                return None
            return delta_ms
        except Exception:
            return None
```

```python
class SubtitleStreamInfo(BaseModel):
    index: int                  # Relative index among subtitle streams (0, 1, ...)
    global_index: int           # Global stream index in ffmpeg (e.g. 2, 3)

    is_image_based: bool = False
```
