import re
from typing import Dict, List, Optional


class ResponseParser:
    """Parses and cleans the LLM response to extract translations, stripping all prompt echoes and metadata."""

    # Common prefix noise to strip
    PREFIX_CLEANER = re.compile(
        r"^(?:(?:Original|Current Arabic|Improved Arabic|Improved|Corrected|Arabic|Revision|Refined|Result|Translation|Translated|Translated text|Target|Draft|Translator|"
        r"المنظر العربي المترجم|المنظر العربي|المترجم|المترجمة|المدقق|المراجع|تقرير التعديلات|تقرير التحسين|تقرير المراجعة|التعديلات|التصحيحات|التصحيح|"
        r"النص العربي المصقول النهائي مباشرة|النص العربي المصقول النهائي|النص المصقول النهائي|المصقول النهائي مباشرة|المصقول النهائي|النص المصقول|السطر المصقول|"
        r"الترجمة المحسنة|الترجمة المقترحة|الترجمة النهائية|الترجمة العربية|الترجمة|المسودة|النتيجة|المصححة|الصياغة الجديدة|الصياغة الفصيحة|الأصل|النص الأصلي|"
        r"النص العربي|التحسين|التعديل|ترجمة|إليك الترجمة|الترجمة هي|نص الترجمة)[\s:\-–—]*)+",
        re.IGNORECASE
    )

    @classmethod
    def clean_text_item(cls, text: str) -> str:
        """Cleans prompt echoes, formatting tokens, prefixes, and quotation marks from a translation string."""
        if not text:
            return ""

        # Remove zero-width & invisible unicode characters (preserve \u200f RLM BiDi marks)
        text = re.sub(r'[\u200b\u200c\u200d\u200e\ufeff\u202a-\u202e\u2066-\u2069]', '', text)

        # If text contains a pipe '|' separating original and translation (prompt leak echo)
        if "|" in text:
            parts = text.split("|")
            text = parts[-1].strip()

        # Remove leading/trailing formatting like **, ``, --
        text = re.sub(r"^[\*\:\s\-–—\.]+", "", text).strip()
        text = re.sub(r"\*+$", "", text).strip()

        # Check for inline markdown like **Translated Text**
        if text.startswith("**") and text.endswith("**"):
            text = text[2:-2].strip()

        if text.startswith("`") and text.endswith("`"):
            text = text.strip("`").strip()

        # Iteratively strip out common conversational and prompt prefixes inside the translation
        for _ in range(3):
            prev = text
            text = cls.PREFIX_CLEANER.sub("", text).strip()
            text = re.sub(r"^[\*\:\s\-–—\.]+", "", text).strip()
            if text == prev:
                break

        # Strip quotes if wrapped or orphan outer quote
        for q_open, q_close in (('"', '"'), ("'", "'"), ('“', '”'), ('«', '»'), ('"', '”'), ('“', '"')):
            if text.startswith(q_open) and text.endswith(q_close) and len(text) >= 2:
                text = text[len(q_open):-len(q_close)].strip()
                break
        else:
            if text.startswith(('"', "'", "“", "«")):
                text = text[1:].strip()
            if text.endswith(('"', "'", "”", "»")):
                text = text[:-1].strip()

        # Strip empty or stray brackets at beginning like [] or [ ] (common in ALLaM outputs)
        text = re.sub(r"^[\[\(]\s*[\]\)]\s*[:\-\–\—\.]*", "", text).strip()

        # Strip trailing notes or context leaks e.g. (سياق الحوار اللاحق) ... or \n### ...
        text = re.sub(r"\n\s*(?:###|\(سياق|\(Context|ملاحظة:|Note:).*$", "", text, flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE).strip()
        text = re.sub(r"\s*\(سياق[^\)]*\)$", "", text).strip()
        text = re.sub(r"\s*\(Context[^\)]*\)$", "", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip()

        if text.startswith("`") and text.endswith("`"):
            text = text.strip("`").strip()
        elif text.startswith("`") and text.count("`") % 2 == 1:
            text = text[1:].strip()
        elif text.endswith("`") and text.count("`") % 2 == 1:
            text = text[:-1].strip()

        # Strip out translation notes aggressively
        text = re.sub(r"[\(\[]?(Note|ملاحظة|ملاحظه|Translation Note)[\s:]+.*$", "", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip()
        text = re.sub(r"\s*[-|–|—]\s*(Note|ملاحظة|ملاحظه)[\s:]+.*$", "", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip()

        # Strip commentary, gender, or explanation notes inside parentheses (e.g. (المخاطب فتاة), (المتحدث غاضب), (تم التصحيح))
        text = re.sub(
            r"\s*[\(\[«](?:المخاطب|المتحدث|المتكلم|ملاحظة|ملاحظه|تعديل|تصحيح|توضيح|شرح|حذف|إضافة|مذكر|مؤنث|أنثى|فتاة|صبي|رجل|note|tone|speaker|context)[\s:،,-][^\)\]»]*[\)\]»]",
            "",
            text,
            flags=re.IGNORECASE
        ).strip()
        text = re.sub(
            r"\s*[\(\[](?:المخاطب\s+(?:فتاة|ذكر|أنثى|مذكر|مؤنث)|المتحدث\s+(?:فتاة|ذكر|أنثى|مذكر|مؤنث)|تم\s+التصحيح|تم\s+التعديل|بصوت\s+عالي|بهمس)[\)\]]\s*$",
            "",
            text,
            flags=re.IGNORECASE
        ).strip()

        return text.strip()

    def parse_response(self, raw_response: str, expected_ids: List[int]) -> Dict[int, str]:
        """Extract translations mapped by ID from raw LLM output, supporting inline and multiline ID blocks."""
        if not raw_response:
            return {}

        # 1. Strip think blocks (both closed <think>...</think> and unclosed <think>...)
        cleaned = re.sub(r"<think>.*?</think>", "", raw_response, flags=re.DOTALL)
        if "<think>" in cleaned:
            cleaned = re.sub(r"<think>.*$", "", cleaned, flags=re.DOTALL)
        if "</think>" in cleaned:
            cleaned = cleaned.split("</think>")[-1]

        # 2. Strip markdown code fences
        cleaned = re.sub(r"^```[a-zA-Z]*\n", "", cleaned, flags=re.MULTILINE)
        cleaned = re.sub(r"\n```$", "", cleaned, flags=re.MULTILINE)

        lines = [line.strip() for line in cleaned.split("\n") if line.strip()]

        raw_parsed: List[tuple[int, str]] = []

        # Pattern 1: [1] Text or **[1]**: Text or - [1] Text or [ 001 ] Text or (1) Text
        pat_bracket = re.compile(r"^[^\w\[\(]*[\[\(]\s*(\d+)\s*[\]\)]\s*[:\-\–\—\.]*\s*(.*)$")
        # Pattern 1b: [] Text or [ ] Text (Empty brackets without digits, e.g. from ALLaM SFT)
        pat_empty_bracket = re.compile(r"^[^\w\[\(]*[\[\(]\s*[\]\)]\s*[:\-\–\—\.]*\s*(.*)$")
        # Pattern 2: 1. Text or 1: Text or 1 - Text or **1:** Text
        pat_dot = re.compile(r"^[^\w]*(\d+)[\.\:\-][\s:\-\–\—\.]*\s*(.*)$")

        i = 0
        n_expected = len(expected_ids)
        expected_set = set(expected_ids)
        expected_min = min(expected_ids) if expected_ids else 0

        IGNORE_TRIGGERS = (
            "here is", "here are", "sure,", "sure!", "translation:", "الترجمة التالية:",
            "###", "---", "(سياق)", "(context)", "(سياق الحوار", "ملاحظة:", "note:"
        )

        while i < len(lines):
            line = lines[i]
            line_lower = line.lower()
            if any(trig in line_lower for trig in IGNORE_TRIGGERS):
                i += 1
                continue

            # Ignore raw timestamp lines (e.g. '12:05:00 Scene Intro') before pat_dot matching
            if re.match(r"^\d{1,2}:\d{2}(?::\d{2})?(?:[.,]\d+)?\b", line):
                i += 1
                continue

            match = pat_bracket.match(line) or pat_dot.match(line)
            empty_match = pat_empty_bracket.match(line) if not match else None

            if match:
                parsed_num = int(match.group(1))
                inline_text = self.clean_text_item(match.group(2))

                # Avoid false positives where pat_dot matched arbitrary numbers
                is_valid_id = (
                    parsed_num in expected_set or
                    (1 <= parsed_num <= n_expected) or
                    (parsed_num == 0 and n_expected > 0) or
                    (n_expected > 1 and expected_min <= parsed_num <= expected_min + n_expected - 1)
                )

                if not is_valid_id:
                    i += 1
                    continue

                if inline_text:
                    raw_parsed.append((parsed_num, inline_text))
                    i += 1
                    continue

                # Text is on the following line(s) (multiline ID block format)
                i += 1
                block_lines = []
                while i < len(lines):
                    next_line = lines[i]
                    if pat_bracket.match(next_line) or pat_dot.match(next_line) or pat_empty_bracket.match(next_line):
                        break
                    block_lines.append(next_line)
                    i += 1

                chosen = ""
                for bl in block_lines:
                    if any(k in bl for k in ("الترجمة المحسنة", "الترجمة:", "الصياغة", "Improved:", "Translation:")):
                        chosen = self.clean_text_item(bl)
                        if chosen:
                            break
                if not chosen:
                    for bl in reversed(block_lines):
                        if not any(k in bl for k in ("النص الأصلي", "الترجمة الحالية", "Original:", "Current:")):
                            cand = self.clean_text_item(bl)
                            if cand:
                                chosen = cand
                                break
                if chosen:
                    raw_parsed.append((parsed_num, chosen))
            elif empty_match:
                inline_text = self.clean_text_item(empty_match.group(1))
                if inline_text:
                    raw_parsed.append((-1, inline_text))
                i += 1
            else:
                i += 1

        translations: Dict[int, str] = {}

        # Strategy 1 (Preflight Guard): Detect sequential renumbering slippage before partial Direct ID matching
        # Example: expected=[10, 12, 14, 18], LLM renumbers sequentially as [10, 11, 12, 13] or [1, 2, 3, 4]
        direct_matches = {pid: text for pid, text in raw_parsed if pid in expected_set}
        numbered_entries = [(pid, text) for pid, text in raw_parsed if pid != -1 and text]
        numbered_pids = [pid for pid, _ in numbered_entries]
        if (
            len(numbered_pids) >= 2
            and len(direct_matches) < len(expected_ids)
            and numbered_pids != expected_ids[:len(numbered_pids)]
            and numbered_pids == list(range(numbered_pids[0], numbered_pids[0] + len(numbered_pids)))
            and numbered_pids[0] in (0, 1, expected_ids[0])
        ):
            remapped = {}
            for idx in range(min(len(numbered_entries), len(expected_ids))):
                remapped[expected_ids[idx]] = numbered_entries[idx][1]
            if len(remapped) >= len(direct_matches):
                return remapped

        # Strategy 1: Direct ID Match
        if len(direct_matches) == len(expected_ids) or (len(expected_ids) > 1 and len(direct_matches) >= len(expected_ids) // 2):
            translations.update(direct_matches)
            # Fill remaining unmatched expected slots with unnumbered (-1) lines ONLY if counts match exactly
            unmatched_expected = [eid for eid in expected_ids if eid not in translations]
            unmatched_raw = [text for pid, text in raw_parsed if pid == -1 and text]
            if unmatched_expected and unmatched_raw and len(unmatched_expected) == len(unmatched_raw):
                for idx, text in enumerate(unmatched_raw):
                    translations[unmatched_expected[idx]] = text
            return translations

        # Strategy 2: Relative Renumbering Match (1..N or 0..N-1)
        # When LLMs renumber items sequentially from 1 (or 0) instead of retaining original IDs (e.g. [9..16] -> [1..8])
        if len(raw_parsed) > 0 and len(direct_matches) < len(expected_ids):
            valid_pids = [pid for pid, _ in raw_parsed if pid != -1]
            if valid_pids:
                is_1_based = all(1 <= pid <= len(expected_ids) for pid in valid_pids)
                is_0_based = all(0 <= pid < len(expected_ids) for pid in valid_pids)

                if is_1_based and len(expected_set.intersection(valid_pids)) < len(valid_pids):
                    remapped = {}
                    for pid, text in raw_parsed:
                        if 1 <= pid <= len(expected_ids):
                            target_id = expected_ids[pid - 1]
                            remapped[target_id] = text
                    if len(remapped) >= len(direct_matches):
                        return remapped

                elif is_0_based and len(expected_set.intersection(valid_pids)) < len(valid_pids):
                    remapped = {}
                    for pid, text in raw_parsed:
                        if 0 <= pid < len(expected_ids):
                            target_id = expected_ids[pid]
                            remapped[target_id] = text
                    if len(remapped) >= len(direct_matches):
                        return remapped

        # Strategy 3: Sequential / Positional Mapping (Handles [ ] and un-numbered lines from ALLaM and local LLMs)
        if len(raw_parsed) > 0:
            # If no direct matches were found (e.g. all lines used [ ] or []), map sequentially
            if len(direct_matches) == 0:
                remapped = {}
                limit = min(len(expected_ids), len(raw_parsed))
                for idx in range(limit):
                    remapped[expected_ids[idx]] = raw_parsed[idx][1]
                return remapped

        # Return whatever direct matches we found
        if direct_matches:
            return direct_matches

        # Strategy 4: Fallback to non-empty clean lines matching expected_ids
        clean_lines = [
            l for l in lines 
            if not any(trig in l.lower() for trig in IGNORE_TRIGGERS)
        ]
        if len(clean_lines) > 0:
            limit = min(len(expected_ids), len(clean_lines))
            for idx in range(limit):
                fallback_text = self.clean_text_item(clean_lines[idx])
                translations[expected_ids[idx]] = fallback_text

        return translations

class RetryStrategy:
    """Manages retry logic for translation batches."""
    
    def __init__(self, max_attempts: int = 5):
        self.max_attempts = max_attempts
        
    def should_retry(self, attempt: int) -> bool:
        """Determine if another attempt should be made."""
        return attempt < self.max_attempts
        
    def get_instructions_for_attempt(self, attempt: int, missing_ids: list = None, is_allam: bool = False) -> str:
        """Get specific instructions based on attempt number."""
        if attempt == 1:
            return ""
            
        if is_allam:
            base = "تنبيه هام للمحاولة السابقة: اكتب رقم كل سطر بدقة داخل القوسين مثل [128]، ممنوع منعاً باتاً ترك القوسين فارغين هكذا [ ] وممنوع حذف الأرقام! "
            if missing_ids:
                base += f"الأسطر ذات الأرقام التالية فُقدت ويجب كتابة أرقامها وترجمتها سطراً بسطر: {missing_ids}."
            else:
                base += "تأكد من ترجمة كل سطر وكتابة رقمه داخل القوسين بدقة دون تخطي."
            return base

        base = "تنبيه للمحاولة السابقة: التزم بالصيغة الإلزامية [الرقم] النص المترجم مباشرة بدون أي كلام تمهيدي أو ماركداون وبدون ترك القوسين فارغين هكذا [ ]. "
        
        if missing_ids:
            base += f"الأسطر ذات المعرفات التالية فُقدت في الرد السابق ويجب ترجمتها وتضمينها بأرقامها: {missing_ids}."
        else:
            base += "تأكد من ترجمة كل سطر بنفس رقمه بدقة دون دمج أو تخطي."
            
        return base

````python
import re
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
from app.models.subtitle import SubtitleEvent
from app.character.resolver import CharacterResolver


class GenderValidator:
    def validate(self, parsed_translations: Dict[int, str], expected_events: List[SubtitleEvent], characters: List) -> List[str]:
        issues = []
        if not characters:
            return issues

        resolver = CharacterResolver(characters)
        for event in expected_events:
            text = parsed_translations.get(event.id, "")
            if not text or not event.speaker:
                continue

            speaker = event.speaker.strip()
            match = resolver.resolve_speaker(speaker)
            if match and match.profile:
                profile = match.profile
                gender_info = getattr(profile, "gender_info", None)
                gender = str(getattr(gender_info, "gender", "") or getattr(profile, "gender", "")).upper()

                if "MALE" in gender and "FEMALE" not in gender:
                    # Match Arabic feminine 2nd-person Kasra suffixes without \b after nonspacing diacritic \u0650
                    if re.search(
                        r"(?:^|[\s\"\'\(\[«\-])(?:أنتِ|[\u0621-\u064A]{2,}(?:تِ|كِ))(?=$|\s|[!؟\.\،\؛:\"\'\)\]»])",
                        text,
                    ):
                        issues.append(
                            f"Gender Warning (ID {event.id}): Speaker {speaker} is MALE but text contains feminine 2nd-person form."
                        )
        return issues

class TerminologyValidator:
    def validate(self, parsed_translations: Dict[int, str], expected_events: List[SubtitleEvent], glossary: List) -> List[str]:
        issues = []
        if not glossary:
            return issues
            
        for event in expected_events:
            text = parsed_translations.get(event.id, "")
            orig = event.get_clean_text()
            if not text or not orig:
                continue
                
            for term in glossary:
                source = getattr(term, "source_term", "")
                target = getattr(term, "target_term", "")
                if source and target and source.lower() in orig.lower():
                    if target not in text:
                        issues.append(f"Terminology Warning (ID {event.id}): Expected '{target}' for '{source}' in translation.")
        return issues

class PipelineValidator:
    """Validates the output of a translation batch."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.gender_val = GenderValidator()
        self.term_val = TerminologyValidator()
    
    def validate_batch_output(self, parsed_translations: Dict[int, str], expected_events: List[SubtitleEvent], characters: List = None, glossary: List = None) -> Tuple[bool, List[str]]:
        """
        Validate parsed translations against expected events.
        Returns (is_valid, list_of_blocking_issues)
        """
        issues = []
        expected_ids = {e.id for e in expected_events}
        parsed_ids = set(parsed_translations.keys())
        
        # 1. Output Structure Validation
        missing_ids = expected_ids - parsed_ids
        if missing_ids:
            issues.append(f"Missing translations for IDs: {sorted(missing_ids)}")
            
        extra_ids = parsed_ids - expected_ids
        if extra_ids:
            issues.append(f"Extra unexpected translations for IDs: {sorted(extra_ids)}")
            
        for event_id in expected_ids.intersection(parsed_ids):
            text = parsed_translations[event_id]
            if not text or not text.strip():
                issues.append(f"Empty translation for ID: {event_id}")
            elif "```" in text or text.startswith("Here is"):
                issues.append(f"Suspicious markdown or conversational residue for ID: {event_id}")
            elif re.search(r"[\u4e00-\u9fff\u3040-\u30ff\uac00-\ud7af]", text):
                issues.append(f"Hallucination (ID {event_id}): Text contains Chinese/Asian characters: '{text[:30]}'")
            elif not re.search(r"[\u0600-\u06FF]", text) and len(text.strip()) > 3:
                issues.append(f"Untranslated or Non-Arabic Output (ID {event_id}): '{text[:30]}'")
                
        # 2. Gender Validation
        if characters:
            issues.extend(self.gender_val.validate(parsed_translations, expected_events, characters))
            
        # 3. Terminology Validation
        if glossary:
            issues.extend(self.term_val.validate(parsed_translations, expected_events, glossary))
                
        blocking_issues = [
            i for i in issues 
            if any(k in i for k in ("Missing", "Empty", "Suspicious", "Hallucination", "Untranslated", "Non-Arabic"))
        ]
        is_valid = len(blocking_issues) == 0
        
        warnings = [i for i in issues if i not in blocking_issues]
        if warnings:
            from app.ui.bus import EventBus
            for w in warnings:
                EventBus.instance().log_message.emit(w)
                
        return is_valid, blocking_issues

# Alias for testing/backward compatibility
TranslationValidator = PipelineValidator
````

```python
import sys
import os
import asyncio
import traceback
import ctypes
import qasync
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from PySide6.QtGui import QIcon
from app.ui.windows.main_window import MainWindow
from app.ui.theme import DARK_THEME_QSS
from app.ui.bus import EventBus
from app.core.logging import get_logger, setup_root_logging
from app.core.resources import resource_path

logger = get_logger("app")

def run_app():
    setup_root_logging()
    
    # Set Windows AppUserModelID for proper taskbar icon and grouping
    if os.name == 'nt':
        try:
            ctypes.windll.shell32.SetCurrentProcessExplicitAppUserModelID("com.subnova.studio")
        except Exception:
            pass

    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    app.setApplicationName("SubNova Studio")
    app.setApplicationDisplayName("SubNova Studio — استوديو سوب نوفا")
    app.setStyleSheet(DARK_THEME_QSS)

    # Set application icon with dynamic asset resolution
    icon_path = resource_path(os.path.join("app", "resources", "icons", "subnova_icon.ico"))
    if os.path.exists(icon_path):
        app.setWindowIcon(QIcon(icon_path))
    
    # Initialize EventBus
    bus = EventBus.instance()
    
    # Set up qasync event loop
    loop = qasync.QEventLoop(app)
    asyncio.set_event_loop(loop)

    # 1. Capture unhandled async background errors and surface them to UI
    def async_exception_handler(current_loop, context):
        exc = context.get("exception")
        msg = context.get("message", "Unhandled async task exception")
        if isinstance(exc, (asyncio.CancelledError, ConnectionRefusedError)):
            return  # Benign task cancellation or offline local server probe
        if exc and "Cannot enter into task" in str(exc):
            return  # Benign loop re-entrance artifact
        if exc:
            err_text = f"[ASYNC ERROR] {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
        else:
            err_text = f"[ASYNC ERROR] {msg}"
        logger.error(err_text)
        bus.log_message.emit(err_text)

    loop.set_exception_handler(async_exception_handler)

    # 2. Capture unhandled synchronous exceptions and surface them to UI & crash.log
    def sys_exception_hook(exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback):
        if issubclass(exc_type, KeyboardInterrupt):
            sys.__excepthook__(exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback)
            return
        full_tb = "".join(traceback.format_exception(exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback))
        err_msg = "".join(traceback.format_exception_only(exc_type, exc_value)).strip()
        logger.critical(f"Unhandled Exception: {err_msg}\n{full_tb}")
        try:
            with open("crash.log", "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                from datetime import datetime
                f.write(f"\n{'='*60}\nUNHANDLED EXCEPTION [{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}]:\n{full_tb}\n{'='*60}\n")
        except Exception:
            pass
        bus.log_message.emit(f"[FATAL ERROR] {err_msg}")

    sys.excepthook = sys_exception_hook
    
    window = MainWindow()
    window.show()
    
    with loop:
        sys.exit(loop.run_forever())

from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, Signal

class EventBus(QObject):
    """Singleton EventBus for global application events."""
    
    _instance = None
    
    file_selected = Signal(list)
    files_cleared = Signal()
    provider_changed = Signal(dict)
    model_selected = Signal(str)
    translation_started = Signal()
    improvement_started = Signal()
    translation_progress = Signal(int, int, str) # current, total, status
    translation_finished = Signal(dict)
    translation_cancelled = Signal()
    character_updated = Signal(dict)
    log_message = Signal(str)
    live_preview_updated = Signal(str, str) # orig, imp
    auto_detect_status = Signal(str, str) # status, color

    @classmethod
    def instance(cls):
        if cls._instance is None:
            cls._instance = EventBus()
        return cls._instance

from typing import List, Optional
from PySide6.QtGui import QUndoCommand

class EditCellCommand(QUndoCommand):
    """Undoable command for editing a single subtitle cell (time, text, speaker)."""
    def __init__(self, model, row: int, col: int, old_val: str, new_val: str, description="تعديل سطر"):
        super().__init__(description)
        self.model = model
        self.row = row
        self.col = col
        self.old_val = old_val
        self.new_val = new_val

    def undo(self):
        self.model.set_cell_value_direct(self.row, self.col, self.old_val)

    def redo(self):
        self.model.set_cell_value_direct(self.row, self.col, self.new_val)

class ShiftTimingsCommand(QUndoCommand):
    """Undoable command for shifting subtitle timestamps with exact snapshot restore."""
    def __init__(self, model, offset_ms: int, row_indices: Optional[List[int]] = None, description="إزاحة التوقيت"):
        super().__init__(description)
        self.model = model
        self.offset_ms = offset_ms
        self.row_indices = list(row_indices) if row_indices is not None else None
        # Capture exact pre-shift timestamps so clamping at 0 never loses original state on Undo
        target_rows = self.row_indices if self.row_indices else range(len(model.events))
        self._snapshot = [
            (r, model.events[r].start_time, model.events[r].end_time)
            for r in target_rows
            if 0 <= r < len(model.events)
        ]

    def undo(self):
        if hasattr(self.model, "restore_timings_snapshot") and self._snapshot:
            self.model.restore_timings_snapshot(self._snapshot)
        else:
            self.model.shift_timings(-self.offset_ms, self.row_indices)

    def redo(self):
        self.model.shift_timings(self.offset_ms, self.row_indices)

from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLineEdit, QPushButton,
    QListWidget, QListWidgetItem, QLabel, QComboBox
)
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
import asyncio
from typing import Optional, List
from app.models.anime import MediaInfo, CharacterProfile

class MediaSearchDialog(QDialog):
    """Dialog for searching movies, TV series, and anime."""
    
    def __init__(self, parent=None, metadata_service=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.metadata_service = metadata_service
        self.selected_media: Optional[MediaInfo] = None
        self.selected_anime: Optional[MediaInfo] = None  # alias
        self.selected_characters: List[CharacterProfile] = []
        
        self.results: List[MediaInfo] = []
        
        self.setWindowTitle("Search Media (Movies, Series & Anime) / بحث عن عمل")
        self.setMinimumSize(680, 520)
        
        self.layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        
        search_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        self.le_search = QLineEdit()
        self.le_search.setPlaceholderText("Enter title (Movie, Series, Anime) / ابحث عن اسم العمل...")
        
        self.cb_filter = QComboBox()
        self.cb_filter.addItems(["All / الكل", "TV Series / مسلسلات", "Movies / أفلام", "Anime / أنمي"])
        self.cb_filter.setFixedWidth(140)
        
        self.btn_search = QPushButton("🔍 Search / بحث")
        search_layout.addWidget(self.le_search)
        search_layout.addWidget(self.cb_filter)
        search_layout.addWidget(self.btn_search)
        self.layout.addLayout(search_layout)
        
        # Content layout
        content_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        
        self.list_results = QListWidget()
        self.list_results.setFixedWidth(300)
        
        details_layout = QVBoxLayout()
        self.lbl_details = QLabel("Select a title to view details / اختر عملاً لعرض تفاصيله.")
        self.lbl_details.setAlignment(Qt.AlignTop | Qt.AlignLeft)
        self.lbl_details.setWordWrap(True)
        details_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_details)
        
        content_layout.addWidget(self.list_results)
        content_layout.addLayout(details_layout)
        
        self.layout.addLayout(content_layout)
        
        self.btn_select = QPushButton("Select Title / اختيار العمل")
        self.btn_select.setEnabled(False)
        self.layout.addWidget(self.btn_select)
        
        self.list_results.itemSelectionChanged.connect(self._on_select)
        self.btn_select.clicked.connect(self._on_accept_clicked)
        self.btn_search.clicked.connect(self._on_search_clicked)
        self.le_search.returnPressed.connect(self._on_search_clicked)
        
    def _on_search_clicked(self):
        title = self.le_search.text().strip()
        if not title or not self.metadata_service:
            return
            
        self.btn_search.setEnabled(False)
        self.list_results.clear()
        self.results = []
        self.lbl_details.setText("Searching across databases...")
        self.list_results.addItem("Searching...")
        
        filter_text = self.cb_filter.currentText()
        if "TV" in filter_text:
            filter_type = "tv"
        elif "Movie" in filter_text:
            filter_type = "movie"
        elif "Anime" in filter_text:
            filter_type = "anime"
        else:
            filter_type = "all"
        
        async def search():
            try:
                items = await self.metadata_service.search_multiple_media(title, filter_type=filter_type)
                self.list_results.clear()
                self.results = items
                if items:
                    for i, a in enumerate(items):
                        tag = "[TV]" if a.media_type == "tv" else ("[Movie]" if a.media_type == "movie" else "[Anime]")
                        year_str = f" ({a.year})" if a.year else ""
                        item = QListWidgetItem(f"{tag} {a.display_title}{year_str}")
                        item.setData(Qt.UserRole, i)
                        self.list_results.addItem(item)
                    self.lbl_details.setText(f"Found {len(items)} results. Select one to see cast.")
                else:
                    self.list_results.addItem("No results found.")
                    self.lbl_details.setText("No results found for this query.")
            except Exception as e:
                self.list_results.clear()
                self.list_results.addItem(f"Error: {e}")
                self.lbl_details.setText("")
            finally:
                self.btn_search.setEnabled(True)
                
        def run_coroutine(coro):
            try:
                loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
                loop.create_task(coro)
            except RuntimeError:
                import threading
                threading.Thread(target=lambda: asyncio.run(coro), daemon=True).start()

        run_coroutine(search())
        
    def _on_select(self):
        items = self.list_results.selectedItems()
        if not items:
            self.btn_select.setEnabled(False)
            return
            
        idx = items[0].data(Qt.UserRole)
        if idx is None or idx >= len(self.results):
            return
            
        media = self.results[idx]
        m_tag = "TV Series" if media.media_type == "tv" else ("Movie" if media.media_type == "movie" else "Anime")
        
        details = f"<h3 style='margin-bottom:4px;'>{media.display_title}</h3>"
        details += f"<b>Type:</b> {m_tag} | <b>Format:</b> {media.format or 'N/A'}<br>"
        if media.year:
            details += f"<b>Year:</b> {media.year}<br>"
        if media.status:
            details += f"<b>Status:</b> {media.status}<br>"
        if media.source_name:
            details += f"<b>Source:</b> {media.source_name}<br>"
        if media.genres:
            details += f"<b>Genres:</b> {', '.join(media.genres)}<br>"
        if media.overview:
            details += f"<br><b>Overview:</b><br><p>{media.overview[:300]}...</p>"
        
        self.lbl_details.setText(details)
        self.btn_select.setEnabled(True)
        
    def _on_accept_clicked(self):
        items = self.list_results.selectedItems()
        if not items:
            return
        idx = items[0].data(Qt.UserRole)
        if idx is None or idx >= len(self.results):
            return
            
        self.selected_media = self.results[idx]
        self.selected_anime = self.selected_media  # alias
        self.btn_select.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_select.setText("Fetching Characters & Cast...")
        
        async def fetch_chars():
            try:
                self.selected_characters = await self.metadata_service.get_characters_for_media(self.selected_media)
                self.accept()
            except Exception as e:
                self.lbl_details.setText(f"Error fetching characters: {e}")
                self.btn_select.setEnabled(True)
                self.btn_select.setText("Select Title / اختيار العمل")
        
        try:
            loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
            loop.create_task(fetch_chars())
        except RuntimeError:
            import threading
            threading.Thread(target=lambda: asyncio.run(fetch_chars()), daemon=True).start()

# Backward compatibility alias
AnimeSearchDialog = MediaSearchDialog

        self.layout.addWidget(self.button_box)
        
        # Populate if initial data provided
        if self.initial_data:
            self.le_canonical.setText(self.initial_data.get("canonical", ""))
            self.le_japanese.setText(self.initial_data.get("japanese", ""))
            self.le_arabic.setText(self.initial_data.get("arabic", ""))
            
            gender_val = str(self.initial_data.get("gender", "")).capitalize()
            idx = self.cb_gender.findText(gender_val)
            if idx >= 0:
                self.cb_gender.setCurrentIndex(idx)
                
            aliases = self.initial_data.get("aliases", [])
            if isinstance(aliases, list):
                self.le_aliases.setText(", ".join(aliases))
            elif isinstance(aliases, str):
                self.le_aliases.setText(aliases)
                
            self.le_style.setText(self.initial_data.get("style", ""))
            self.te_notes.setPlainText(self.initial_data.get("notes", ""))
        
    def save(self):
        data = {
            "row": self.initial_data.get("row"),
            "canonical": self.le_canonical.text().strip(),
            "japanese": self.le_japanese.text().strip(),
            "arabic": self.le_arabic.text().strip(),
            "gender": self.cb_gender.currentText(),
            "aliases": [x.strip() for x in self.le_aliases.text().split(",") if x.strip()],
            "style": self.le_style.text().strip(),
            "notes": self.te_notes.toPlainText().strip()
        }
        EventBus.instance().character_updated.emit(data)
        self.accept()

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QPushButton, QTableWidget, QTableWidgetItem, QCheckBox
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt

class GlossaryEditorDialog(QDialog):
    def __init__(self, parent=None, initial_entries=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle("Glossary Editor")
        self.setMinimumSize(500, 400)
        
        self.layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        
        self.table = QTableWidget(0, 4)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Source Term", "Target Term", "Exact Match", "Case Sensitive"])
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setStretchLastSection(True)
        self.layout.addWidget(self.table)
        
        if initial_entries:
            for entry in initial_entries:
                if " -> " in entry:
                    src, tgt = entry.split(" -> ", 1)
                    self.add_row_with_data(src, tgt)
        
        btn_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        self.btn_add = QPushButton("Add Term")
        self.btn_del = QPushButton("Delete Term")
        self.btn_save = QPushButton("Save")
        
        self.btn_add.clicked.connect(self.add_row)
        self.btn_del.clicked.connect(self.del_row)
        self.btn_save.clicked.connect(self.accept)
        
        btn_layout.addWidget(self.btn_add)
        btn_layout.addWidget(self.btn_del)
        btn_layout.addStretch()
        btn_layout.addWidget(self.btn_save)
        
        self.layout.addLayout(btn_layout)
        
    def add_row(self):
        self.add_row_with_data("", "")

    def add_row_with_data(self, src, tgt):
        row = self.table.rowCount()
        self.table.insertRow(row)
        self.table.setItem(row, 0, QTableWidgetItem(src))
        self.table.setItem(row, 1, QTableWidgetItem(tgt))
        
        cb_exact = QCheckBox()
        cb_exact.setChecked(True)
        self.table.setCellWidget(row, 2, cb_exact)
        
        cb_case = QCheckBox()
        self.table.setCellWidget(row, 3, cb_case)
        
    def del_row(self):
        row = self.table.currentRow()
        if row >= 0:
            self.table.removeRow(row)

    def get_glossary_entries(self):
        entries = []
        for i in range(self.table.rowCount()):
            src = self.table.item(i, 0).text() if self.table.item(i, 0) else ""
            tgt = self.table.item(i, 1).text() if self.table.item(i, 1) else ""
            if src and tgt:
                entries.append(f"{src} -> {tgt}")
        return entries

        self.lbl_detail.setStyleSheet("color: #a1a1aa; font-size: 8.5pt;")
        self.lbl_detail.setWordWrap(True)
        self.lbl_detail.setAlignment(Qt.AlignRight | Qt.AlignVCenter)
        c_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_detail)

        # Indeterminate Progress Bar
        self.progress_bar = QProgressBar()
        self.progress_bar.setRange(0, 0)
        self.progress_bar.setFixedHeight(8)
        self.progress_bar.setTextVisible(False)
        self.progress_bar.setStyleSheet("""

                background-color: #27272a;
                border: none;
                border-radius: 4px;

            QProgressBar::chunk {

                border-radius: 4px;
            }
        """)
        c_layout.addWidget(self.progress_bar)

        # Developer badge
        lbl_brand = QLabel("SubNova Studio | تطوير: حاتم الحربي © 2026")
        lbl_brand.setStyleSheet("color: #52525b; font-size: 7.5pt; font-weight: 500;")
        lbl_brand.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        c_layout.addWidget(lbl_brand)

        layout.addWidget(card)

    def show(self):
        if not getattr(self, 'is_test', False):
            super().show()

    def close(self):
        if not getattr(self, 'is_test', False):
            super().close()

    def set_status(self, title: str, detail: str = ""):
        if getattr(self, 'is_test', False):
            return
        if hasattr(self, 'lbl_title'):
            self.lbl_title.setText(title)
        if detail and hasattr(self, 'lbl_detail'):
            self.lbl_detail.setText(detail)
        QApplication.processEvents()

    def set_determinate(self, current: int, total: int):
        if getattr(self, 'is_test', False):
            return
        if hasattr(self, 'progress_bar'):
            self.progress_bar.setRange(0, total)
            self.progress_bar.setValue(current)
        QApplication.processEvents()

    def set_indeterminate(self):
        if getattr(self, 'is_test', False):
            return
        if hasattr(self, 'progress_bar'):
            self.progress_bar.setRange(0, 0)
        QApplication.processEvents()

        filter_bar.addWidget(QLabel("Filter:"))
        filter_bar.addWidget(self.filter_combo)
        filter_bar.addWidget(self.search_input)
        self.layout.addLayout(filter_bar)
        
        # Table
        self.table = QTableWidget(0, 5)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["ID", "Speaker", "Original / الأصل", "Translation / الترجمة", "Status & Warnings / الحالة"])
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(0, QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(1, QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(2, QHeaderView.Stretch)
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(3, QHeaderView.Stretch)
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(4, QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.DoubleClicked | QAbstractItemView.EditKeyPressed)
        self.layout.addWidget(self.table)
        
        # Buttons
        btn_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        self.btn_revert = QPushButton("Revert to Original / استعادة الأصل للسطر المحدد")
        self.btn_revert.clicked.connect(self._revert_selected)
        
        self.btn_save = QPushButton("💾 Save & Accept / حفظ واعتماد التعديلات")
        self.btn_save.setObjectName("primary_action")
        self.btn_save.clicked.connect(self._on_save)
        
        self.btn_cancel = QPushButton("Close / إغلاق")
        self.btn_cancel.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        
        btn_layout.addWidget(self.btn_revert)
        btn_layout.addStretch()
        btn_layout.addWidget(self.btn_cancel)
        btn_layout.addWidget(self.btn_save)
        self.layout.addLayout(btn_layout)
        
        if self.document:
            self.load_document(self.document)
            
    def load_document(self, document: SubtitleDocument):
        self.document = document
        events = document.get_translatable_events() if hasattr(document, "get_translatable_events") else document.events
        
        self.table.setRowCount(0)
        total = len(events)
        translated_cnt = 0
        warnings_cnt = 0
        
        self.table.setSortingEnabled(False)
        self.table.setRowCount(total)
        
        for row, ev in enumerate(events):
            # ID
            item_id = QTableWidgetItem(str(ev.id))
            item_id.setFlags(item_id.flags() & ~Qt.ItemIsEditable)
            self.table.setItem(row, 0, item_id)
            
            # Speaker
            speaker = getattr(ev, "speaker", "") or ""
            item_speaker = QTableWidgetItem(speaker)
            item_speaker.setFlags(item_speaker.flags() & ~Qt.ItemIsEditable)
            self.table.setItem(row, 1, item_speaker)
            
            # Original
            orig_text = getattr(ev, "text", "") or ""
            item_orig = QTableWidgetItem(orig_text)
            item_orig.setFlags(item_orig.flags() & ~Qt.ItemIsEditable)
            self.table.setItem(row, 2, item_orig)
            
            # Translation (Editable)
            trans_text = getattr(ev, "translated_text", "") or ""
            item_trans = QTableWidgetItem(trans_text)
            self.table.setItem(row, 3, item_trans)
            
            # Quality & Warnings Check
            warnings = []
            if trans_text:
                translated_cnt += 1
                if re.search(r'[a-zA-Z]{3,}', trans_text):
                    warnings.append("Leaked English")
                if trans_text.count('"') % 2 != 0 or trans_text.count('«') != trans_text.count('»'):
                    warnings.append("Orphan quote")
                
                from app.utils.metrics import calculate_cps
                start_ts = getattr(ev, "start", "") or getattr(ev, "start_time", "")
                end_ts = getattr(ev, "end", "") or getattr(ev, "end_time", "")
                cps = calculate_cps(trans_text, start_ts, end_ts)
                if cps > 18.0:
                    warnings.append(f"Fast reading ({cps:.1f} CPS)")
                lines = trans_text.replace("\\N", "\n").split("\n")
                if any(len(l.strip()) > 45 for l in lines):
                    warnings.append("Long line")
            else:
                warnings.append("Untranslated")
                
            warn_str = ", ".join(warnings) if warnings else "OK"
            item_status = QTableWidgetItem(warn_str)
            item_status.setFlags(item_status.flags() & ~Qt.ItemIsEditable)
            
            if warnings:
                warnings_cnt += 1
                if "Untranslated" in warnings:
                    item_status.setForeground(QBrush(QColor("#8b949e")))
                else:
                    item_status.setForeground(QBrush(QColor("#f85149")))
                    item_trans.setBackground(QBrush(QColor(60, 20, 20)))
            else:
                item_status.setForeground(QBrush(QColor("#3fb950")))
                
            self.table.setItem(row, 4, item_status)
            
        self.set_summary(total, translated_cnt, warnings_cnt)
        self._apply_filter()

    def set_summary(self, total: int, translated: int, warnings: int):
        self.lbl_summary.setText(f"Total Lines: {total} | Translated: {translated} | Warnings: {warnings}")
        
    def add_flagged_event(self, event_id: int, original: str, translated: str, warnings_list: list):
        row = self.table.rowCount()
        self.table.insertRow(row)
        
        item_id = QTableWidgetItem(str(event_id))
        item_id.setFlags(item_id.flags() & ~Qt.ItemIsEditable)
        self.table.setItem(row, 0, item_id)
        
        item_spk = QTableWidgetItem("")
        item_spk.setFlags(item_spk.flags() & ~Qt.ItemIsEditable)
        self.table.setItem(row, 1, item_spk)
        
        item_orig = QTableWidgetItem(original)
        item_orig.setFlags(item_orig.flags() & ~Qt.ItemIsEditable)
        self.table.setItem(row, 2, item_orig)
        
        item_trans = QTableWidgetItem(translated)
        self.table.setItem(row, 3, item_trans)
        
        warn_str = "\n".join(warnings_list)
        item_warn = QTableWidgetItem(warn_str)
        item_warn.setFlags(item_warn.flags() & ~Qt.ItemIsEditable)
        self.table.setItem(row, 4, item_warn)
        
    def _apply_filter(self):
        query = self.search_input.text().lower().strip()
        mode = self.filter_combo.currentIndex()
        # 0: All, 1: Translated, 2: Untranslated, 3: Warnings
        
        for row in range(self.table.rowCount()):
            item_orig = self.table.item(row, 2)
            item_trans = self.table.item(row, 3)
            item_status = self.table.item(row, 4)
            
            orig_text = item_orig.text() if item_orig else ""
            trans_text = item_trans.text() if item_trans else ""
            status_text = item_status.text() if item_status else ""
            
            # Match search
            matches_search = True
            if query:
                matches_search = (query in orig_text.lower()) or (query in trans_text.lower())
                
            # Match filter
            matches_filter = True
            if mode == 1: # Translated
                matches_filter = bool(trans_text.strip())
            elif mode == 2: # Untranslated
                matches_filter = not bool(trans_text.strip())
            elif mode == 3: # Warnings
                matches_filter = (status_text != "OK" and "Untranslated" not in status_text)
                
            self.table.setRowHidden(row, not (matches_search and matches_filter))

    def _revert_selected(self):
        curr_row = self.table.currentRow()
        if curr_row >= 0:
            item_orig = self.table.item(curr_row, 2)
            item_trans = self.table.item(curr_row, 3)
            if item_orig and item_trans:
                item_trans.setText(item_orig.text())

    def _on_save(self):
        if self.document:
            events_map = {e.id: e for e in self.document.events}
            for row in range(self.table.rowCount()):
                item_id = self.table.item(row, 0)
                item_trans = self.table.item(row, 3)
                if item_id and item_trans:
                    try:
                        eid = int(item_id.text())
                        if eid in events_map:
                            events_map[eid].translated_text = item_trans.text()
                    except ValueError:
                        pass
        self.accept()

        return val if val is not None else 0

    def _ms_to_time_str(self, ms: int, is_srt: bool = False) -> str:
        return format_timecode(ms, template_str="," if is_srt else (self.sample_start_time or ""))

    def _update_preview(self):
        if not hasattr(self, "lbl_preview"):
            return
        offset = self.get_offset_ms()
        sign_str = f"+{offset}ms" if offset >= 0 else f"{offset}ms"
        sec_abs = abs(offset) / 1000.0
        effect_desc = (
            f"ستظهر الترجمة لاحقاً بـ {sec_abs:.2f} ثانية"
            if offset >= 0
            else f"ستظهر الترجمة أبكر بـ {sec_abs:.2f} ثانية"
        )
        if self.sample_start_time:
            orig_ms = parse_timecode_ms(self.sample_start_time)
            if orig_ms is not None:
                raw_new_ms = orig_ms + offset
                new_ms = max(0, raw_new_ms)
                new_ts = format_timecode(new_ms, template_str=self.sample_start_time)
                clamp_note = " — (تم التثبيت عند البداية 0 مع حفظ مدة السطر)" if raw_new_ms < 0 else ""
                self.lbl_preview.setText(
                    f"معاينة: {self.sample_start_time} ➔ {new_ts} ({sign_str})\n{effect_desc}{clamp_note}"
                )
                return
        self.lbl_preview.setText(f"إزاحة التوقيت بمقدار: {sign_str} — {effect_desc}")

    def get_offset_ms(self) -> int:
        ms = self.spn_ms.value()
        return ms if self.radio_delay.isChecked() else -ms

    def is_selected_only(self) -> bool:
        return self.radio_selected.isChecked()

        self.chk_prefer_ass.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 600; color: #38bdf8;")
        opt_layout.addWidget(self.chk_prefer_ass)

        # Automation Checkbox
        self.chk_auto_start = QCheckBox("🚀 البدء الفوري بالترجمة والتحسين التلقائي بعد الاستخراج مباشرة")
        self.chk_auto_start.setChecked(True)
        self.chk_auto_start.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 600; color: #fbbf24;")
        opt_layout.addWidget(self.chk_auto_start)

        layout.addWidget(opt_box)

        # Buttons
        btn_box = QHBoxLayout()
        btn_box.setSpacing(10)
        
        self.btn_confirm = QPushButton("استخراج وبدء العمل")
        self.btn_confirm.setStyleSheet("background-color: #0284c7; color: white; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 14px;")
        self.btn_confirm.clicked.connect(self._on_confirm)

        self.btn_cancel = QPushButton("إلغاء")
        self.btn_cancel.clicked.connect(self.reject)

        btn_box.addStretch()
        btn_box.addWidget(self.btn_cancel)
        btn_box.addWidget(self.btn_confirm)
        layout.addLayout(btn_box)

    def _on_confirm(self):
        sel_id = self.btn_group.checkedId()
        if sel_id >= 0:
            self.selected_stream_index = sel_id
        self.auto_start_processing = self.chk_auto_start.isChecked()
        self.prefer_ass = self.chk_prefer_ass.isChecked()
        self.accept()

import re
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional, Tuple
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, QAbstractTableModel, QModelIndex
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor
from app.models.subtitle import SubtitleEvent
from app.subtitle.timecode import (
    parse_timecode_ms,
    parse_timecode_ms_safe,
    format_timecode,
    normalize_timecode,
)

class SubtitleTableModel(QAbstractTableModel):
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.headers = ["#", "Start", "End", "Speaker", "Original Subtitle", "Translation", "Status"]
        self.events: List[SubtitleEvent] = []
        self.statuses: Dict[int, str] = {}  # Map row idx to status string
        self.on_data_changed_callback = None

    def rowCount(self, parent=QModelIndex()) -> int:
        return len(self.events)

    def columnCount(self, parent=QModelIndex()) -> int:
        return len(self.headers)

    def headerData(self, section: int, orientation: Qt.Orientation, role: int = Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):
        if orientation == Qt.Orientation.Horizontal and role == Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole:
            return self.headers[section]
        return None

    def flags(self, index: QModelIndex) -> Qt.ItemFlags:
        if not index.isValid():
            return Qt.ItemFlag.NoItemFlags

        base_flags = Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEnabled | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsSelectable
        col = index.column()
        # Direct in-place editing allowed for Start (1), End (2), Speaker (3), Original (4), Translation (5)
        if col in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5):
            return base_flags | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEditable
        return base_flags

    def calculate_cps(self, event: SubtitleEvent) -> float:
        """Calculate characters per second (CPS) for reading speed metrics with micro-caching."""
        cached = getattr(event, '_cached_cps', None)
        if cached is not None:
            return cached
        try:
            start_ms = parse_timecode_ms(event.start_time)
            end_ms = parse_timecode_ms(event.end_time)
            if start_ms is None or end_ms is None:
                val = 0.0
            else:
                dur_sec = (end_ms - start_ms) / 1000.0
                if dur_sec <= 0.1:
                    val = 0.0
                else:
                    raw_text = event.translated_text or event.original_text or ""
                    # Strip ASS tags, comments, and line breaks for true reading length
                    clean_text = re.sub(r"\{.*?\}", "", raw_text).replace("\\N", " ").strip()
                    val = len(clean_text) / dur_sec
        except Exception:
            val = 0.0
        setattr(event, '_cached_cps', val)
        return val

    def _parse_time_to_ms(self, time_str: str) -> int:
        return parse_timecode_ms_safe(time_str, default=0)

    def _ms_to_time_str(self, ms: int, template_str: str = "0:00:00.00", fmt: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
        return format_timecode(ms, template_str=template_str, fmt=fmt)

    def data(self, index: QModelIndex, role: int = Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):
        if not index.isValid():
            return None

        row = index.row()
        col = index.column()
        event = self.events[row]

        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole or role == Qt.ItemDataRole.EditRole:
            if col == 0:
                return str(event.id)
            elif col == 1:
                return event.start_time
            elif col == 2:
                return event.end_time
            elif col == 3:
                return event.speaker
            elif col == 4:
                return event.original_text
            elif col == 5:
                trans = event.translated_text if event.translated_text else ""
                # Directional isolation marker for Arabic RTL text
                return f"\u200F{trans}\u200F" if trans else ""
            elif col == 6:
                st = self.statuses.get(row)
                if st:
                    return st
                if event.translated_text:
                    return "Done"
                if hasattr(event, "has_translatable_text") and event.has_translatable_text():
                    return "Pending"
                if hasattr(event, "is_visual_effect") and event.is_visual_effect():
                    return "مؤثرات (FX)"
                return "Pending"

        elif role == Qt.ItemDataRole.TextAlignmentRole:
            if col in [0, 1, 2, 6]:
                return Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter
            elif col == 5:
                return Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter
            return Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter

        elif role == Qt.ItemDataRole.BackgroundRole:
            # Color code reading speed CPS warnings
            if col in (4, 5):
                cps = self.calculate_cps(event)
                if cps > 22.0:
                    return QColor(185, 28, 28, 80) # Red: too fast to read
                elif cps > 18.0:
                    return QColor(217, 119, 6, 60) # Amber: slightly fast

        elif role == Qt.ItemDataRole.ToolTipRole:
            if col in (1, 2, 4, 5):
                cps = self.calculate_cps(event)
                if cps > 22.0:
                    return f"⚠️ تنبيه: سرعة القراءة مرتفعة جداً ({cps:.1f} حرف/ثانية)! يُنصح بألا تتجاوز 18-20 حرف/ث."
                elif cps > 18.0:
                    return f"⚡ سرعة القراءة سريعة ({cps:.1f} حرف/ثانية)."
                elif cps > 0:
                    return f"⏱️ سرعة القراءة ممتازة ومريحة ({cps:.1f} حرف/ثانية)."

        return None

    def setData(self, index: QModelIndex, value: Any, role: int = Qt.ItemDataRole.EditRole) -> bool:
        if not index.isValid() or role not in (Qt.ItemDataRole.EditRole, Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):
            return False

        row = index.row()
        col = index.column()
        event = self.events[row]
        str_val = str(value).strip().replace("\u200F", "").replace("\u2067", "").replace("\u2069", "")

        old_val = ""
        if col == 1:
            norm = normalize_timecode(
                str_val,
                template_str=event.start_time or str_val,
                fmt=getattr(event.format_type, "value", None),
            )
            if norm is None:
                return False  # Reject unparseable / out-of-range timecode strictly
            old_val = event.start_time
            str_val = norm
            event.start_time = str_val
        elif col == 2:
            norm = normalize_timecode(
                str_val,
                template_str=event.end_time or str_val,
                fmt=getattr(event.format_type, "value", None),
            )
            if norm is None:
                return False  # Reject unparseable / out-of-range timecode strictly
            old_val = event.end_time
            str_val = norm
            event.end_time = str_val
        elif col == 3:
            old_val = event.speaker
            event.speaker = str_val
        elif col == 4:
            old_val = event.original_text
            event.original_text = str_val
        elif col == 5:
            old_val = event.translated_text or ""
            event.translated_text = str_val
            self.statuses[row] = "Edited"
        else:
            return False

        setattr(event, '_cached_cps', None)
        self.dataChanged.emit(index, index, [Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole, Qt.ItemDataRole.EditRole, Qt.ItemDataRole.BackgroundRole])
        if self.on_data_changed_callback:
            self.on_data_changed_callback(row, col, old_val, str_val)
        return True

    def set_cell_value_direct(self, row: int, col: int, value: str):
        """Directly update a cell value and emit dataChanged (used by Undo/Redo and Inline Editor)."""
        if not (0 <= row < len(self.events)):
            return
        event = self.events[row]
        str_val = str(value).strip().replace("\u200F", "").replace("\u2067", "").replace("\u2069", "")
        if col == 1:
            if parse_timecode_ms(str_val) is None:
                return
            event.start_time = str_val
        elif col == 2:
            if parse_timecode_ms(str_val) is None:
                return
            event.end_time = str_val
        elif col == 3:
            event.speaker = str_val
        elif col == 4:
            event.original_text = str_val
        elif col == 5:
            event.translated_text = str_val
            self.statuses[row] = "Edited"
        setattr(event, '_cached_cps', None)
        idx = self.index(row, col)
        self.dataChanged.emit(idx, idx, [Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole, Qt.ItemDataRole.EditRole, Qt.ItemDataRole.BackgroundRole])

    def shift_timings(self, offset_ms: int, row_indices: Optional[List[int]] = None):
        """
        Shift start and end timings of all or selected subtitles by offset_ms.
        Preserves display duration when clamping start_time at 00:00:00.
        """
        if not self.events:
            return
        target_rows = row_indices if row_indices is not None and len(row_indices) > 0 else range(len(self.events))
        valid_rows = [r for r in target_rows if 0 <= r < len(self.events)]
        if not valid_rows:
            return
        for r in valid_rows:
            event = self.events[r]
            orig_s = parse_timecode_ms(event.start_time)
            orig_e = parse_timecode_ms(event.end_time)
            if orig_s is None or orig_e is None:
                continue
            orig_dur = max(0, orig_e - orig_s)
            raw_s = orig_s + offset_ms
            if raw_s < 0:
                s_ms = 0
                # Preserve original display duration rather than truncating against 00:00:00
                e_ms = orig_dur
            else:
                s_ms = raw_s
                e_ms = max(s_ms, orig_e + offset_ms)

            fmt = getattr(event.format_type, "value", None)
            event.start_time = format_timecode(s_ms, template_str=event.start_time, fmt=fmt)
            event.end_time = format_timecode(e_ms, template_str=event.end_time, fmt=fmt)
            setattr(event, '_cached_cps', None)

        first_row = min(valid_rows)
        last_row = max(valid_rows)
        self.dataChanged.emit(self.index(first_row, 1), self.index(last_row, 2), [Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole])

    def restore_timings_snapshot(self, snapshot: List[Tuple[int, str, str]]):
        """Restores exact (row_idx, start_time, end_time) strings on Undo."""
        if not snapshot or not self.events:
            return
        valid_rows = []
        for r, s_str, e_str in snapshot:
            if 0 <= r < len(self.events):
                ev = self.events[r]
                ev.start_time = s_str
                ev.end_time = e_str
                setattr(ev, '_cached_cps', None)
                valid_rows.append(r)
        if valid_rows:
            self.dataChanged.emit(self.index(min(valid_rows), 1), self.index(max(valid_rows), 2), [Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole])

    def merge_lines(self, row_indices: List[int]) -> bool:
        """Merge multiple selected contiguous/adjacent lines into the first line."""
        if not row_indices or len(row_indices) < 2:
            return False
        sorted_rows = sorted(row_indices)
        first_idx = sorted_rows[0]
        if first_idx >= len(self.events):
            return False

        first_event = self.events[first_idx]
        last_event = self.events[sorted_rows[-1]]
        
        # Merge timing: start of first to end of last
        first_event.end_time = last_event.end_time

        # Merge texts using format-appropriate linebreak
        fmt_val = getattr(first_event.format_type, "value", "ass")
        joiner = " \\N " if fmt_val == "ass" else "\n"
        merged_orig = []
        merged_trans = []
        for r in sorted_rows:
            ev = self.events[r]
            merged_orig.append(ev.original_text or "")
            if ev.translated_text:
                merged_trans.append(ev.translated_text)

        first_event.original_text = joiner.join(merged_orig)
        if merged_trans:
            first_event.translated_text = joiner.join(merged_trans)
        setattr(first_event, '_cached_cps', None)
        self.statuses[first_idx] = "Edited"

        # Remove the merged rows (from bottom to top)
        self.beginResetModel()
        for r in sorted(sorted_rows[1:], reverse=True):
            if 0 <= r < len(self.events):
                del self.events[r]
        # Re-index
        for idx, ev in enumerate(self.events):
            ev.id = idx + 1
        self.statuses = {
            i: ("مؤثرات (FX)" if (hasattr(e, "is_visual_effect") and e.is_visual_effect() and not (hasattr(e, "has_translatable_text") and e.has_translatable_text())) else self.statuses.get(i, "Pending"))
            for i, e in enumerate(self.events)
        }
        self.endResetModel()
        return True

    @staticmethod
    def _split_text_halves(text: str) -> Tuple[str, str]:
        if not text:
            return "", ""
        if "\\N" in text:
            parts = text.split("\\N", 1)
            return parts[0].strip(), parts[1].strip()
        if "\n" in text:
            parts = text.split("\n", 1)
            return parts[0].strip(), parts[1].strip()
        words = text.split()
        if len(words) <= 1:
            return text.strip(), ""
        half = max(1, len(words) // 2)
        return " ".join(words[:half]), " ".join(words[half:])

    def split_line(self, row_idx: int, split_at_ms: Optional[int] = None) -> bool:
        """
        Split a subtitle line into two synchronized parts.
        Uses exact `split_at_ms` (e.g. active video playback time) when inside the line,
        otherwise distributes duration proportionally by text length rather than a blind 50/50 split.
        """
        if not (0 <= row_idx < len(self.events)):
            return False

        ev = self.events[row_idx]
        s_ms = parse_timecode_ms(ev.start_time)
        e_ms = parse_timecode_ms(ev.end_time)
        if s_ms is None or e_ms is None:
            return False
        dur = e_ms - s_ms
        if dur <= 400:
            return False  # Too short to split safely

        # Split original and translated texts first so character ratio can guide timing
        orig1, orig2 = self._split_text_halves(ev.original_text or "")
        trans1, trans2 = self._split_text_halves(ev.translated_text or "")

        if split_at_ms is not None and (s_ms + 200) <= split_at_ms <= (e_ms - 200):
            mid_ms = int(split_at_ms)
        else:
            ref1 = re.sub(r"\{.*?\}", "", trans1 or orig1).strip()
            ref2 = re.sub(r"\{.*?\}", "", trans2 or orig2).strip()
            total_len = len(ref1) + len(ref2)
            ratio = (len(ref1) / total_len) if total_len > 0 else 0.5
            ratio = max(0.20, min(0.80, ratio))
            mid_ms = s_ms + int(round(dur * ratio))

        from copy import deepcopy
        ev2 = deepcopy(ev)
        fmt = getattr(ev.format_type, "value", None)

        # Adjust first half
        ev.end_time = format_timecode(mid_ms, template_str=ev.end_time, fmt=fmt)
        ev.original_text = orig1
        if ev.translated_text:
            ev.translated_text = trans1
        setattr(ev, '_cached_cps', None)

        # Adjust second half
        ev2.start_time = format_timecode(mid_ms, template_str=ev2.start_time, fmt=fmt)
        ev2.original_text = orig2
        if ev2.translated_text:
            ev2.translated_text = trans2
        setattr(ev2, '_cached_cps', None)

        self.beginResetModel()
        self.events.insert(row_idx + 1, ev2)
        for idx, e in enumerate(self.events):
            e.id = idx + 1
        self.statuses = {
            i: ("مؤثرات (FX)" if (hasattr(e, "is_visual_effect") and e.is_visual_effect() and not (hasattr(e, "has_translatable_text") and e.has_translatable_text())) else self.statuses.get(i, "Pending"))
            for i, e in enumerate(self.events)
        }
        self.endResetModel()
        return True

    def update_event(self, row_idx: int, translated: str, status: str):
        if 0 <= row_idx < len(self.events):
            self.events[row_idx].translated_text = translated
            setattr(self.events[row_idx], '_cached_cps', None)
            self.statuses[row_idx] = status
            idx1 = self.index(row_idx, 5)
            idx2 = self.index(row_idx, 6)
            self.dataChanged.emit(idx1, idx2, [Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole, Qt.ItemDataRole.BackgroundRole])

    def set_batch_status(self, event_ids: List[int], status: str):
        """Update status for a list of event IDs and refresh status badges."""
        id_to_row = {e.id: idx for idx, e in enumerate(self.events)}
        for eid in event_ids:
            if eid in id_to_row:
                row = id_to_row[eid]
                self.statuses[row] = status
                idx = self.index(row, 6)
                self.dataChanged.emit(idx, idx, [Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole])

    def update_events_batch(self, translations: Dict[int, str], status: str = "Done"):
        """Update translated text and status for multiple events."""
        id_to_row = {e.id: idx for idx, e in enumerate(self.events)}
        for eid, trans in translations.items():
            if eid in id_to_row:
                row = id_to_row[eid]
                self.events[row].translated_text = trans
                setattr(self.events[row], '_cached_cps', None)
                self.statuses[row] = status
                idx1 = self.index(row, 5)
                idx2 = self.index(row, 6)
                self.dataChanged.emit(idx1, idx2, [Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole, Qt.ItemDataRole.BackgroundRole])

    def set_events(self, events: List[SubtitleEvent]):
        self.beginResetModel()
        self.events = events
        self.statuses = {
            i: ("مؤثرات (FX)" if (hasattr(e, "is_visual_effect") and e.is_visual_effect() and not (hasattr(e, "has_translatable_text") and e.has_translatable_text())) else ("Done" if e.translated_text else "Pending"))
            for i, e in enumerate(events)
        }
        self.endResetModel()

from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QPushButton,
    QTableWidget, QTableWidgetItem, QHeaderView, QFrame, QLineEdit
)
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt

class CharacterPanel(QWidget):
    """
    Clean, spacious panel for managing Characters, Genders,
    Pronouns, and Arabic Names with live filtering and auto-enrichment.
    """
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        self.layout.setContentsMargins(6, 6, 6, 6)
        self.layout.setSpacing(8)
        
        # Header Media Title Box
        media_box = QFrame()
        media_box.setStyleSheet("background-color: #18181b; border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px;")
        m_layout = QVBoxLayout(media_box)
        m_layout.setContentsMargins(8, 6, 8, 6)
        
        self.lbl_anime_title = QLabel("العمل: لم يتم الكشف بعد (No Media Detected)")
        self.lbl_anime_title.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 600; color: #fbbf24; font-size: 9pt;")
        self.lbl_anime_title.setWordWrap(True)
        self.lbl_media_title = self.lbl_anime_title  # alias
        m_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_anime_title)
        self.layout.addWidget(media_box)
        
        # Search Media Button (Full Width)
        self.btn_search = QPushButton("🔍 جلب بيانات العمل والشخصيات تلقائياً")
        self.btn_search.setStyleSheet("background-color: #0284c7; color: white; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px;")
        self.btn_search.setToolTip("البحث في قواعد بيانات الأنمي والمسلسلات والأفلام لجلب الشخصيات والأجناس تلقائياً")
        self.layout.addWidget(self.btn_search)

        # Quick Search / Filter Bar
        self.le_filter = QLineEdit()
        self.le_filter.setPlaceholderText("🔎 تصفية الشخصيات في الجدول...")
        self.le_filter.textChanged.connect(self._filter_table)
        self.layout.addWidget(self.le_filter)

        # Character Table (3 Clean Columns)
        self.table = QTableWidget(0, 3)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["الاسم الأصلي", "الاسم بالعربية", "الجنس"])
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(0, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(1, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(2, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Fixed)
        self.table.setColumnWidth(2, 85)
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QTableWidget.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.layout.addWidget(self.table)
        
        # Action Buttons Row
        ctrl_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        ctrl_layout.setSpacing(6)
        
        self.btn_add = QPushButton("➕ إضافة")
        self.btn_edit = QPushButton("✏️ تعديل")
        self.btn_delete = QPushButton("🗑️ حذف")
        self.btn_delete.setStyleSheet("background-color: #27272a; color: #f87171;")

        ctrl_layout.addWidget(self.btn_add)
        ctrl_layout.addWidget(self.btn_edit)
        ctrl_layout.addWidget(self.btn_delete)
        self.layout.addLayout(ctrl_layout)
        
        self.btn_delete.clicked.connect(self._delete_selected)

    def _filter_table(self, query: str):
        query = (query or "").strip().lower()
        for r in range(self.table.rowCount()):
            can = (self.table.item(r, 0).text() if self.table.item(r, 0) else "").lower()
            ara = (self.table.item(r, 1).text() if self.table.item(r, 1) else "").lower()
            gen = (self.table.item(r, 2).text() if self.table.item(r, 2) else "").lower()
            match = not query or (query in can or query in ara or query in gen)
            self.table.setRowHidden(r, not match)

    def _delete_selected(self):
        row = self.table.currentRow()
        if row >= 0:
            self.table.removeRow(row)
        
    def add_character(self, canonical, arabic, gender, conf=1.0, source=""):
        row = self.table.rowCount()
        self.table.insertRow(row)
        
        item_can = QTableWidgetItem(str(canonical or ""))
        item_ar = QTableWidgetItem(str(arabic or ""))
        item_gen = QTableWidgetItem(str(gender or ""))
        item_gen.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        
        # Store full metadata in item user data
        item_can.setData(Qt.UserRole, {
            "conf": str(conf or "1.0"),
            "source": str(source or "")
        })

        self.table.setItem(row, 0, item_can)
        self.table.setItem(row, 1, item_ar)
        self.table.setItem(row, 2, item_gen)
        
    def get_selected_character(self):
        row = self.table.currentRow()
        if row < 0 and self.table.rowCount() > 0:
            row = 0
        if row >= 0:
            item_can = self.table.item(row, 0)
            meta = item_can.data(Qt.UserRole) if item_can else {}
            return {
                "row": row,
                "canonical": item_can.text() if item_can else "",
                "arabic": self.table.item(row, 1).text() if self.table.item(row, 1) else "",
                "gender": self.table.item(row, 2).text() if self.table.item(row, 2) else "",
                "conf": meta.get("conf", "1.0") if isinstance(meta, dict) else "1.0",
                "source": meta.get("source", "User") if isinstance(meta, dict) else "User"
            }
        return None

    def update_character_row(self, row: int, canonical: str, arabic: str, gender: str, conf: str = "1.0", source: str = "User Override"):
        if 0 <= row < self.table.rowCount():
            item_can = QTableWidgetItem(canonical)
            item_can.setData(Qt.UserRole, {"conf": str(conf), "source": str(source)})
            item_ar = QTableWidgetItem(arabic)
            item_gen = QTableWidgetItem(gender)
            item_gen.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
            
            self.table.setItem(row, 0, item_can)
            self.table.setItem(row, 1, item_ar)
            self.table.setItem(row, 2, item_gen)

    def get_characters(self):
        from app.models.character import CharacterProfile, GenderInfo, GenderEnum
        chars = []
        for row in range(self.table.rowCount()):
            item_can = self.table.item(row, 0)
            canonical = item_can.text() if item_can else ""
            arabic = self.table.item(row, 1).text() if self.table.item(row, 1) else ""
            gender_str = self.table.item(row, 2).text() if self.table.item(row, 2) else ""
            meta = item_can.data(Qt.UserRole) if item_can else {}
            
            conf_str = meta.get("conf", "1.0") if isinstance(meta, dict) else "1.0"
            src_str = meta.get("source", "Direct") if isinstance(meta, dict) else "Direct"
            
            gender_enum = GenderEnum(gender_str.upper()) if gender_str and hasattr(GenderEnum, gender_str.upper()) else GenderEnum.UNKNOWN
            try:
                conf = float(conf_str)
            except ValueError:
                conf = 1.0
                
            chars.append(CharacterProfile(
                canonical_name=canonical,
                arabic_name=arabic,
                gender_info=GenderInfo(gender=gender_enum, confidence=conf, source=src_str)
            ))
        return chars
