import os
from pathlib import Path
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QPushButton, QLabel, QFileDialog, QFrame
from PySide6.QtGui import QDragEnterEvent, QDropEvent
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from app.ui.bus import EventBus
from app.subtitle.video_extractor import VIDEO_EXTENSIONS

SUBTITLE_EXTS = ('.srt', '.ass', '.ssa', '.vtt', '.sbv', '.txt', '.json')
ALL_SUPPORTED_EXTS = SUBTITLE_EXTS + VIDEO_EXTENSIONS

class FilePanel(QWidget):
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setAcceptDrops(True)
        self.layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        self.layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self.layout.setSpacing(6)
        
        card = QFrame()
        card.setObjectName("file_card")
        card.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame#file_card {
                background-color: #18181b;
                border: 1px dashed #0284c7;
                border-radius: 8px;
            }
        """)
        c_layout = QVBoxLayout(card)
        c_layout.setContentsMargins(10, 8, 10, 8)
        c_layout.setSpacing(6)

        lbl_header = QLabel("✨ SubNova Studio | منطقة استيراد الوسائط")
        lbl_header.setStyleSheet("color: #38bdf8; font-size: 8pt; font-weight: 700;")
        lbl_header.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        c_layout.addWidget(lbl_header)

        btn_layout_1 = QHBoxLayout()
        btn_layout_1.setSpacing(6)
        
        self.btn_select_video = QPushButton("🎬 استيراد فيديو")
        self.btn_select_video.setObjectName("video_action")
        self.btn_select_video.setStyleSheet("background-color: #0284c7; color: white; font-weight: 600;")
        self.btn_select_video.setToolTip("استخراج مسار الترجمة بتنسيقه الأصلي الكامل وترجمته وتحسينه تلقائياً")
        self.btn_select_video.clicked.connect(self._select_video)

        self.btn_select = QPushButton("📂 استيراد ترجمة")
        self.btn_select.setObjectName("primary_action")
        self.btn_select.clicked.connect(self._select_file)

        btn_layout_1.addWidget(self.btn_select_video)
        btn_layout_1.addWidget(self.btn_select)

        btn_layout_2 = QHBoxLayout()
        btn_layout_2.setSpacing(6)
        
        self.btn_select_folder = QPushButton("📁 مجلد كامل")
        self.btn_select_folder.clicked.connect(self._select_folder)

        self.btn_new_session = QPushButton("🔄 مسح الجلسة")
        self.btn_new_session.clicked.connect(self._clear_all)

        btn_layout_2.addWidget(self.btn_select_folder)
        btn_layout_2.addWidget(self.btn_new_session)
        
        self.lbl_selected = QLabel("اسحب وأفلت الفيديوهات أو ملفات الترجمة هنا مباشرة")
        self.lbl_selected.setStyleSheet("color: #38bdf8; font-size: 8.5pt; font-weight: 500;")
        self.lbl_selected.setWordWrap(True)
        self.lbl_selected.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)

        self.lbl_formats = QLabel("يدعم ملفات ASS, SRT, VTT واستخراج تلقائي مباشر من MKV, MP4")
        self.lbl_formats.setStyleSheet("color: #71717a; font-size: 7.5pt;")
        self.lbl_formats.setWordWrap(True)
        self.lbl_formats.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        
        c_layout.addLayout(btn_layout_1)
        c_layout.addLayout(btn_layout_2)
        c_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_selected)
        c_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_formats)
        
        self.layout.addWidget(card)
        
    def _select_video(self):
        file_paths, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileNames(
            self, "اختر ملفات الفيديو لاستخراج الترجمة منها تلقائياً", "",
            "ملفات الفيديو (*.mkv *.mp4 *.avi *.mov *.webm *.flv *.ts *.m4v);;كل الملفات (*.*)"
        )
        if file_paths:
            self._handle_incoming_paths(file_paths)

    def _select_file(self):
        file_paths, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileNames(
            self, "اختر ملفات الترجمة", "", "ملفات الترجمة (*.srt *.ass *.ssa *.vtt *.sbv *.txt *.json);;كل الملفات (*.*)"
        )
        if file_paths:
            self._handle_incoming_paths(file_paths)

    def _select_folder(self):
        folder = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "اختر مجلداً يحتوي على ملفات الترجمة أو الفيديوهات")
        if folder:
            self._handle_incoming_paths([folder])

    def _clear_all(self):
        self.lbl_selected.setText("اسحب وأفلت الفيديوهات أو ملفات الترجمة هنا مباشرة")
        EventBus.instance().files_cleared.emit()

    def _handle_incoming_paths(self, paths):
        collected = []
        for p in paths:
            clean = os.path.normpath(str(p))
            if os.path.isfile(clean):
                if clean.lower().endswith(ALL_SUPPORTED_EXTS):
                    collected.append(clean)
            elif os.path.isdir(clean):
                for root, _, files in os.walk(clean):
                    for f in files:
                        if f.lower().endswith(ALL_SUPPORTED_EXTS):
                            collected.append(os.path.normpath(os.path.join(root, f)))
        
        collected = list(dict.fromkeys(collected))
        if collected:
            video_count = sum(1 for f in collected if f.lower().endswith(VIDEO_EXTENSIONS))
            sub_count = len(collected) - video_count
            desc = []
            if video_count > 0:
                desc.append(f"{video_count} فيديو")
            if sub_count > 0:
                desc.append(f"{sub_count} ملف ترجمة")
            self.lbl_selected.setText(f"جاهز: {', '.join(desc)}")
            EventBus.instance().file_selected.emit(collected)
        else:
            self.lbl_selected.setText("لم يتم العثور على ملفات ترجمة أو فيديو مدعومة.")

    def dragEnterEvent(self, event: QDragEnterEvent):
        if event.mimeData().hasUrls():
            event.acceptProposedAction()
            return
        event.ignore()

    def dropEvent(self, event: QDropEvent):
        urls = event.mimeData().urls()
        if urls:
            paths = [url.toLocalFile() for url in urls if url.isLocalFile()]
            if paths:
                self._handle_incoming_paths(paths)
                event.acceptProposedAction()

from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QLineEdit, QPushButton, QCheckBox, QFrame
)
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, Signal
from PySide6.QtGui import QKeySequence, QShortcut

class FindReplaceBar(QFrame):
    """
    SubNova Studio — In-Table Search and Replace Bar (Ctrl+F).
    Supports finding occurrences, replacing current, and bulk replacing
    in original or translated subtitle text.
    """
    find_next_requested = Signal(str, bool)  # (search_text, case_sensitive)
    replace_requested = Signal(str, str, bool)  # (search_text, replace_text, case_sensitive)
    replace_all_requested = Signal(str, str, bool)  # (search_text, replace_text, case_sensitive)
    closed_signal = Signal()

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            FindReplaceBar {
                background-color: #0f172a;
                border: 1px solid #1e293b;
                border-radius: 6px;
                padding: 4px;
            }
            QLineEdit {
                background-color: #1e293b;
                border: 1px solid #334155;
                color: #f1f5f9;
                border-radius: 4px;
                padding: 4px 8px;
                font-size: 9pt;
            }
            QLineEdit:focus {
                border: 1px solid #38bdf8;
            }
            QPushButton {
                background-color: #1e293b;
                color: #cbd5e1;
                border: 1px solid #334155;
                border-radius: 4px;
                padding: 4px 10px;
                font-size: 8.5pt;
                font-weight: 500;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                background-color: #334155;
                color: #ffffff;
            }
            QCheckBox {
                color: #94a3b8;
                font-size: 8pt;
            }
        """)

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(6, 4, 6, 4)
        layout.setSpacing(6)

        lbl_icon = QLabel("🔍")
        layout.addWidget(lbl_icon)

        # Search box
        self.edit_find = QLineEdit()
        self.edit_find.setPlaceholderText("بحث في الأسطر (Find)...")
        self.edit_find.setFixedWidth(170)
        self.edit_find.returnPressed.connect(self._on_find_next)
        layout.addWidget(self.edit_find)

        # Replace box
        self.edit_replace = QLineEdit()
        self.edit_replace.setPlaceholderText("استبدال بـ (Replace with)...")
        self.edit_replace.setFixedWidth(170)
        self.edit_replace.returnPressed.connect(self._on_replace)
        layout.addWidget(self.edit_replace)

        # Case sensitivity checkbox
        self.chk_case = QCheckBox("Aa")
        self.chk_case.setToolTip("مطابقة حالة الأحرف (Case Sensitive)")
        layout.addWidget(self.chk_case)

        # Buttons
        self.btn_find = QPushButton("بحث عن التالي")
        self.btn_find.clicked.connect(self._on_find_next)
        layout.addWidget(self.btn_find)

        self.btn_replace = QPushButton("استبدال")
        self.btn_replace.clicked.connect(self._on_replace)
        layout.addWidget(self.btn_replace)

        self.btn_replace_all = QPushButton("استبدال الكل")
        self.btn_replace_all.setStyleSheet("background-color: #0369a1; color: white;")
        self.btn_replace_all.clicked.connect(self._on_replace_all)
        layout.addWidget(self.btn_replace_all)

        # Status match label
        self.lbl_matches = QLabel("")
        self.lbl_matches.setStyleSheet("color: #38bdf8; font-size: 8pt; font-weight: bold;")
        layout.addWidget(self.lbl_matches)

        layout.addStretch()

        # Close button
        btn_close = QPushButton("✕")
        btn_close.setFixedSize(22, 22)
        btn_close.setStyleSheet("background: transparent; border: none; color: #94a3b8; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;")
        btn_close.clicked.connect(self.hide_bar)
        layout.addWidget(btn_close)

        # ESC shortcut to hide
        esc_shortcut = QShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt.Key.Key_Escape), self)
        esc_shortcut.activated.connect(self.hide_bar)

    def show_bar(self):
        self.setVisible(True)
        self.edit_find.setFocus()
        self.edit_find.selectAll()

    def hide_bar(self):
        self.setVisible(False)
        self.closed_signal.emit()

    def set_match_status(self, current: int, total: int):
        if total > 0:
            self.lbl_matches.setText(f"{current}/{total} مطابقة")
        else:
            self.lbl_matches.setText("لا يوجد تطابق")

    def _on_find_next(self):
        text = self.edit_find.text()
        if text:
            self.find_next_requested.emit(text, self.chk_case.isChecked())

    def _on_replace(self):
        find_txt = self.edit_find.text()
        rep_txt = self.edit_replace.text()
        if find_txt:
            self.replace_requested.emit(find_txt, rep_txt, self.chk_case.isChecked())

    def _on_replace_all(self):
        find_txt = self.edit_find.text()
        rep_txt = self.edit_replace.text()
        if find_txt:
            self.replace_all_requested.emit(find_txt, rep_txt, self.chk_case.isChecked())

from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QCheckBox,
    QTextEdit, QGroupBox, QFrame, QScrollArea
)
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from app.core.config import get_settings

class HealingPanel(QWidget):
    """
    Spacious, beautifully organized panel for the Smart Auto-Healing Engine,
    Punctuation Normalization, Tag Immunity, and Story/Scene Context.
    """
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.settings = get_settings()

        # Wrap in a ScrollArea to guarantee zero vertical or horizontal crampedness
        outer_layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        outer_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        outer_layout.setSpacing(0)

        scroll = QScrollArea()
        scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        scroll.setFrameShape(QFrame.NoFrame)
        scroll.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        
        container = QWidget()
        layout = QVBoxLayout(container)
        layout.setContentsMargins(6, 6, 6, 6)
        layout.setSpacing(10)

        # Helper to create option item with title + wrapped description
        def create_option_block(chk: QCheckBox, desc_text: str):
            box = QWidget()
            b_layout = QVBoxLayout(box)
            b_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 4)
            b_layout.setSpacing(1)
            b_layout.addWidget(chk)

            lbl_desc.setStyleSheet("color: #71717a; font-size: 8pt; margin-right: 24px;")
            b_layout.addWidget(lbl_desc)
            return box

        # 1. Smart Auto-Healing Group
        grp_healing = QGroupBox("🛡️ محرك التنقية الذاتي (Auto-Healing)")
        grp_healing.setStyleSheet("QGroupBox::title { color: #4ade80; }")
        layout_healing = QVBoxLayout(grp_healing)
        layout_healing.setSpacing(6)
        layout_healing.setContentsMargins(10, 12, 10, 10)

        self.chk_auto_heal = QCheckBox("تفعيل الفلترة الذاتية الشاملة")
        self.chk_auto_heal.setChecked(getattr(self.settings, 'enable_smart_healing', True))
        self.chk_auto_heal.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 600; color: #4ade80;")
        layout_healing.addWidget(create_option_block(self.chk_auto_heal, "تطبيق سلسلة المعالجة والتنقية الذاتية فور اكتمال الترجمة"))

        self.chk_arabic_punct = QCheckBox("تصحيح علامات الترقيم العربية")

        self.settings.deduplicate_identical_lines = self.chk_dedup_lines.isChecked()
        self.settings.auto_improve = self.chk_auto_improve.isChecked()
        self.settings.play_sound_on_finish = self.chk_play_sound.isChecked()
        self.settings.story_notes = self.te_story_notes.toPlainText().strip()
        self.settings.save_to_file()

    def get_healing_options(self) -> dict:

            "quote_fix": self.chk_quote_fix.isChecked(),

            "skip_visual_effects": self.chk_skip_fx.isChecked(),
            "separate_inline_effects": self.chk_separate_effects.isChecked(),
            "deduplicate_identical_lines": self.chk_dedup_lines.isChecked()
        }

    def get_story_notes(self) -> str:
        return self.te_story_notes.toPlainText().strip()

import re
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QLineEdit,
    QTextEdit, QPushButton, QFrame
)
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, Signal
from app.subtitle.timecode import parse_timecode_ms, parse_timecode_ms_safe

class InlineSubtitleEditor(QWidget):
    """
    SubNova Studio — Dedicated Subtitle Inline Editor Panel.
    Provides immediate, high-productivity editing for the currently selected subtitle line
    (Start, End, Speaker, Original, Arabic Translation) with real-time CPS metrics.
    """
    line_updated = Signal(int, str, str, str, str, str)  # (row, start, end, speaker, orig, trans)
    nav_previous_requested = Signal()
    nav_next_requested = Signal()
    play_in_video_requested = Signal(str)  # (start_time_str)

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.current_row = -1
        self._is_loading = False

        self.layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        self.layout.setContentsMargins(0, 2, 0, 2)
        self.layout.setSpacing(4)

        card = QFrame()
        card.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame {
                background-color: #0f172a;
                border: 1px solid #1e293b;
                border-radius: 8px;
            }
            QLabel {
                color: #94a3b8;
                font-size: 8.5pt;
                font-weight: 600;
            }
            QLineEdit {
                background-color: #1e293b;
                border: 1px solid #334155;
                color: #f8fafc;
                border-radius: 4px;
                padding: 4px 6px;
                font-size: 9pt;
            }
            QLineEdit:focus {
                border: 1px solid #38bdf8;
            }
            QTextEdit {
                background-color: #1e293b;
                border: 1px solid #334155;
                color: #f8fafc;
                border-radius: 4px;
                padding: 6px;
                font-size: 10pt;
            }
            QTextEdit:focus {
                border: 1px solid #38bdf8;
            }
            QPushButton {
                background-color: #1e293b;
                color: #cbd5e1;
                border: 1px solid #334155;
                border-radius: 4px;
                padding: 4px 8px;
                font-size: 8.5pt;
                font-weight: 500;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                background-color: #334155;
                color: #ffffff;
            }
        """)
        c_layout = QVBoxLayout(card)
        c_layout.setContentsMargins(8, 6, 8, 6)
        c_layout.setSpacing(6)

        # Top Bar: Row Info, Time Inputs, CPS, Navigation
        top_row = QHBoxLayout()
        top_row.setSpacing(8)

        self.lbl_row_info = QLabel("السطر: لم يُحدد")
        self.lbl_row_info.setStyleSheet("color: #38bdf8; font-weight: bold; font-size: 9.5pt;")
        top_row.addWidget(self.lbl_row_info)

        lbl_start = QLabel("البداية:")
        self.edit_start = QLineEdit()
        self.edit_start.setFixedWidth(80)
        self.edit_start.textChanged.connect(self._on_timing_changed)
        top_row.addWidget(lbl_start)
        top_row.addWidget(self.edit_start)

        lbl_end = QLabel("النهاية:")
        self.edit_end = QLineEdit()
        self.edit_end.setFixedWidth(80)
        self.edit_end.textChanged.connect(self._on_timing_changed)
        top_row.addWidget(lbl_end)
        top_row.addWidget(self.edit_end)

        lbl_spk = QLabel("المتحدث:")
        self.edit_speaker = QLineEdit()
        self.edit_speaker.setFixedWidth(90)
        self.edit_speaker.textChanged.connect(self._on_content_changed)
        top_row.addWidget(lbl_spk)
        top_row.addWidget(self.edit_speaker)

        self.lbl_cps = QLabel("CPS: 0.0")
        self.lbl_cps.setStyleSheet("color: #4ade80; font-weight: bold; font-size: 8.5pt;")
        top_row.addWidget(self.lbl_cps)

        top_row.addStretch()

        # Play in video button
        self.btn_play_video = QPushButton("🎬 تشغيل السطر")
        self.btn_play_video.setStyleSheet("background-color: #0369a1; color: white;")
        self.btn_play_video.clicked.connect(self._on_play_in_video)
        top_row.addWidget(self.btn_play_video)

        # Navigation buttons
        self.btn_prev = QPushButton("◀ السابق")
        self.btn_prev.clicked.connect(self.nav_previous_requested.emit)
        top_row.addWidget(self.btn_prev)

        self.btn_next = QPushButton("التالي ▶")
        self.btn_next.clicked.connect(self.nav_next_requested.emit)
        top_row.addWidget(self.btn_next)

        c_layout.addLayout(top_row)

        # Two-box Editor: Original (Left) vs Arabic Translation (Right)
        text_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        text_layout.setSpacing(8)

        # Original
        orig_box = QVBoxLayout()
        orig_box.setSpacing(2)
        lbl_orig_head = QLabel("النص الأصلي (Original):")
        self.edit_orig = QTextEdit()
        self.edit_orig.setFixedHeight(58)
        self.edit_orig.setStyleSheet("color: #94a3b8; font-size: 9.5pt;")
        self.edit_orig.textChanged.connect(self._on_content_changed)
        orig_box.addWidget(lbl_orig_head)
        orig_box.addWidget(self.edit_orig)
        text_layout.addLayout(orig_box, 1)

        # Translation
        trans_box = QVBoxLayout()
        trans_box.setSpacing(2)
        lbl_trans_head = QLabel("الترجمة والتدقيق العربي (Arabic Translation):")
        lbl_trans_head.setStyleSheet("color: #38bdf8; font-weight: bold;")
        self.edit_trans = QTextEdit()
        self.edit_trans.setFixedHeight(58)
        self.edit_trans.setAlignment(Qt.AlignRight)
        self.edit_trans.setStyleSheet("color: #38bdf8; font-size: 10.5pt; font-weight: 600;")
        self.edit_trans.textChanged.connect(self._on_trans_changed)
        trans_box.addWidget(lbl_trans_head)
        trans_box.addWidget(self.edit_trans)
        text_layout.addLayout(trans_box, 1)

        c_layout.addLayout(text_layout)
        self.layout.addWidget(card)

    def load_event(self, row: int, event, total_rows: int = 0):
        if not event:
            self.clear()
            return
        self._is_loading = True
        self.current_row = row
        total_str = f" من {total_rows}" if total_rows > 0 else ""
        self.lbl_row_info.setText(f"السطر #{row + 1}{total_str}")
        self.edit_start.setText(event.start_time or "")
        self.edit_end.setText(event.end_time or "")
        self.edit_speaker.setText(event.speaker or "")
        self.edit_orig.setPlainText(event.original_text or "")
        self.edit_trans.setPlainText(event.translated_text or "")
        self._update_cps()
        self._is_loading = False

    def clear(self):
        self._is_loading = True
        self.current_row = -1
        self.lbl_row_info.setText("السطر: لم يُحدد")
        self.edit_start.setStyleSheet("")
        self.edit_end.setStyleSheet("")
        self.edit_start.clear()
        self.edit_end.clear()
        self.edit_speaker.clear()
        self.edit_orig.clear()
        self.edit_trans.clear()
        self.lbl_cps.setStyleSheet("color: #4ade80; font-weight: bold; font-size: 8.5pt;")
        self.lbl_cps.setText("CPS: 0.0")
        self._is_loading = False

    def _validate_timing_inputs(self):
        """Returns (is_valid, s_ms, e_ms) and visually highlights invalid time fields."""
        s_ms = parse_timecode_ms(self.edit_start.text())
        e_ms = parse_timecode_ms(self.edit_end.text())
        order_bad = (s_ms is not None and e_ms is not None and e_ms < s_ms)

        bad_style = "border: 1px solid #ef4444; background-color: #2a1215;"
        self.edit_start.setStyleSheet(bad_style if (s_ms is None or order_bad) else "")
        self.edit_end.setStyleSheet(bad_style if (e_ms is None or order_bad) else "")
        return (s_ms is not None and e_ms is not None and not order_bad), s_ms, e_ms

    def _on_timing_changed(self):
        if self._is_loading:
            return
        valid, _, _ = self._validate_timing_inputs()
        self._update_cps()
        if valid:
            self._emit_update()

    def _on_content_changed(self):
        if self._is_loading:
            return
        self._update_cps()
        self._emit_update()

    def _on_trans_changed(self):
        self._on_content_changed()

    def _emit_update(self):
        if self.current_row >= 0 and not self._is_loading:
            self.line_updated.emit(
                self.current_row,
                self.edit_start.text().strip(),
                self.edit_end.text().strip(),
                self.edit_speaker.text().strip(),
                self.edit_orig.toPlainText().strip(),
                self.edit_trans.toPlainText().strip()
            )

    def _on_play_in_video(self):
        start_time = self.edit_start.text().strip()
        if parse_timecode_ms(start_time) is not None:
            self.play_in_video_requested.emit(start_time)

    def _update_cps(self):
        try:
            valid, s_ms, e_ms = self._validate_timing_inputs()
            if s_ms is None or e_ms is None:
                self.lbl_cps.setStyleSheet("color: #ef4444; font-weight: bold; font-size: 8.5pt;")
                self.lbl_cps.setText("CPS: -- ⚠️ (توقيت غير صالح)")
                return
            if e_ms < s_ms:
                self.lbl_cps.setStyleSheet("color: #ef4444; font-weight: bold; font-size: 8.5pt;")
                self.lbl_cps.setText("CPS: -- ⚠️ (النهاية قبل البداية)")
                return
            dur = (e_ms - s_ms) / 1000.0
            if dur <= 0.1:
                self.lbl_cps.setStyleSheet("color: #94a3b8; font-weight: bold; font-size: 8.5pt;")
                self.lbl_cps.setText("CPS: --")
                return
            txt = self.edit_trans.toPlainText() or self.edit_orig.toPlainText()
            clean = re.sub(r"\{.*?\}", "", txt).replace("\\N", " ").strip()
            cps = len(clean) / dur
            if cps > 22.0:
                self.lbl_cps.setStyleSheet("color: #ef4444; font-weight: bold; font-size: 8.5pt;")
                self.lbl_cps.setText(f"CPS: {cps:.1f} ⚠️ (سريع جداً)")
            elif cps > 18.0:
                self.lbl_cps.setStyleSheet("color: #f59e0b; font-weight: bold; font-size: 8.5pt;")
                self.lbl_cps.setText(f"CPS: {cps:.1f} ⚡ (سريع)")
            else:
                self.lbl_cps.setStyleSheet("color: #4ade80; font-weight: bold; font-size: 8.5pt;")
                self.lbl_cps.setText(f"CPS: {cps:.1f} ✓ (ممتاز)")
        except Exception:
            self.lbl_cps.setText("CPS: --")

    def _parse_ms(self, s: str) -> int:
        return parse_timecode_ms_safe(s, default=0)

from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QFrame, QPushButton
)
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from app.ui.bus import EventBus

class LivePreviewWidget(QWidget):
    """
    Displays real-time side-by-side comparison of the original subtitle line
    and the AI-improved, healed translation as each line/batch finishes.
    Supports collapsing to save vertical space.
    """
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        self.layout.setContentsMargins(4, 2, 4, 2)
        self.layout.setSpacing(4)

        # Header with Collapse Toggle
        hdr_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        hdr_layout.setContentsMargins(4, 0, 4, 0)
        
        lbl_title = QLabel("👁️ المعاينة الحية المباشرة (Live Subtitle Preview):")
        lbl_title.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 600; color: #38bdf8; font-size: 9.5pt;")
        hdr_layout.addWidget(lbl_title)
        hdr_layout.addStretch()

        self.btn_toggle = QPushButton("▼ إخفاء المعاينة")
        self.btn_toggle.setCheckable(True)
        self.btn_toggle.setChecked(False)
        self.btn_toggle.setFixedHeight(22)
        self.btn_toggle.setStyleSheet("background: transparent; border: none; color: #71717a; font-size: 8pt;")
        self.btn_toggle.clicked.connect(self._toggle_collapse)
        hdr_layout.addWidget(self.btn_toggle)
        self.layout.addLayout(hdr_layout)

        # Container Frame
        self.preview_box = QFrame()
        self.preview_box.setStyleSheet(
            "QFrame { background-color: #18181b; border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px; }"
        )
        box_layout = QHBoxLayout(self.preview_box)
        box_layout.setContentsMargins(8, 6, 8, 6)
        box_layout.setSpacing(12)

        # Original Line Box
        orig_container = QWidget()
        orig_layout = QVBoxLayout(orig_container)
        orig_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        orig_layout.setSpacing(2)
        
        lbl_orig_head = QLabel("النص الأصلي (Original Line):")
        lbl_orig_head.setStyleSheet("color: #71717a; font-size: 8pt; font-weight: 600;")
        
        self.lbl_orig = QLabel("بانتظار بدء المعالجة...")
        self.lbl_orig.setWordWrap(True)
        self.lbl_orig.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextSelectableByMouse)
        self.lbl_orig.setStyleSheet("color: #e4e4e7; font-size: 9.5pt;")
        
        orig_layout.addWidget(lbl_orig_head)
        orig_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_orig)
        orig_layout.addStretch()

        # Divider
        v_sep = QFrame()
        v_sep.setFrameShape(QFrame.VLine)
        v_sep.setStyleSheet("color: #27272a;")

        # Improved Line Box
        imp_container = QWidget()
        imp_layout = QVBoxLayout(imp_container)
        imp_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        imp_layout.setSpacing(2)
        
        lbl_imp_head = QLabel("التحسين الفائق والمُصفى (Improved Line):")
        lbl_imp_head.setStyleSheet("color: #4ade80; font-size: 8pt; font-weight: 600;")
        
        self.lbl_imp = QLabel("بانتظار بدء المعالجة...")
        self.lbl_imp.setWordWrap(True)
        self.lbl_imp.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextSelectableByMouse)
        self.lbl_imp.setAlignment(Qt.AlignRight | Qt.AlignVCenter)
        self.lbl_imp.setStyleSheet("color: #86efac; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: 600;")
        
        imp_layout.addWidget(lbl_imp_head)
        imp_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_imp)
        imp_layout.addStretch()

        box_layout.addWidget(orig_container, 1)
        box_layout.addWidget(v_sep)
        box_layout.addWidget(imp_container, 1)

        self.layout.addWidget(self.preview_box)

        # Connect to event bus
        EventBus.instance().live_preview_updated.connect(self.update_preview)

    def _toggle_collapse(self):
        collapsed = self.btn_toggle.isChecked()
        self.preview_box.setVisible(not collapsed)
        self.btn_toggle.setText("▲ إظهار المعاينة" if collapsed else "▼ إخفاء المعاينة")

    def update_preview(self, orig_text: str, imp_text: str):
        self.lbl_orig.setText(orig_text or "")
        self.lbl_imp.setText(imp_text or "")

    def clear(self):
        self.lbl_orig.setText("بانتظار بدء المعالجة...")
        self.lbl_imp.setText("بانتظار بدء المعالجة...")

import html
import datetime
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QTextEdit, QPushButton,
    QApplication, QDialog, QLineEdit, QLabel
)
from PySide6.QtGui import QTextCursor
from PySide6.QtCore import Signal, Qt
from app.ui.bus import EventBus

class FullLogDialog(QDialog):
    """Spacious, searchable full-window log viewer for detailed debugging and error tracebacks."""
    def __init__(self, parent=None, full_text=""):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle("📜 سجل العمليات والأخطاء التفصيلي (Full System & Error Log)")
        self.setMinimumSize(850, 600)
        
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(12, 12, 12, 12)
        layout.setSpacing(8)

        # Search Bar
        search_row = QHBoxLayout()
        search_lbl = QLabel("🔍 بحث في السجل:")
        search_lbl.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 600; color: #38bdf8;")
        self.le_search = QLineEdit()
        self.le_search.setPlaceholderText("اكتب كلمة للبحث (مثل: error, ffmpeg, timeout)...")
        self.le_search.textChanged.connect(self._filter_log)
        search_row.addWidget(search_lbl)
        search_row.addWidget(self.le_search, 1)
        layout.addLayout(search_row)

        # Big Text Area
        self.text_view = QTextEdit()
        self.text_view.setReadOnly(True)
        self.text_view.setAcceptRichText(True)
        self.text_view.setHtml(full_text)
        self.full_html = full_text
        layout.addWidget(self.text_view, 1)

        # Bottom Actions
        act_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.btn_copy_all = QPushButton("📋 نسخ السجل بالكامل")
        self.btn_copy_all.clicked.connect(self._copy_all)
        self.btn_close = QPushButton("إغلاق")
        self.btn_close.clicked.connect(self.accept)

        act_row.addWidget(self.btn_copy_all)
        act_row.addStretch()
        act_row.addWidget(self.btn_close)
        layout.addLayout(act_row)

    def _filter_log(self, query: str):
        if not query:
            self.text_view.setHtml(self.full_html)
            return
        plain = self.text_view.toPlainText()
        lines = [line for line in plain.splitlines() if query.lower() in line.lower()]
        self.text_view.setPlainText("\n".join(lines))

    def _copy_all(self):
        QApplication.clipboard().setText(self.text_view.toPlainText())
        self.btn_copy_all.setText("✅ تم النسخ!")


class LogPanel(QWidget):
    expand_toggled = Signal(bool)

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._is_expanded = False
        self.layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        self.layout.setContentsMargins(4, 4, 4, 4)
        self.layout.setSpacing(6)
        
        self.text_edit = QTextEdit()
        self.text_edit.setReadOnly(True)

        self.text_edit.setStyleSheet("""

                background-color: #121214;
                border: 1px solid #27272a;

                font-family: Consolas, "Cascadia Code", "Segoe UI", monospace;
                font-size: 9pt;
                padding: 6px;
            }
        """)
        self.layout.addWidget(self.text_edit)
        
        btn_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        btn_layout.setSpacing(8)

        self.btn_expand = QPushButton("⤢ تكبير السجل")
        self.btn_expand.setToolTip("تكبير نافذة السجل لرؤية رسائل الأخطاء بوضوح")
        self.btn_expand.clicked.connect(self._toggle_expand)

        self.btn_popout = QPushButton("🔍 نافذة السجل الكامل")
        self.btn_popout.setToolTip("فتح السجل في نافذة مستقلة كاملة مع إمكانية البحث")
        self.btn_popout.clicked.connect(self._open_popout)

        self.btn_copy = QPushButton("📋 نسخ السجل")
        self.btn_copy.clicked.connect(self._copy_log)

        self.btn_clear = QPushButton("🧹 مسح")
        self.btn_clear.clicked.connect(self.text_edit.clear)
        
        btn_layout.addWidget(self.btn_expand)
        btn_layout.addWidget(self.btn_popout)
        btn_layout.addStretch()
        btn_layout.addWidget(self.btn_copy)
        btn_layout.addWidget(self.btn_clear)
        self.layout.addLayout(btn_layout)
        
        EventBus.instance().log_message.connect(self.append_log)
        
    def _toggle_expand(self):
        self._is_expanded = not self._is_expanded
        self.btn_expand.setText("⤡ استعادة الحجم" if self._is_expanded else "⤢ تكبير السجل")
        self.expand_toggled.emit(self._is_expanded)

    def _open_popout(self):
        dlg = FullLogDialog(self, full_text=self.text_edit.toHtml())
        dlg.exec()

    def append_log(self, message: str):
        timestamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S")
        safe_msg = html.escape(str(message))
        
        lower_msg = message.lower()
        if any(err in lower_msg for err in ("[error]", "[fatal]", "failed", "exception", "خطأ", "فشل")):
            color = "#f87171"
            badge = "🔴"
            weight = "bold"
            # Render a prominent alert box for errors so the user can easily diagnose issues
            formatted_html = (
                f"<div style='background-color: #271515; border: 1px solid #ef4444; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 8px; margin: 3px 0;'>"
                f"<span style='color: #a1a1aa; font-size: 8pt;'>[{timestamp}]</span> "
                f"<span style='color: {color}; font-weight: {weight};'>{badge} {safe_msg}</span>"
                f"</div>"
            )
        elif any(warn in lower_msg for warn in ("[warn]", "warning", "rate limit", "retrying", "تنبيه")):
            color = "#fbbf24"
            badge = "🟡"
            weight = "600"
            formatted_html = (
                f"<div style='margin-bottom: 2px;'>"
                f"<span style='color: #71717a; font-size: 8pt;'>[{timestamp}]</span> "
                f"<span style='color: {color}; font-weight: {weight};'>{badge} {safe_msg}</span>"
                f"</div>"
            )
        elif any(succ in lower_msg for succ in ("[success]", "finished", "completed", "saved", "connected", "نجاح", "تم")):
            color = "#4ade80"
            badge = "🟢"
            weight = "500"
            formatted_html = (
                f"<div style='margin-bottom: 2px;'>"
                f"<span style='color: #71717a; font-size: 8pt;'>[{timestamp}]</span> "
                f"<span style='color: {color}; font-weight: {weight};'>{badge} {safe_msg}</span>"
                f"</div>"
            )
        else:
            color = "#e4e4e7"
            badge = "ℹ️"
            weight = "normal"
            formatted_html = (
                f"<div style='margin-bottom: 2px;'>"
                f"<span style='color: #71717a; font-size: 8pt;'>[{timestamp}]</span> "
                f"<span style='color: {color}; font-weight: {weight};'>{badge} {safe_msg}</span>"
                f"</div>"
            )

        self.text_edit.append(formatted_html)
        self.text_edit.moveCursor(QTextCursor.End)

    def _copy_log(self):
        plain_text = self.text_edit.toPlainText()
        if plain_text:
            QApplication.clipboard().setText(plain_text)
            self.btn_copy.setText("✅ تم النسخ!")
            self.append_log("Log copied to clipboard! (تم نسخ السجل للحافظة)")
            from PySide6.QtCore import QTimer
            QTimer.singleShot(2000, lambda: self.btn_copy.setText("📋 نسخ السجل"))

        self._set_busy(True)
        EventBus.instance().translation_started.emit()

    def _on_improve(self):
        self._set_busy(True)
        EventBus.instance().improvement_started.emit()

    def _on_external_started(self):
        self._set_busy(True)
        self.lbl_stats.setText("⏳ جاري بدء الترجمة والتدقيق التلقائي...")

    def _on_quick_heal(self):
        self.quick_heal_requested.emit()
        
    def _on_cancel(self):
        self.btn_cancel.setEnabled(False)
        EventBus.instance().translation_cancelled.emit()
        
    def _set_busy(self, is_busy: bool):
        self.btn_start.setEnabled(not is_busy)
        self.btn_improve.setEnabled(not is_busy)
        self.btn_quick_heal.setEnabled(not is_busy)
        self.btn_cancel.setEnabled(is_busy)

    def _reset_controls(self):
        self._set_busy(False)
        
    def _on_progress(self, current, total, status):
        if total > 0:
            val = min(100, max(0, int((current / total) * 100)))
            self.progress_bar.setValue(val)
        self.lbl_stats.setText(status)

        # Setup Background Auto-Detector Timer for LM Studio / Ollama
        self._startup_refresh_timer = QTimer(self)

        self._startup_refresh_timer.timeout.connect(self._safe_startup_refresh)

        self.auto_detect_timer = QTimer(self)
        self.auto_detect_timer.setInterval(10000)
        self.auto_detect_timer.timeout.connect(self._auto_detect_tick)
        self.auto_detect_timer.start()

        # Initialize current provider selection from settings
        self._load_initial_provider()

    def pause_auto_detect(self) -> None:
        """Pause background auto-detection ticks (reference-counted)."""
        self._pause_depth += 1

    def resume_auto_detect(self) -> None:
        """Resume background auto-detection ticks once all active pauses finish."""
        if self._pause_depth > 0:
            self._pause_depth -= 1

    def stop_background_tasks(self) -> None:
        """Stop timers and cancel pending background async tasks cleanly on shutdown."""
        self._stopped = True
        for timer_attr in ("_startup_refresh_timer", "auto_detect_timer"):
            timer = getattr(self, timer_attr, None)
            if timer is not None and timer.isActive():
                timer.stop()
        for attr in ("_probe_task", "_refresh_task", "_test_task"):
            task = getattr(self, attr, None)
            if task is not None and not task.done():
                task.cancel()
            setattr(self, attr, None)

    def _can_run_background_probe(self) -> bool:
        if getattr(self, "_stopped", False) or getattr(self, "_pause_depth", 0) > 0:
            return False
        if self._is_populating or getattr(self, "_probe_running", False):
            return False
        if QApplication.activeModalWidget() is not None or QApplication.activePopupWidget() is not None:
            return False
        for attr in ("_probe_task", "_refresh_task", "_test_task"):
            task = getattr(self, attr, None)
            if task is not None and not task.done():
                return False
        return True

    def _safe_startup_refresh(self) -> None:
        if getattr(self, "_stopped", False) or getattr(self, "_pause_depth", 0) > 0:
            return
        if QApplication.activeModalWidget() is not None or QApplication.activePopupWidget() is not None:
            return
        if self._refresh_task is not None and not self._refresh_task.done():
            return
        try:
            loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
            self._refresh_task = loop.create_task(self._async_refresh_models())
        except RuntimeError:
            pass

    def get_current_provider_type(self) -> str:
        """Returns the currently selected provider type string."""
        return self.cb_provider.currentData() or "lmstudio"

    def _auto_detect_tick(self):
        try:
            ptype = self.get_current_provider_type()
            if ptype in ("lmstudio", "ollama") and self._can_run_background_probe():
                try:
                    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
                    self._probe_task = loop.create_task(self._probe_auto_detect(ptype))
                except RuntimeError:
                    pass
        except Exception:
            pass

    async def _probe_auto_detect(self, ptype: str):
        if getattr(self, '_probe_running', False) or getattr(self, '_stopped', False):
            return
        self._probe_running = True
        provider = None
        try:
            config = self.get_provider_config()
            provider = get_provider(config)
            models = await provider.list_models()
            if models and not getattr(self, '_stopped', False):
                for m in models:
                    self._discovered_models[m.id] = m
                current_selected = self.get_selected_model() or self.settings.model_name
                new_ids = [m.id for m in models]
                existing_ids = [self.cb_models.itemData(i) or self.cb_models.itemText(i) for i in range(self.cb_models.count())]
                
                if new_ids != existing_ids:
                    self._is_populating = True
                    self.cb_models.clear()
                    for m in models:
                        self.cb_models.addItem(m.name, userData=m.id)

                    # Preserve user selection
                    target_idx = -1
                    if current_selected:
                        for i in range(self.cb_models.count()):
                            if self.cb_models.itemData(i) == current_selected or self.cb_models.itemText(i) == current_selected:
                                target_idx = i
                                break

                    # Prioritize ALLaM if available locally
                    if target_idx < 0:
                        for i in range(self.cb_models.count()):
                            mid = str(self.cb_models.itemData(i) or "").lower()
                            if "allam" in mid:
                                target_idx = i
                                break

                    if target_idx < 0:
                        for i in range(self.cb_models.count()):
                            mid = str(self.cb_models.itemData(i) or "").lower()
                            if "qwen2.5" in mid or "qwen-2.5" in mid:
                                target_idx = i
                                break

                    if target_idx < 0:
                        for i in range(self.cb_models.count()):
                            txt = self.cb_models.itemText(i)
                            if "نموذج صور" not in txt and "vlm" not in str(self.cb_models.itemData(i) or "").lower():
                                target_idx = i
                                break

                    self.cb_models.setCurrentIndex(target_idx if target_idx >= 0 else 0)
                    chosen = self.get_selected_model()
                    self._is_populating = False
                    self.lbl_status.setText(f"🟢 متصل تلقائياً: [{chosen}]")
                    self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("color: #4ade80; font-weight: 600;")
                    if chosen:
                        self._detect_and_apply_context(chosen)
                elif not self.cb_models.currentText() and new_ids:
                    chosen = self.get_selected_model()
                    self.lbl_status.setText(f"🟢 متصل: [{chosen}]")
                    self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("color: #4ade80;")
                    if chosen:
                        self._detect_and_apply_context(chosen)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass
        except (ConnectionRefusedError, Exception):
            if not getattr(self, '_stopped', False):
                if "متصل" in self.lbl_status.text() or "الحالة: جاهز" in self.lbl_status.text():
                    self.lbl_status.setText(f"⚪ بانتظار تشغيل خادم {ptype} محلياً...")
                    self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("color: #71717a;")
        finally:
            if provider:
                try:
                    await provider.close()
                except Exception:
                    pass
            self._probe_running = False
            self._probe_task = None

    def _load_initial_provider(self):
        saved_type = self.settings.provider_type or "lmstudio"
        idx = 0
        for i in range(self.cb_provider.count()):
            if self.cb_provider.itemData(i) == saved_type:
                idx = i
                break
        self.cb_provider.setCurrentIndex(idx)
        self._apply_provider_ui(saved_type, is_initial=True)

    def _update_preset_chips(self, ptype: str):
        """Build clickable quick model preset chips arranged in a compact 2-column grid."""
        # Clear existing chips
        while self.preset_chips_layout.count():
            item = self.preset_chips_layout.takeAt(0)
            if item.widget():
                item.widget().deleteLater()

        presets = PROVIDER_MODEL_PRESETS.get(ptype, [])
        for idx, (model_id, desc) in enumerate(presets[:6]):
            short_title = model_id.split("/")[-1].replace(":latest", "")
            btn_chip = QPushButton(short_title)
            btn_chip.setToolTip(f"{model_id}\n{desc}")
            btn_chip.setFixedHeight(24)
            btn_chip.setStyleSheet("""
                QPushButton {
                    background-color: #1f2937;
                    color: #93c5fd;
                    border: 1px solid #374151;
                    border-radius: 12px;
                    padding: 0 8px;
                    font-size: 7.5pt;
                    font-weight: 600;
                }
                QPushButton:hover {
                    background-color: #1e3a8a;
                    color: #ffffff;
                    border-color: #3b82f6;
                }
            """)
            btn_chip.clicked.connect(lambda checked=False, m=model_id: self._select_preset_chip(m))
            row = idx // 2
            col = idx % 2
            self.preset_chips_layout.addWidget(btn_chip, row, col)

    def _select_preset_chip(self, model_id: str):
        """Callback when a preset chip button is clicked."""
        self._is_populating = True
        # Look for model in combobox
        target_idx = -1
        for i in range(self.cb_models.count()):
            if self.cb_models.itemData(i) == model_id:
                target_idx = i
                break

        if target_idx >= 0:
            self.cb_models.setCurrentIndex(target_idx)
        else:
            self.cb_models.addItem(model_id, userData=model_id)
            self.cb_models.setCurrentIndex(self.cb_models.count() - 1)

        self._is_populating = False
        self._on_model_edited(model_id)
        self.lbl_status.setText(f"⚡ تم تفعيل النموذج: {model_id}")
        self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("color: #38bdf8; font-weight: 600;")

    def _apply_provider_ui(self, ptype: str, is_initial: bool = False):
        """Show only relevant input fields based on the selected provider."""
        self._is_populating = True
        self.cb_models.clear()

        # Update quick preset chips
        self._update_preset_chips(ptype)

        # Get presets for this provider
        presets = PROVIDER_MODEL_PRESETS.get(ptype, [])

        if ptype == "lmstudio":
            self.url_container.setVisible(True)
            self.lbl_url.setText("عنوان خادم LM Studio (URL):")
            self.le_url.setText(self.settings.lmstudio_url or "http://localhost:1234/v1")
            self.key_container.setVisible(False)
            self.le_key.clear()
            self.btn_refresh.setEnabled(True)

            for m_id, desc in presets:
                self.cb_models.addItem(f"{m_id} ({desc})", userData=m_id)

            saved_m = self.settings.lmstudio_model or self.settings.model_name or "qwen2.5-7b-instruct"
            self._select_or_add_model(saved_m)

        elif ptype == "ollama":
            self.url_container.setVisible(True)
            self.lbl_url.setText("عنوان خادم Ollama (URL):")
            self.le_url.setText(self.settings.ollama_url or "http://localhost:11434")
            self.key_container.setVisible(False)
            self.le_key.clear()
            self.btn_refresh.setEnabled(True)

            for m_id, desc in presets:
                self.cb_models.addItem(f"{m_id} ({desc})", userData=m_id)

            saved_m = self.settings.ollama_model or "qwen2.5:7b"
            self._select_or_add_model(saved_m)

        elif ptype == "gemini":
            self.url_container.setVisible(False)
            self.key_container.setVisible(True)
            self.lbl_key.setText("مفتاح Google Gemini API Key:")
            self.le_key.setText(self.settings.gemini_api_key or "")
            self.btn_refresh.setEnabled(True)

            for m_id, desc in presets:
                self.cb_models.addItem(f"{m_id} ({desc})", userData=m_id)

            saved_m = self.settings.gemini_model or "gemini-2.5-flash"
            self._select_or_add_model(saved_m)

        elif ptype == "openai":
            self.url_container.setVisible(False)
            self.key_container.setVisible(True)
            self.lbl_key.setText("مفتاح OpenAI API Key:")
            self.le_key.setText(self.settings.openai_api_key or "")
            self.btn_refresh.setEnabled(True)

            for m_id, desc in presets:
                self.cb_models.addItem(f"{m_id} ({desc})", userData=m_id)

            saved_m = self.settings.openai_model or "gpt-4o-mini"
            self._select_or_add_model(saved_m)

        elif ptype == "openai_compatible":
            self.url_container.setVisible(True)
            self.lbl_url.setText("عنوان الـ Base URL:")
            self.le_url.setText(self.settings.custom_url or "https://api.openai.com/v1")
            self.key_container.setVisible(True)
            self.lbl_key.setText("مفتاح API Key:")
            self.le_key.setText(self.settings.custom_api_key or "")
            self.btn_refresh.setEnabled(True)

            for m_id, desc in presets:
                self.cb_models.addItem(f"{m_id} ({desc})", userData=m_id)

            saved_m = self.settings.custom_model or "deepseek-chat"
            self._select_or_add_model(saved_m)

        self._is_populating = False

        # Schedule automatic refresh for local providers on startup safely
        if is_initial and ptype in ("lmstudio", "ollama") and hasattr(self, "_startup_refresh_timer"):
            self._startup_refresh_timer.start(400)

    def _select_or_add_model(self, model_name: str):
        """Helper to find and select a model or append it."""
        if not model_name:
            if self.cb_models.count() > 0:
                self.cb_models.setCurrentIndex(0)
            return

        target_idx = -1
        for i in range(self.cb_models.count()):
            if self.cb_models.itemData(i) == model_name or self.cb_models.itemText(i) == model_name:
                target_idx = i
                break

        if target_idx >= 0:
            self.cb_models.setCurrentIndex(target_idx)
        else:
            self.cb_models.addItem(model_name, userData=model_name)
            self.cb_models.setCurrentIndex(self.cb_models.count() - 1)

    def _toggle_key_visibility(self):
        if self.le_key.echoMode() == QLineEdit.Password:
            self.le_key.setEchoMode(QLineEdit.Normal)
            self.btn_toggle_key.setText("🔒")
        else:
            self.le_key.setEchoMode(QLineEdit.Password)
            self.btn_toggle_key.setText("👁️")

    def _on_provider_changed(self, index: int):
        """Immediately responds to provider selection without requiring reload."""
        ptype = self.cb_provider.currentData()
        self.settings.provider_type = ptype
        self.settings.save_to_file()

        # Apply UI layout and presets immediately
        self._apply_provider_ui(ptype)

        current_label = self.cb_provider.currentText()
        selected_m = self.get_selected_model()
        self.lbl_status.setText(f"🟢 تم التبديل إلى: {current_label}")
        self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("color: #38bdf8; font-weight: 600;")

        if selected_m:
            EventBus.instance().model_selected.emit(selected_m)

        # Auto-refresh if local server
        if ptype in ("lmstudio", "ollama"):
            self.refresh_models()

    def _on_url_edited(self, text: str):
        if self._is_populating:
            return
        ptype = self.cb_provider.currentData()
        clean_text = text.strip()
        if ptype == "lmstudio":
            self.settings.lmstudio_url = clean_text
            self.settings.provider_url = clean_text
        elif ptype == "ollama":
            self.settings.ollama_url = clean_text
            self.settings.provider_url = clean_text
        elif ptype == "openai_compatible":
            self.settings.custom_url = clean_text
            self.settings.provider_url = clean_text
        self.settings.save_to_file()

    def _on_key_edited(self, text: str):
        if self._is_populating:
            return
        ptype = self.cb_provider.currentData()
        clean_key = text.strip()
        if ptype == "gemini":
            self.settings.gemini_api_key = clean_key
        elif ptype == "openai":
            self.settings.openai_api_key = clean_key
        elif ptype == "openai_compatible":
            self.settings.custom_api_key = clean_key
        self.settings.save_to_file()

    def _on_model_edited(self, model: str):
        if self._is_populating or not model:
            return
        if any(keyword in model for keyword in ("Error", "Searching", "Loading", "No models", "لم يتم")):
            return
            
        clean_model = self.get_selected_model()
        if not clean_model:
            return

        ptype = self.cb_provider.currentData()
        if ptype == "lmstudio":
            self.settings.lmstudio_model = clean_model
        elif ptype == "ollama":
            self.settings.ollama_model = clean_model
        elif ptype == "gemini":
            self.settings.gemini_model = clean_model
        elif ptype == "openai":
            self.settings.openai_model = clean_model
        elif ptype == "openai_compatible":
            self.settings.custom_model = clean_model
            
        self.settings.model_name = clean_model
        self.settings.save_to_file()
        self._detect_and_apply_context(clean_model)
        EventBus.instance().model_selected.emit(clean_model)

    def _on_max_context_changed(self, val: int):
        self.settings.max_context = val
        self.settings.save_to_file()

    def _on_parallel_changed(self, val: int):
        self.settings.concurrency = val
        self.settings.save_to_file()

    def _detect_and_apply_context(self, model_id: str):
        if not model_id:
            return
        m_lower = model_id.lower()
        auto_ctx = None

        if hasattr(self, '_discovered_models') and model_id in self._discovered_models:
            m_info = self._discovered_models[model_id]
            if m_info.context_length:
                auto_ctx = m_info.context_length

        if not auto_ctx:
            if "allam" in m_lower:
                auto_ctx = 4096
            elif "qwen2.5" in m_lower or "qwen-2.5" in m_lower:
                auto_ctx = 32768
            elif "ministral" in m_lower or "mistral" in m_lower:
                auto_ctx = 32768
            elif "gemma" in m_lower:
                auto_ctx = 8192
            elif "gemini" in m_lower:
                auto_ctx = 128000
            elif any(k in m_lower for k in ("gpt-4", "o1", "o3", "deepseek")):
                auto_ctx = 64000
            else:
                auto_ctx = getattr(self.settings, 'max_context', 4096)

        if auto_ctx:
            self.sb_max_context.setValue(auto_ctx)
            self.settings.max_context = auto_ctx
            self.settings.save_to_file()
            self.lbl_context_badge.setText(f"✓ سياق تلقائي للنموذج: {auto_ctx} توكن")
            self.lbl_context_badge.setStyleSheet("color: #4ade80; font-size: 7.5pt; font-weight: 600;")

    def get_provider_config(self) -> ProviderConfig:
        """Constructs ProviderConfig with the selected provider, URL, and API key."""
        ptype_str = self.cb_provider.currentData()
        
        if ptype_str == "gemini":
            return ProviderConfig(
                provider_type=ProviderType.GEMINI,
                base_url="https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai",
                api_key=self.le_key.text().strip(),
                timeout=120
            )
        elif ptype_str == "openai":
            return ProviderConfig(
                provider_type=ProviderType.OPENAI,
                base_url="https://api.openai.com/v1",
                api_key=self.le_key.text().strip(),
                timeout=120
            )
        elif ptype_str == "ollama":
            return ProviderConfig(
                provider_type=ProviderType.OLLAMA,
                base_url=self.le_url.text().strip() or "http://localhost:11434",
                timeout=120
            )
        elif ptype_str == "openai_compatible":
            return ProviderConfig(
                provider_type=ProviderType.OPENAI_COMPATIBLE,
                base_url=self.le_url.text().strip() or "https://api.openai.com/v1",
                api_key=self.le_key.text().strip() or None,
                timeout=120
            )
        else:  # lmstudio
            return ProviderConfig(
                provider_type=ProviderType.LM_STUDIO,
                base_url=self.le_url.text().strip() or "http://localhost:1234/v1",
                timeout=120
            )

    def get_selected_model(self) -> str:
        """Returns the actual model identifier, stripping any descriptive annotations."""
        idx = self.cb_models.currentIndex()
        if idx >= 0:
            data = self.cb_models.itemData(idx)
            if data:
                return str(data).strip()
        model = self.cb_models.currentText().strip()
        if not model or any(k in model for k in ("Error", "Loading", "Searching", "No models", "لم يتم")):
            return ""
        if " (" in model:
            model = model.split(" (")[0].strip()
        if " [" in model:
            model = model.split(" [")[0].strip()
        return model

    def refresh_models(self):
        if getattr(self, "_stopped", False):
            return
        if self._refresh_task is not None and not self._refresh_task.done():
            return
        try:
            loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
            self._refresh_task = loop.create_task(self._async_refresh_models())
        except RuntimeError:
            pass

    def test_connection(self):
        if getattr(self, "_stopped", False):
            return
        if self._test_task is not None and not self._test_task.done():
            return
        try:
            loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
            self._test_task = loop.create_task(self._async_test_connection())
        except RuntimeError:
            pass

    async def _async_refresh_models(self):
        self.btn_refresh.setEnabled(False)
        self.lbl_status.setText("الحالة: جاري جلب النماذج من المزود...")
        self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("color: #38bdf8;")

        config = self.get_provider_config()
        provider = None

        try:
            provider = get_provider(config)
            models = await provider.list_models()
            if getattr(self, "_stopped", False):
                return
            self._is_populating = True
            current_selected = self.get_selected_model() or self.settings.model_name
            self.cb_models.clear()

            if models:
                for m in models:
                    self._discovered_models[m.id] = m
                    self.cb_models.addItem(m.name, userData=m.id)
                self.lbl_status.setText(f"الحالة: متصل بنجاح ({len(models)} نموذج متاح) ✅")
                self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("color: #10B981; font-weight: 600;")

                # Restore previously selected model or pick recommended (prioritizing ALLaM)
                target_idx = -1
                if current_selected:
                    for i in range(self.cb_models.count()):
                        if self.cb_models.itemData(i) == current_selected or self.cb_models.itemText(i) == current_selected:
                            target_idx = i
                            break

                if target_idx < 0:
                    for i in range(self.cb_models.count()):
                        mid = str(self.cb_models.itemData(i) or "").lower()
                        if "allam" in mid:
                            target_idx = i
                            break

                if target_idx < 0:
                    for i in range(self.cb_models.count()):
                        mid = str(self.cb_models.itemData(i) or "").lower()
                        if "qwen2.5" in mid or "qwen-2.5" in mid:
                            target_idx = i
                            break

                if target_idx < 0:
                    for i in range(self.cb_models.count()):
                        txt = self.cb_models.itemText(i)
                        if "نموذج صور" not in txt and "vlm" not in str(self.cb_models.itemData(i) or "").lower():
                            target_idx = i
                            break

                self.cb_models.setCurrentIndex(target_idx if target_idx >= 0 else 0)
                selected_clean = self.get_selected_model()
                if selected_clean:
                    self._detect_and_apply_context(selected_clean)
                EventBus.instance().log_message.emit(
                    f"Found {len(models)} models from {config.provider_type.value}. Selected: {selected_clean}"
                )
                EventBus.instance().model_selected.emit(selected_clean)
            else:
                self.cb_models.addItem("No models found")
                self.lbl_status.setText("الحالة: لم يتم العثور على نماذج ⚠️")
                self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("color: #F59E0B;")
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass
        except Exception as e:
            if not getattr(self, "_stopped", False):
                self.lbl_status.setText("الحالة: تعذر الاتصال بالخادم ❌")
                self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("color: #EF4444;")
                EventBus.instance().log_message.emit(f"Provider connection error: {str(e)}")
        finally:
            if provider:
                try:
                    await provider.close()
                except Exception:
                    pass
            self._is_populating = False
            self._refresh_task = None
            if not getattr(self, "_stopped", False):
                self.btn_refresh.setEnabled(True)

    async def _async_test_connection(self):
        self.btn_test.setEnabled(False)
        self.lbl_status.setText("الحالة: جاري فحص الاتصال بالمزود...")
        self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("color: #38bdf8;")
        
        config = self.get_provider_config()
        provider = None

        try:
            provider = get_provider(config)
            avail = await provider.is_available()
            if getattr(self, "_stopped", False):
                return
            if avail:
                self.lbl_status.setText("الحالة: متصل وجاهز للعمل بنجاح ✅")
                self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("color: #10B981; font-weight: 600;")
                EventBus.instance().log_message.emit(f"Successfully connected to {config.provider_type.value}!")
            else:
                self.lbl_status.setText("الحالة: الخادم غير متصل أو لا يستجيب ❌")
                self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("color: #EF4444; font-weight: 600;")
                EventBus.instance().log_message.emit(f"Failed to connect to {config.provider_type.value}. Check URL or API Key.")
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass
        except Exception as e:
            if not getattr(self, "_stopped", False):
                self.lbl_status.setText("الحالة: خطأ في الاتصال ❌")
                self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("color: #EF4444;")
                EventBus.instance().log_message.emit(f"Test connection error: {str(e)}")
        finally:
            if provider:
                try:
                    await provider.close()
                except Exception:
                    pass
            self._test_task = None
            if not getattr(self, "_stopped", False):
                self.btn_test.setEnabled(True)

class IntStepper(QWidget):
    """

    """
    valueChanged = Signal(int)

    def __init__(self, min_val: int = 1, max_val: int = 100, val: int = 10, step: int = 1, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)

        self.btn_minus.setStyleSheet("""

            }

                background-color: #3f3f46;
                border-color: #38bdf8;

            }
            QPushButton:pressed {
                background-color: #18181b;
            }
        """)

        self.spin = QSpinBox()
        self.spin.setRange(min_val, max_val)

        self.btn_plus = QPushButton("+")

        self.spin.valueChanged.connect(self.valueChanged.emit)

        layout.addWidget(self.btn_minus)
        layout.addWidget(self.spin, 1)
        layout.addWidget(self.btn_plus)

    def value(self) -> int:
        return self.spin.value()

    def setValue(self, v: int):
        self.spin.setValue(v)

    def setRange(self, mn: int, mx: int):
        self.spin.setRange(mn, mx)

    def setSingleStep(self, s: int):
        self.spin.setSingleStep(s)

        super().setToolTip(t)

        if "كشف تلقائي" in text or "Auto" in text:
            return "Auto Detect"
        if " " in text:
            return text.split(" ")[0].strip()
        return text

    def get_target_lang_clean(self) -> str:
        text = self.cb_target.currentText()
        if " " in text:
            return text.split(" ")[0].strip()
        return text

    def _clear_cache(self):

        from app.ui.bus import EventBus
        try:
            db = DatabaseManager()

            self.btn_clear_cache.setText("✅ تم مسح كل ذواكر الترجمة المؤقتة والكاش بنجاح!")

            EventBus.instance().log_message.emit("🧹 All translation memory, checkpoints and API caches cleared successfully.")
        except Exception as e:
            EventBus.instance().log_message.emit(f"Failed to clear cache: {e}")

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QTableView, QStyledItemDelegate, QStyleOptionViewItem, QHeaderView
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, QRect
from PySide6.QtGui import QPainter, QColor, QPen

class StatusBadgeDelegate(QStyledItemDelegate):
    def paint(self, painter: QPainter, option: QStyleOptionViewItem, index):
        if index.column() == 6:
            status = str(index.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole) or "Pending")
            painter.save()
            
            # Select colors based on status
            bg_color = QColor(63, 63, 70)
            text_color = QColor(228, 228, 231)
            
            if status in ("Translating", "Improving"):
                bg_color = QColor(2, 132, 199)
                text_color = QColor(255, 255, 255)
            elif status == "Done":
                bg_color = QColor(22, 163, 74)
                text_color = QColor(255, 255, 255)
            elif status in ("مؤثرات (FX)", "FX / مؤثرات", "FX"):
                bg_color = QColor(99, 102, 241) # Elegant Indigo/Purple for Visual Effects
                text_color = QColor(255, 255, 255)
            elif status == "Error":
                bg_color = QColor(220, 38, 38)
                text_color = QColor(255, 255, 255)
            elif status == "Warning":
                bg_color = QColor(217, 119, 6)
                text_color = QColor(0, 0, 0)
                
            rect = option.rect
            margin_y = 5
            margin_x = 6
            badge_rect = QRect(rect.left() + margin_x, rect.top() + margin_y, rect.width() - 2*margin_x, rect.height() - 2*margin_y)
            
            painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
            painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
            painter.setBrush(bg_color)
            painter.drawRoundedRect(badge_rect, 5, 5)
            
            painter.setPen(QPen(text_color))
            painter.drawText(badge_rect, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter, status)
            
            painter.restore()
        else:
            super().paint(painter, option, index)

class SubtitleTableView(QTableView):
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.setSelectionBehavior(QTableView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.setEditTriggers(
            QTableView.EditTrigger.DoubleClicked |
            QTableView.EditTrigger.EditKeyPressed |
            QTableView.EditTrigger.AnyKeyPressed
        )
        self.verticalHeader().hide()
        self.verticalHeader().setDefaultSectionSize(32)
        
        # Apply delegate for status badge
        self.setItemDelegateForColumn(6, StatusBadgeDelegate(self))
        
    def setModel(self, model):
        super().setModel(model)
        header = self.horizontalHeader()
        header.setStretchLastSection(False)
        
        # Fixed size metadata columns
        self.setColumnWidth(0, 48)  # ID
        self.setColumnWidth(1, 85)  # Start
        self.setColumnWidth(2, 85)  # End
        self.setColumnWidth(3, 95)  # Speaker
        self.setColumnWidth(6, 95)  # Status
        
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Fixed)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(1, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Fixed)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(2, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Fixed)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(3, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(4, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)  # Original text
        header.setSectionResizeMode(5, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)  # Translated Arabic
        header.setSectionResizeMode(6, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Fixed)
