```python
        act_toggle_fx.triggered.connect(self.btn_toggle_fx.click)

        menu.exec(self.table_view.viewport().mapToGlobal(pos))

    def _play_selected_in_video(self):
        selected = [idx.row() for idx in self.table_view.selectionModel().selectedRows()]
        if selected and self.document:
            ev = self.document.events[selected[0]]
            if ev.start_time:
                self._on_play_line_in_video(ev.start_time)

    def _copy_selected_translation(self):
        selected = [idx.row() for idx in self.table_view.selectionModel().selectedRows()]
        if selected and self.document:
            texts = [self.document.events[r].translated_text or "" for r in selected if r < len(self.document.events)]
            QApplication.clipboard().setText("\n".join(texts))

    def _copy_selected_original(self):
        selected = [idx.row() for idx in self.table_view.selectionModel().selectedRows()]
        if selected and self.document:
            texts = [self.document.events[r].original_text or "" for r in selected if r < len(self.document.events)]
            QApplication.clipboard().setText("\n".join(texts))

    def _open_shift_timings_dialog(self):
        if not self.table_model.events:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "تنبيه", "لا توجد أسطر ترجمة محملة لتعديل التوقيت.")
            return
        selected_rows = [idx.row() for idx in self.table_view.selectionModel().selectedRows()]
        has_selection = len(selected_rows) > 0
        sample_time = ""
        if has_selection and selected_rows[0] < len(self.table_model.events):
            sample_time = self.table_model.events[selected_rows[0]].start_time
        elif self.table_model.events:
            sample_time = self.table_model.events[0].start_time

        dlg = ShiftTimingsDialog(self, has_selection=has_selection, sample_start_time=sample_time)
        if dlg.exec():
            offset_ms = dlg.get_offset_ms()
            rows_to_shift = selected_rows if (dlg.is_selected_only() and has_selection) else None
            cmd = ShiftTimingsCommand(self.table_model, offset_ms, rows_to_shift)
            self.undo_stack.push(cmd)
            direction_str = "تأخير الظهور (+)" if offset_ms > 0 else "تقديم الظهور (-)"
            count_str = f"{len(rows_to_shift)} سطر محدد" if rows_to_shift else "كل أسطر الترجمة"
            EventBus.instance().log_message.emit(f"⏱️ تم {direction_str} بمقدار {abs(offset_ms)} مللي ثانية لـ ({count_str}).")
            curr_row = self.table_view.currentIndex().row()
            if self.document and 0 <= curr_row < len(self.document.events) and hasattr(self, 'inline_editor'):
                self.inline_editor.load_event(curr_row, self.document.events[curr_row], len(self.document.events))
            if self.document:
                self._save_file_auto()
                if hasattr(self, 'video_player'):
                    self.video_player.set_subtitles_for_overlay(self.document.events)

    def _merge_selected_lines(self):
        selected_rows = [idx.row() for idx in self.table_view.selectionModel().selectedRows()]
        if len(selected_rows) < 2:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "تنبيه", "الرجاء تحديد سطرين أو أكثر لدمجهما معاً.")
            return
        ok = self.table_model.merge_lines(selected_rows)
        if ok:
            EventBus.instance().log_message.emit(f"🔗 تم دمج {len(selected_rows)} أسطر بنجاح.")
            first_row = min(selected_rows)
            if self.document and 0 <= first_row < len(self.document.events) and hasattr(self, 'inline_editor'):
                self.inline_editor.load_event(first_row, self.document.events[first_row], len(self.document.events))
            if self.document:
                self._save_file_auto()
                if hasattr(self, 'video_player'):
                    self.video_player.set_subtitles_for_overlay(self.document.events)

    def _split_selected_line(self):
        selected_rows = [idx.row() for idx in self.table_view.selectionModel().selectedRows()]
        if not selected_rows:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "تنبيه", "الرجاء تحديد السطر المراد تقسيمه أولاً.")
            return
        target_row = selected_rows[0]
        split_at_ms = None
        if hasattr(self, 'video_player') and not self.video_container.isHidden():
            split_at_ms = self.video_player.get_current_position_ms()
        ok = self.table_model.split_line(target_row, split_at_ms=split_at_ms)
        if ok:
            EventBus.instance().log_message.emit(f"✂️ تم تقسيم السطر #{target_row + 1} إلى سطرين بنجاح.")
            if self.document and 0 <= target_row < len(self.document.events) and hasattr(self, 'inline_editor'):
                self.inline_editor.load_event(target_row, self.document.events[target_row], len(self.document.events))
            if self.document:
                self._save_file_auto()
                if hasattr(self, 'video_player'):
                    self.video_player.set_subtitles_for_overlay(self.document.events)

    def _cleanup_temp_files(self):
        for p in list(self.temp_extracted_files):
            try:
                if os.path.exists(p):
                    os.remove(p)
            except Exception:
                pass
        self.temp_extracted_files.clear()

    def closeEvent(self, event):
        if self._translation_task and not self._translation_task.done():
            self._translation_task.cancel()
        if hasattr(self, 'provider_panel') and hasattr(self.provider_panel, 'stop_background_tasks'):
            self.provider_panel.stop_background_tasks()
        if hasattr(self, 'metadata_service') and hasattr(self.metadata_service, 'aclose'):
            try:
                loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
                if loop.is_running():
                    loop.create_task(self.metadata_service.aclose())
            except RuntimeError:
                pass
        self._cleanup_temp_files()
        if hasattr(self, 'video_player'):
            self.video_player.cleanup()
        if hasattr(self, 'db') and hasattr(self.db, 'close'):
            self.db.close()
        super().closeEvent(event)

    def _new_session(self):
        self._cleanup_temp_files()
        if self.current_file_path:
            CheckpointManager.cleanup(self.current_file_path)
        for f in self.selected_files:
            CheckpointManager.cleanup(f)
            
        self.video_origin_map.clear()
        self.temp_extracted_files.clear()
        self.detected_source_lang = None
        self.stream_lang_code = None
        self.settings_panel.set_detected_language("")
        self.document = None
        self.current_file_path = None
        self.selected_files = []
        self.glossary_entries = []
        self.table_model.set_events([])
        self.character_panel.table.setRowCount(0)
        self.character_panel.lbl_anime_title.setText("العمل: لم يتم الكشف بعد (No Media Detected)")
        self.file_panel.lbl_selected.setText("اسحب وأفلت الفيديوهات أو ملفات الترجمة هنا مباشرة (Drag & Drop)")
        self.log_panel.text_edit.clear()
        self.live_preview.clear()
        if hasattr(self, 'inline_editor'):
            self.inline_editor.clear()
        if hasattr(self, 'undo_stack'):
            self.undo_stack.clear()
        if hasattr(self, 'find_replace_bar'):
            self.find_replace_bar.hide_bar()
        if hasattr(self, 'video_player'):
            self.video_player.subtitles = []
            self.video_player.cleanup()
        self.current_video_file = None
        self.video_container.setVisible(False)
        self.btn_toggle_video.setText("🎬 مشغل الوسائط والمعاينة الحية (طافي لتوفير موارد الجهاز - اضغط للفتح)")
        self.btn_toggle_video.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton {
                background-color: #18181b;
                color: #94a3b8;
                font-weight: 600;
                font-size: 8.5pt;
                border: 1px solid #27272a;
                border-radius: 5px;
                padding: 3px 12px;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                background-color: #27272a;
                color: #38bdf8;
                border-color: #0284c7;
            }
        """)
        self.progress_panel.lbl_stats.setText("جاهز للعمل | الأسطر: 0/0 | السرعة: 0.0 سطر/ث | الوقت المتبقي: --:--")
        self.progress_panel.progress_bar.setValue(0)
        self.is_fresh_session = True
        
        # Purge translation memory and cache from database
        try:
            self.db.clear_cache()
        except Exception:
            pass
            
        EventBus.instance().log_message.emit("🧹 تم بدء جلسة جديدة كلياً وتفريغ كل ذواكر الترجمة والملفات المؤقتة بنجاح (Fresh Session).")

    def _open_review_dialog(self):
        if not self.document:
            EventBus.instance().log_message.emit("No document loaded to review.")
            return
        dlg = TranslationReviewDialog(self, document=self.document)
        if dlg.exec():
            self.table_model.set_events(self.document.events)
            self.table_model.layoutChanged.emit()
            self._save_file_auto()
            EventBus.instance().log_message.emit("Translation edits saved and updated in document.")

    def _save_file(self):
        if not self.document or not self.current_file_path:
            EventBus.instance().log_message.emit("No document to save.")
            return
            
        from PySide6.QtWidgets import QFileDialog
        from pathlib import Path
        
        orig_target = self.video_origin_map.get(self.current_file_path, self.current_file_path)
        orig_path = Path(orig_target)
        target_ext = orig_path.suffix if orig_path.suffix.lower() in ('.ass', '.srt', '.vtt') else '.ass'
        default_save_path = str(orig_path.with_name(f"{orig_path.stem}.ara{target_ext}"))
        
        file_path, _ = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self, "Save Translated Subtitle", default_save_path, "All Files (*)"
        )
        
        if file_path:
            try:
                write_subtitle(self.document, file_path)
                EventBus.instance().log_message.emit(f"Successfully saved to {file_path}")
            except Exception as e:
                EventBus.instance().log_message.emit(f"Failed to save file: {e}")
                
    def _save_file_auto(self, file_path: str = None):
        if not self.document:
            return
        target_path = file_path or self.current_file_path
        if not target_path:
            self._save_file()
            return
            
        from pathlib import Path
        
        # Check if the subtitle was extracted from a video
        if target_path in self.video_origin_map:
            video_path = Path(self.video_origin_map[target_path])
            video_dir = video_path.parent
            video_stem = video_path.stem
            
            # If the video directory was renamed or moved while processing
            if not video_dir.exists():
                parent_dir = video_dir.parent
                if parent_dir.exists():
                    candidates = list(parent_dir.glob(f"**/{video_path.name}"))
                    if candidates:
                        video_path = candidates[0]
                        video_dir = video_path.parent
                        self.video_origin_map[target_path] = str(video_path)
                os.makedirs(video_dir, exist_ok=True)
            else:
                os.makedirs(video_dir, exist_ok=True)

            # Save only the Arabic subtitle next to the video
            auto_save_path = str(video_dir / f"{video_stem}.ara.ass")
            
            # Immediately remove the temporary extracted subtitle so no raw subtitle is left
            try:
                if os.path.exists(target_path):
                    os.remove(target_path)
                self.temp_extracted_files.discard(target_path)
            except Exception as e:
                EventBus.instance().log_message.emit(f"Notice: Cleaning temp extracted file: {e}")

            # If an old raw [video_stem].ass was left next to the video from earlier runs, clean it up
            stray_raw_ass = video_dir / f"{video_stem}.ass"
            if stray_raw_ass.exists() and str(stray_raw_ass) != auto_save_path:
                try:
                    os.remove(stray_raw_ass)
                except Exception:
                    pass
        else:
            orig_path = Path(target_path)
            stem = orig_path.stem
            if stem.endswith(".ara"):
                stem = stem[:-4]
            elif stem.endswith("_improved"):
                stem = stem[:-9]
            auto_save_path = str(orig_path.with_name(f"{stem}.ara{orig_path.suffix}"))
            
        try:
            write_subtitle(self.document, auto_save_path)
            EventBus.instance().log_message.emit(f"💾 تم حفظ ملف الترجمة المعتمد والمصقول في: {auto_save_path}")
            
            # Update current active file pointer
            self.current_file_path = auto_save_path
            
            # If target_path was a temporary extracted file, update selected_files to the saved file
            if target_path in self.video_origin_map or target_path in self.temp_extracted_files:
                if target_path in self.selected_files:
                    idx = self.selected_files.index(target_path)
                    self.selected_files[idx] = auto_save_path
                elif file_path and file_path in self.selected_files:
                    idx = self.selected_files.index(file_path)
                    self.selected_files[idx] = auto_save_path
            
            # Check if bilingual export is selected
            export_mode = self.settings_panel.cb_export.currentText()
            if "Bilingual" in export_mode or "ثنائي" in export_mode:
                if target_path in self.video_origin_map:
                    video_path = Path(self.video_origin_map[target_path])
                    bi_save_path = str(video_path.parent / f"{video_path.stem}.bi.ass")
                else:
                    orig_path = Path(target_path)
                    bi_save_path = str(orig_path.with_name(f"{stem}.bi{orig_path.suffix}"))
                from copy import deepcopy
                bi_doc = deepcopy(self.document)
                for ev in bi_doc.events:
                    if ev.translated_text:
                        clean_orig = ev.get_clean_text()
                        if getattr(bi_doc, "format", None) and getattr(bi_doc.format, "value", "") == "ass":
                            ev.translated_text = f"{ev.translated_text}\\N{{\\rDefault\\fs14\\c&HCCCCCC&}}{clean_orig}"
                        else:
                            ev.translated_text = f"{ev.translated_text}\n{clean_orig}"
                write_subtitle(bi_doc, bi_save_path)
                EventBus.instance().log_message.emit(f"Auto-saved bilingual file to: {bi_save_path}")
        except Exception as e:
            EventBus.instance().log_message.emit(f"Failed auto-save: {e}")

    def _save_file_improved(self, file_path: str = None):
        """Deprecated: Saves directly into the unified single .ara file."""
        self._save_file_auto(file_path)
        
    def _open_char_add(self):
        dlg = CharacterEditorDialog(self, initial_data={"row": None})
        dlg.exec()

    def _open_char_editor(self):
        selected_data = self.character_panel.get_selected_character()
        dlg = CharacterEditorDialog(self, initial_data=selected_data)
        dlg.exec()
        
    def _open_glossary_editor(self):
        dlg = GlossaryEditorDialog(self, initial_entries=self.glossary_entries)
        if dlg.exec():
            self.glossary_entries = dlg.get_glossary_entries()
            EventBus.instance().log_message.emit(f"Saved {len(self.glossary_entries)} glossary entries for this session.")
        
    def _open_anime_search(self):
        dlg = AnimeSearchDialog(self, metadata_service=self.metadata_service)
        if dlg.exec():
            selected = dlg.selected_media or dlg.selected_anime
            if selected:
                title = selected.display_title
                m_type = "TV Series" if selected.media_type == "tv" else ("Movie" if selected.media_type == "movie" else "Anime")
                self.character_panel.lbl_anime_title.setText(f"{m_type}: {title}")
                self.character_panel.table.setRowCount(0)
                try:
                    for char in dlg.selected_characters:
                        if hasattr(char, 'gender') and hasattr(char.gender, 'value'):
                            gender_str = char.gender.value
                        elif hasattr(char, 'gender_info') and hasattr(char.gender_info.gender, 'value'):
                            gender_str = char.gender_info.gender.value
                        else:
                            gender_str = str(getattr(char, 'gender', 'UNKNOWN'))

                        conf = getattr(char, 'gender_confidence', None)
                        if conf is None and hasattr(char, 'gender_info'):
                            conf = getattr(char.gender_info, 'confidence', 0.0)

                        src = getattr(char, 'gender_source', None)
                        if src is None and hasattr(char, 'gender_info'):
                            src = getattr(char.gender_info, 'source', '')

                        self.character_panel.add_character(
                            char.canonical_name or "",
                            char.arabic_name or "",
                            gender_str or "",
                            conf if conf is not None else 0.0,
                            src or ""
                        )
                except Exception as e:
                    EventBus.instance().log_message.emit(f"Error adding characters: {e}")
                    import traceback
                    traceback.print_exc()

    def dragEnterEvent(self, event: QDragEnterEvent):
        if event.mimeData().hasUrls():
            event.acceptProposedAction()
            return
        event.ignore()

    def dropEvent(self, event: QDropEvent):
        urls = event.mimeData().urls()
        if urls:
            paths = [url.toLocalFile() for url in urls if url.isLocalFile()]
            if paths:
                self.file_panel._handle_incoming_paths(paths)
                event.acceptProposedAction()
```

```python
import re

def timestamp_to_seconds(ts: str) -> float:
    """Converts subtitle timestamp (00:01:02.500 or 0:00:01.00) to seconds."""
    if not ts or not ts.strip():
        return 0.0

    clean_ts = ts.strip().replace(",", ".")
    parts = clean_ts.split(":")
    try:
        if len(parts) == 3:
            h, m, s = float(parts[0]), float(parts[1]), float(parts[2])
            return h * 3600.0 + m * 60.0 + s
        elif len(parts) == 2:
            m, s = float(parts[0]), float(parts[1])
            return m * 60.0 + s
    except Exception:
        pass
    return 0.0

def calculate_cps(text: str, start_ts: str, end_ts: str) -> float:
    """Calculates Characters Per Second (CPS) for subtitle reading speed."""
    if not text or not start_ts or not end_ts:
        return 0.0

    start_sec = timestamp_to_seconds(start_ts)
    end_sec = timestamp_to_seconds(end_ts)
    duration = end_sec - start_sec

    if duration <= 0.2:
        return 0.0

    clean_text = re.sub(r"\{[^}]*\}", "", text)
    clean_len = len(clean_text.strip().replace("\n", " ").replace("\\N", " "))
    return clean_len / duration

def format_line_length(text: str, max_chars: int = 42) -> str:
    """Wraps text so no individual line exceeds max_chars, breaking cleanly at spaces."""
    if not text or len(text) <= max_chars or "\n" in text or "\\N" in text:
        return text

    words = text.split()
    lines = []
    current_line = []
    current_len = 0

    for word in words:
        space_needed = 1 if current_line else 0
        if current_len + len(word) + space_needed <= max_chars:
            current_line.append(word)
            current_len += len(word) + space_needed
        else:
            if current_line:
                lines.append(" ".join(current_line))
            current_line = [word]
            current_len = len(word)

    if current_line:
        lines.append(" ".join(current_line))

    return "\\N".join(lines)
```

```python
import os
import sys
import subprocess

def create_shortcut():
    desktop = os.path.normpath(os.path.expanduser("~/Desktop"))
    path = os.path.join(desktop, "SubNova Studio.lnk")
    
    python_dir = os.path.dirname(sys.executable)
    pythonw_exe = os.path.join(python_dir, "pythonw.exe")
    if not os.path.exists(pythonw_exe):
        pythonw_exe = sys.executable
    
    current_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
    exe_path = os.path.join(current_dir, "dist", "SubNovaStudio.exe")
    target_script = os.path.join(current_dir, "main.py")
    icon_file = os.path.join(current_dir, "app", "resources", "icons", "subnova_icon.ico")
    
    if os.path.exists(exe_path):
        target_path = exe_path
        args_str = ""
        icon_location = f"{exe_path},0"
        work_dir = os.path.dirname(exe_path)
    else:
        target_path = pythonw_exe
        args_str = f'"{target_script}"'
        icon_location = f"{icon_file},0" if os.path.exists(icon_file) else sys.executable
        work_dir = current_dir

    try:
        import win32com.client
        shell = win32com.client.Dispatch("WScript.Shell")
        shortcut = shell.CreateShortCut(path)
        shortcut.Targetpath = target_path
        shortcut.Arguments = args_str
        shortcut.WorkingDirectory = work_dir
        shortcut.IconLocation = icon_location
        shortcut.Description = "SubNova Studio — المترجم والمدقق الخارق للشاشة | تطوير حاتم الحربي © 2026"
        shortcut.WindowStyle = 1
        shortcut.save()
        print(f"Shortcut created successfully at: {path}")
    except Exception as e:
        # Fallback using powershell safely without shell=True or os.system
        icon_arg = f';$s.IconLocation="{icon_location}"'
        args_arg = f';$s.Arguments="`"{args_str}`""' if args_str else ';$s.Arguments=""'
        cmd = f'$s=(New-Object -COM WScript.Shell).CreateShortcut("{path}");$s.TargetPath="{target_path}"{args_arg};$s.WorkingDirectory="{work_dir}"{icon_arg};$s.Description="SubNova Studio | حاتم الحربي";$s.Save()'
        subprocess.run(["powershell", "-NoProfile", "-Command", cmd], shell=False, check=False)
        print(f"Shortcut created at: {path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    create_shortcut()
```

```python
import re
import sys
from app.subtitle import parse_subtitle

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

file_path = r"c:\Users\hatim alharbi\Downloads\My Girlfriends Friend S01E04.ara.ass"
doc = parse_subtitle(file_path)

print(f"Total lines: {len(doc.events)}")

for i, ev in enumerate(doc.events, 1):
    text = ev.translated_text or ev.original_text
    
    # Check 1: Empty tags like {\i1}{\i0}
    if r"{\i1}{\i0}" in text or r"{\i0}{\i1}" in text or r"{\b1}{\b0}" in text:
        print(f"[EMPTY TAG] Line {i}: {text}")
        
    # Check 2: Latin characters
    no_tags = re.sub(r"\{[^}]*\}", "", text).replace(r"\N", " ")
    latin = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z\u00C0-\u024F]+", no_tags)
    if latin:
        print(f"[LATIN] Line {i} {latin}: {text}")

    # Check 3: Broken punctuation or formatting
    if re.search(r"[,?;]", no_tags):
        print(f"[ASCII PUNCT] Line {i}: {text}")
        
    if re.search(r"\s+[،؟!\.]", no_tags):
        print(f"[SPACE BEFORE PUNCT] Line {i}: {text}")

    if re.search(r"\\N\s*$", text) or re.search(r"^\s*\\N", text):
        print(f"[DANGLING \\N] Line {i}: {text}")
```

```python
import math
import os
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter

def create_subnova_icon(size=512, is_round=False):
    # High-res base canvas with supersampling (4x)
    base_size = size * 4
    img = Image.new("RGBA", (base_size, base_size), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    center = base_size / 2
    radius = (base_size * 0.92) / 2 if is_round else base_size * 0.88 / 2

    # Background gradient
    # Deep midnight slate to obsidian
    c_top = (11, 15, 25, 255)       # #0B0F19
    c_bottom = (5, 8, 15, 255)      # #05080F
    c_glow = (0, 229, 255, 60)      # Neon cyan ambient glow

    # Draw rounded rect or circle background
    mask = Image.new("L", (base_size, base_size), 0)
    mask_draw = ImageDraw.Draw(mask)
    if is_round:
        mask_draw.ellipse(
            (center - radius, center - radius, center + radius, center + radius),
            fill=255
        )
    else:
        corner_r = int(base_size * 0.22)
        mask_draw.rounded_rectangle(
            (center - radius, center - radius, center + radius, center + radius),
            radius=corner_r,
            fill=255
        )

    # Gradient fill
    for y in range(base_size):
        t = y / base_size
        r = int(c_top[0] * (1 - t) + c_bottom[0] * t)
        g = int(c_top[1] * (1 - t) + c_bottom[1] * t)
        b = int(c_top[2] * (1 - t) + c_bottom[2] * t)
        draw.line([(0, y), (base_size, y)], fill=(r, g, b, 255))

    # Glow layer
    glow_canvas = Image.new("RGBA", (base_size, base_size), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    glow_draw = ImageDraw.Draw(glow_canvas)
    glow_r = int(base_size * 0.40)
    glow_draw.ellipse(
        (center - glow_r, center - glow_r * 0.8, center + glow_r, center + glow_r * 1.2),
        fill=(0, 229, 255, 75)
    )
    glow_draw.ellipse(
        (center - glow_r * 0.5, center - glow_r * 0.6, center + glow_r * 0.5, center + glow_r * 0.4),
        fill=(124, 77, 255, 60)
    )
    glow_canvas = glow_canvas.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(int(base_size * 0.08)))
    img = Image.alpha_composite(img, glow_canvas)

    # Composite with background mask
    bg_final = Image.new("RGBA", (base_size, base_size), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    bg_final.paste(img, (0, 0), mask)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(bg_final)

    # Border stroke around the icon
    border_color = (0, 229, 255, 140)
    border_w = int(base_size * 0.015)
    if is_round:
        draw.ellipse(
            (center - radius, center - radius, center + radius, center + radius),
            outline=border_color, width=border_w
        )
    else:
        corner_r = int(base_size * 0.22)
        draw.rounded_rectangle(
            (center - radius, center - radius, center + radius, center + radius),
            radius=corner_r,
            outline=border_color, width=border_w
        )

    # Foreground Elements:
    # 1. Cinema / Subtitle frame card
    fg_canvas = Image.new("RGBA", (base_size, base_size), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    fg_draw = ImageDraw.Draw(fg_canvas)

    card_w = int(base_size * 0.64)
    card_h = int(base_size * 0.46)
    card_x1 = int(center - card_w / 2)
    card_y1 = int(center - card_h / 2)
    card_x2 = int(center + card_w / 2)
    card_y2 = int(center + card_h / 2)
    card_r = int(base_size * 0.08)

    # Semi-transparent dark card background
    fg_draw.rounded_rectangle(
        (card_x1, card_y1, card_x2, card_y2),
        radius=card_r,
        fill=(16, 23, 38, 220),
        outline=(0, 229, 255, 230),
        width=int(base_size * 0.02)
    )

    # 2. Glowing "S" and Nova Sparkle in center
    # Draw stylized S curve
    s_points_top = [
        (center + int(base_size * 0.12), center - int(base_size * 0.12)),
        (center - int(base_size * 0.10), center - int(base_size * 0.12)),
        (center - int(base_size * 0.12), center - int(base_size * 0.02)),
        (center + int(base_size * 0.12), center + int(base_size * 0.02)),
        (center + int(base_size * 0.10), center + int(base_size * 0.12)),
        (center - int(base_size * 0.12), center + int(base_size * 0.12)),
    ]
    
    # Draw Subtitle Dialogue Waves [ ——  —— ]
    line_y1 = center + int(base_size * 0.14)
    line_y2 = center - int(base_size * 0.02)
    
    # Wave 1 (Cyan)
    fg_draw.rounded_rectangle(
        (center - int(base_size * 0.22), line_y1, center - int(base_size * 0.05), line_y1 + int(base_size * 0.035)),
        radius=int(base_size * 0.015),
        fill=(0, 229, 255, 255)
    )
    # Wave 2 (Green)
    fg_draw.rounded_rectangle(
        (center + int(base_size * 0.02), line_y1, center + int(base_size * 0.22), line_y1 + int(base_size * 0.035)),
        radius=int(base_size * 0.015),
        fill=(0, 230, 118, 255)
    )

    # Center Nova Star ✨
    def draw_star(cx, cy, r_outer, r_inner, color):
        points = []
        for i in range(8):
            angle = i * (math.pi / 4)
            r = r_outer if i % 2 == 0 else r_inner
            points.append((cx + r * math.cos(angle), cy + r * math.sin(angle)))
        fg_draw.polygon(points, fill=color)

    star_cx = center
    star_cy = center - int(base_size * 0.05)
    # Golden outer glow
    draw_star(star_cx, star_cy, int(base_size * 0.14), int(base_size * 0.04), (255, 215, 0, 255))
    # Core bright white/cyan star
    draw_star(star_cx, star_cy, int(base_size * 0.10), int(base_size * 0.025), (255, 255, 255, 255))

    # Corner brackets for cinematic framing
    cb_len = int(base_size * 0.07)
    cb_w = int(base_size * 0.018)
    cb_color = (0, 229, 255, 220)
    
    # Top-Left Bracket
    fg_draw.line([(card_x1 + 10, card_y1 + cb_len), (card_x1 + 10, card_y1 + 10), (card_x1 + cb_len, card_y1 + 10)], fill=cb_color, width=cb_w)
    # Bottom-Right Bracket
    fg_draw.line([(card_x2 - 10, card_y2 - cb_len), (card_x2 - 10, card_y2 - 10), (card_x2 - cb_len, card_y2 - 10)], fill=cb_color, width=cb_w)

    final_img = Image.alpha_composite(bg_final, fg_canvas)
    # Resize down with Lanczos for anti-aliasing
    return final_img.resize((size, size), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    res_dir = r"android\app\src\main\res"
    densities = {
        "mipmap-mdpi": 48,
        "mipmap-hdpi": 72,
        "mipmap-xhdpi": 96,
        "mipmap-xxhdpi": 144,
        "mipmap-xxxhdpi": 192
    }

    for folder, dim in densities.items():
        target_dir = os.path.join(res_dir, folder)
        os.makedirs(target_dir, exist_ok=True)
        
        # Square / squircle icon
        img_square = create_subnova_icon(dim, is_round=False)
        img_square.save(os.path.join(target_dir, "ic_launcher.png"), "PNG")
        
        # Round icon
        img_round = create_subnova_icon(dim, is_round=True)
        img_round.save(os.path.join(target_dir, "ic_launcher_round.png"), "PNG")

        # Also remove old .webp icons if present to ensure .png takes priority
        for old_file in ["ic_launcher.webp", "ic_launcher_round.webp"]:
            p = os.path.join(target_dir, old_file)
            if os.path.exists(p):
                os.remove(p)

    # Also save 512x512 master icon
    master = create_subnova_icon(512, is_round=False)
    master.save(os.path.join(res_dir, "subnova_logo_512.png"), "PNG")
    print("All SubNova icons generated successfully!")
```

```python
import sys
import os
import traceback

# Ensure current working directory is application directory when frozen
if getattr(sys, "frozen", False):
    os.chdir(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(sys.executable)))

# Add project directory to Python path if needed
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))

def log_fatal_crash(exc_type, exc_val, tb, show_dialog: bool = True) -> None:
    """Logs fatal crashes to crash.log and alerts the user with a native dialog."""
    crash_file = os.path.join(
        os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(sys.executable if getattr(sys, "frozen", False) else __file__)),
        "crash.log"
    )
    err_msg = "".join(traceback.format_exception(exc_type, exc_val, tb))
    try:
        from datetime import datetime
        with open(crash_file, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(f"\n{'='*60}\n")
            f.write(f"FATAL APPLICATION CRASH: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}\n")
            f.write(f"{'='*60}\n")
            f.write(err_msg)
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Native Windows alert dialog if running windowed and requested
    if show_dialog and sys.platform == "win32":
        try:
            import ctypes
            ctypes.windll.user32.MessageBoxW(
                0,
                f"حدث خطأ غير متوقع أدى لتوقف التطبيق.\nتم تسجيل التفاصيل في ملف:\n{crash_file}\n\nالخطأ: {exc_val}",
                "SubNova Studio — خطأ غير متوقع",
                0x10  # MB_ICONERROR
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

def main() -> None:
    """Main entry point for SubNova Studio GUI wrapped in top-level crash handler."""
    try:
        from app.ui.app import run_app
        run_app()
    except Exception:
        exc_type, exc_val, tb = sys.exc_info()
        log_fatal_crash(exc_type, exc_val, tb)
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional
import pytest

import app.core.config as config_mod
from app.core.config import AppSettings
from app.core.database import DatabaseManager

_ORIG_SAVE = AppSettings.save_to_file
_ORIG_LOAD_FUNC = AppSettings.__dict__["load_from_file"].__func__
_ORIG_DB_INIT = DatabaseManager.__init__


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _isolate_runtime_state(
    tmp_path_factory: pytest.TempPathFactory,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
):
    """Isolate config.json and subtitler.db per test so pytest never mutates user files."""
    iso_dir = tmp_path_factory.mktemp("subnova_iso")
    test_cfg = iso_dir / "config.json"
    test_db = iso_dir / "subtitler.db"
    created_dbs: list[DatabaseManager] = []

    monkeypatch.setattr(config_mod, "CONFIG_FILE_PATH", test_cfg)
    monkeypatch.setattr(config_mod, "_settings_instance", None)

    def _isolated_save(self: AppSettings, path: Optional[str | Path] = None) -> None:
        target = test_cfg if (path is None or Path(path) == Path("config.json")) else path
        return _ORIG_SAVE(self, target)

    def _isolated_load(cls, path: Optional[str | Path] = None) -> AppSettings:
        target = test_cfg if (path is None or Path(path) == Path("config.json")) else path
        cfg = _ORIG_LOAD_FUNC(cls, target)
        if cfg.db_path == "subtitler.db":
            cfg.db_path = str(test_db)
        return cfg

    def _isolated_db_init(self: DatabaseManager, db_path: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
        if db_path is None:
            settings = config_mod.get_settings()
            candidate = settings.db_path
            db_path = str(test_db) if candidate == "subtitler.db" else candidate
        elif str(db_path) == "subtitler.db":
            db_path = str(test_db)
        _ORIG_DB_INIT(self, db_path=db_path)
        created_dbs.append(self)

    monkeypatch.setattr(AppSettings, "save_to_file", _isolated_save)
    monkeypatch.setattr(AppSettings, "load_from_file", classmethod(_isolated_load))
    monkeypatch.setattr(DatabaseManager, "__init__", _isolated_db_init)

    yield

    monkeypatch.setattr(config_mod, "_settings_instance", None)
    for db in created_dbs:
        try:
            db.close()
        except Exception:
            pass
```

```python
import pytest
from app.translation.prompts import PromptBuilder
from app.translation.response_parser import ResponseParser
from app.translation.batcher import TokenBatcher
from app.core.config import AppSettings, get_settings
from app.models.provider import ModelInfo, ChatMessage
from app.models.subtitle import SubtitleEvent


def test_allam_prompt_builder():
    """Verify ALLaM models receive Arabic-native, high-efficiency prompts."""
    builder = PromptBuilder()
    
    # 1. Normal prompt (non-allam)
    std_msgs = builder.build_prompt(
        source_lang="English",
        target_lang="Arabic",
        current_subtitles="[1] Hello\n[2] World",
        model_name="qwen2.5-7b-instruct"
    )
    assert "You are an elite, master anime" in std_msgs[0].content
    
    # 2. ALLaM-optimized prompt
    allam_msgs = builder.build_prompt(
        source_lang="الإنجليزية",
        target_lang="العربية",
        current_subtitles="[1] Hello\n[2] World",
        story_notes="ملاحظة هامة",
        model_name="allam-7b-arabic-sft"
    )
    # Check that system instruction is purely in Arabic for ALLaM
    assert "أنت مترجم شارات وأنمي محترف" in allam_msgs[0].content
    assert "القواعد الصارمة" in allam_msgs[0].content
    assert "[ملاحظات القصة والمشهد]" in allam_msgs[1].content
    assert "الأسطر المطلوب ترجمتها الآن" in allam_msgs[1].content


def test_allam_improvement_prompt():
    """Verify ALLaM improvement prompt is Arabic-native."""
    builder = PromptBuilder()
    msgs = builder.build_improvement_prompt(
        source_lang="English",
        target_lang="Arabic",
        current_subtitles="[1] مرحباً\n[2] أهلاً",
        model_name="allam-7b-instruct-preview"
    )
    assert "أنت مدقق ومحرر لغوي محترف" in msgs[0].content
    assert "صقل وتدقيق" in msgs[0].content


def test_allam_empty_brackets_response_parsing():
    """Verify ALLaM empty brackets '[]' and '[ ]' are parsed, stripped and mapped positionally."""
    parser = ResponseParser()
    
    # Empty bracket lines from ALLaM SFT
    raw_allam = "[] إلى أين أنت ذاهب الآن؟\n[] أنا متجه إلى الأكاديمية."
    parsed = parser.parse_response(raw_allam, [10, 11])
    assert parsed == {
        10: "إلى أين أنت ذاهب الآن؟",
        11: "أنا متجه إلى الأكاديمية."
    }
    # Ensure leading brackets are completely gone
    assert not parsed[10].startswith("[]")
    assert not parsed[10].startswith("[ ]")
    
    # Empty bracket with spaces
    raw_allam_space = "[ ] مرحباً يا صديقي\n[ ] كيف أصبحت اليوم؟"
    parsed_space = parser.parse_response(raw_allam_space, [1, 2])
    assert parsed_space == {
        1: "مرحباً يا صديقي",
        2: "كيف أصبحت اليوم؟"
    }


def test_max_context_and_batcher_budgeting():
    """Verify TokenBatcher respects max_context properly."""
    # 4k context model (like ALLaM)
    batcher_4k = TokenBatcher(max_events=30, max_context=4096)
    events = [SubtitleEvent(id=i, text=f"Long dialogue line number {i} with several characters") for i in range(1, 30)]
    batches_4k = batcher_4k.create_batches(events, is_local=True)
    assert len(batches_4k[0]) <= 12
    
    # Large context model (like 32k)
    batcher_32k = TokenBatcher(max_events=30, max_context=32768)
    batches_32k = batcher_32k.create_batches(events, is_local=False)
    assert len(batches_32k[0]) == 29


def test_app_settings_max_context_and_parallel():
    """Verify AppSettings includes max_context and default local concurrency."""
    settings = AppSettings()
    assert hasattr(settings, 'max_context')
    assert settings.max_context == 4096
    assert hasattr(settings, 'concurrency')


def test_provider_panel_allam_and_engine_controls():
    """Verify ProviderPanel has max_context and parallel steppers, and detects ALLaM."""
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
    from app.ui.widgets.provider_panel import ProviderPanel, PROVIDER_MODEL_PRESETS
    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])

    panel = ProviderPanel()
    try:
        assert hasattr(panel, 'sb_max_context')
        assert hasattr(panel, 'sb_parallel')
        assert hasattr(panel, 'lbl_context_badge')
        
        # Check ALLaM presets exist for LM Studio and Ollama
        assert any("allam" in mid for mid, _ in PROVIDER_MODEL_PRESETS["lmstudio"])
        assert any("allam" in mid for mid, _ in PROVIDER_MODEL_PRESETS["ollama"])

        # Test context detection for ALLaM
        panel._detect_and_apply_context("allam-7b-arabic-sft")
        assert panel.sb_max_context.value() == 4096
        assert "4096" in panel.lbl_context_badge.text()

        # Test context detection for Qwen
        panel._detect_and_apply_context("qwen2.5-7b-instruct")
        assert panel.sb_max_context.value() == 32768
    finally:
        panel.deleteLater()
        app.processEvents()


def test_main_window_video_player_default_off_and_splitter():
    """Verify Media Player is off by default and toggle button is accessible."""
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
    from app.ui.windows.main_window import MainWindow
    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])

    win = MainWindow()
    try:
        # 1. Media player must be completely off / hidden by default
        assert win.video_container.isHidden()
        assert win.video_player.player is None
        
        # 2. Toggle button must be visible, accessible, and outside video_container
        assert win.btn_toggle_video.parent() != win.video_container
        assert "طافي" in win.btn_toggle_video.text() or "معطل" in win.btn_toggle_video.text()
        
        # 3. Toggle button opens the video player container
        win.btn_toggle_video.click()
        assert not win.video_container.isHidden()
        assert "إغلاق" in win.btn_toggle_video.text()
        
        # 4. Toggle button closes it and cleans up resources
        win.btn_toggle_video.click()
        assert win.video_container.isHidden()
        assert win.video_player.player is None
        assert "طافي" in win.btn_toggle_video.text()

        # 5. Check left panel minimum width >= 400 to prevent splitter overlap
        left_panel = win.findChild(type(win.provider_panel.parent().parent()))
        assert win.provider_panel.minimumWidth() >= 0
    finally:
        win.deleteLater()
        app.processEvents()
```

```python
import pytest
from app.translation.response_parser import ResponseParser
from app.translation.context import ContextBuilder
from app.models.subtitle import SubtitleEvent
from app.translation.prompts import PromptBuilder


def test_response_parser_handles_allam_empty_brackets():
    """Verify that when ALLaM outputs [ ] without IDs, ResponseParser accurately maps them sequentially."""
    parser = ResponseParser()
    expected_ids = [2045, 2046, 2047, 2048, 2049]

    # ALLaM output with empty brackets [ ]
    raw_response = """
    [ ] ضربة نيزك.
    [ ] إنه نيزك صغير،
    [ ] لكن طاقة سقوطه من السماء بسرعة عالية هائلة.
    [ ] أستطيع على الأرجح القضاء عليهم جميعًا.
    [ ] هذا مذهل حقًا.
    """

    res = parser.parse_response(raw_response, expected_ids)
    assert len(res) == 5
    assert res[2045] == "ضربة نيزك."
    assert res[2046] == "إنه نيزك صغير،"
```

```python
def test_anime_identifier():

    t1, e1 = identifier.identify_from_path("[SubsPlease] Sousou no Frieren - 05 (1080p) [XXXXX].ass")
    assert t1 == "Sousou no Frieren"
    assert e1 == "05"

    assert t2 == "My Hero Academia"

def test_character_resolver():
    profiles = [
        CharacterProfile(canonical_name="Naruto Uzumaki", first_name="Naruto", aliases=["Fox Boy"])
    ]
    resolver = CharacterResolver(profiles)
    
    # Exact match
    match = resolver.resolve_speaker("Naruto")
    assert match is not None
    assert match.match_type == "exact"
    
    # Alias match
    match = resolver.resolve_speaker("fox boy")
    assert match is not None
    assert match.match_type == "alias"
    
    # Fuzzy match
    match = resolver.resolve_speaker("Naruto Uzmak")
    assert match is not None
    assert match.match_type == "fuzzy"

def test_gender_resolver():
    resolver = GenderResolver()
    
    res1 = resolver.resolve_gender(GenderEnum.UNKNOWN, GenderEnum.MALE, GenderEnum.UNKNOWN)
    assert res1 == GenderEnum.MALE
    
    res2 = resolver.resolve_gender(GenderEnum.FEMALE, GenderEnum.MALE, GenderEnum.UNKNOWN)
    assert res2 == GenderEnum.FEMALE  # User override wins
    
    res3 = resolver.resolve_gender(GenderEnum.UNKNOWN, GenderEnum.MALE, GenderEnum.FEMALE)
    assert res3 == GenderEnum.CONFLICT
```

```python
def test_database_thread_local_and_indexes():
    """Verify DatabaseManager reuses connections per thread, closes cleanly, and creates indexes."""
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".db", delete=False) as tmp:
        db_path = tmp.name

    try:
        db = DatabaseManager(db_path=db_path)
        conn1 = db.get_connection()
        conn2 = db.get_connection()
        # Connection should be reused in the same thread
        assert conn1 is conn2

        # Check indexes exist
        rows = db.fetch_all("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index'")
        idx_names = [r["name"] for r in rows]
        assert "idx_tm_lookup" in idx_names
        assert "idx_characters_anime" in idx_names
        assert "idx_glossary_anime" in idx_names

        # Clean close
        db.close()
    finally:

            except Exception:
                pass
```

```python
        assert r"\N" in ev.original_text

        # Test writing ASS with translation while preserving tags
        ev.translated_text = r"{\an8\pos(960,120)}انظر إلى السماء!\N{\c&H00FFFF&}إنها جميلة."
        out_ass = ass_path.replace(".ass", "_out.ass")
        write_subtitle(doc_ass, out_ass)
        assert os.path.exists(out_ass)
        with open(out_ass, "r", encoding="utf-8") as rf:
            out_content = rf.read()
        assert "[Script Info]" in out_content
        assert "[V4+ Styles]" in out_content
        assert r"{\an8\pos(960,120)}" in out_content
        assert "انظر إلى السماء!" in out_content
        if os.path.exists(out_ass):
            os.remove(out_ass)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(ass_path):
            os.remove(ass_path)


def test_2_auto_healing_comprehensive():
    """Tests all features of the SubtitleHealer engine."""
    # Punctuation normalization
    raw_ar = "مرحبا, كيف حالك? انا بخير; شكرا لك!"
    fixed_punct = SubtitleHealer.normalize_arabic_punctuation(raw_ar)
    assert "،" in fixed_punct
    assert "؟" in fixed_punct
    assert "؛" in fixed_punct
    assert "," not in fixed_punct
    assert "?" not in fixed_punct

    # Tag protection and restoration
    orig_with_tags = r"{\an8\pos(500,200)}Hello world!\N{\fad(200,200)}Goodbye!"
    protected, tags = SubtitleHealer.protect_ass_tags(orig_with_tags)
    assert "___ASS_TAG_" in protected
    assert len(tags) == 2
    restored = SubtitleHealer.restore_ass_tags(protected, tags)
    assert restored == orig_with_tags

    # Stray Latin removal
    noise_text = r"مرحبا بك \NI {Hmm.} \Na وأهلاً"
    clean_noise = SubtitleHealer.clean_stray_latin(noise_text)
    assert r"\NI" not in clean_noise
    assert r"{Hmm.}" not in clean_noise
    assert "مرحبا بك" in clean_noise and "وأهلاً" in clean_noise

    # Orphan quote fixing
    unbalanced = 'قال المعلم: "هذا درس مهم جدا'
    fixed_quotes = SubtitleHealer.fix_orphan_quotes(unbalanced)
    assert fixed_quotes.count('"') % 2 == 0 or '"' not in fixed_quotes

    # Master heal pipeline
    raw_input = r"{\an8}مرحبا, كيف حالك? \NI {Oh.}"
    healed = SubtitleHealer.heal(raw_input, orig_with_tags, {
        "arabic_punct": True,
        "latin_clean": True,
        "quote_fix": True,
        "protect_tags": True
    })
    assert "،" in healed
    assert "؟" in healed
    assert r"\NI" not in healed
    assert "{Oh.}" not in healed
    assert r"{\an8}" in healed


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_3_translation_engine_full_lifecycle():
    """Tests end-to-end translation, auto-healing, post-improvement, and memory cache."""
    doc = SubtitleDocument(format=SubtitleFormat.SRT)
    doc.events = [
        SubtitleEvent(id=1, start_time="00:00:01,000", end_time="00:00:03,000", original_text="Welcome to the episode, are you ready?"),
        SubtitleEvent(id=2, start_time="00:00:03,500", end_time="00:00:05,000", original_text="Yes, we are completely ready!"),
        SubtitleEvent(id=3, start_time="00:00:05,500", end_time="00:00:07,000", original_text="Welcome to the episode, are you ready?") # Duplicate for TM
    ]

    provider = FullMockProvider()
    engine = TranslationEngine(
        batcher=TokenBatcher(max_tokens=2000, max_events=2)
    )

    progress_reports = []
    def track_progress(*args):
        progress_reports.append(args)

    translated_doc = await engine.translate_document(
        document=doc,
        provider=provider,
        model="google/gemma-4-e2b",
        source_lang="English",
        target_lang="Arabic",
        on_progress=track_progress,
        concurrency=2,
        temperature=0.2,
        auto_heal=True,
        auto_improve=True,
        story_notes="أنمي درامي، الأبطال شجعان"
    )

    assert len(translated_doc.events) == 3
    for ev in translated_doc.events:
        assert ev.translated_text
        assert "مرحباً" in ev.translated_text or "جاهز" in ev.translated_text
    assert len(progress_reports) > 0


def test_4_video_subtitle_extractor_logic():
    """Tests video file detection, stream selection scoring, and codec mappings."""
    for ext in ('.mkv', '.mp4', '.avi', '.mov', '.webm', '.flv', '.ts', '.m4v'):
        assert VideoSubtitleExtractor.is_video_file(f"test_movie{ext}")
    assert not VideoSubtitleExtractor.is_video_file("test_sub.srt")
    assert not VideoSubtitleExtractor.is_video_file("test_sub.ass")

    # Test smart stream scoring
    streams = [
        SubtitleStreamInfo(index=0, global_index=2, codec_name='subrip', extension='.srt', language='eng', title='Signs & Songs', is_default=False),
        SubtitleStreamInfo(index=1, global_index=3, codec_name='ass', extension='.ass', language='eng', title='Full Dialogue [Subtitles]', is_default=True),
        SubtitleStreamInfo(index=2, global_index=4, codec_name='subrip', extension='.srt', language='spa', title='Spanish', is_default=False)
    ]

    best = VideoSubtitleExtractor.select_best_stream(streams, preferred_lang="en")
    assert best is not None
    assert best.index == 1
    assert best.codec_name == 'ass'
    assert best.title == 'Full Dialogue [Subtitles]'


def test_5_anime_and_character_metadata():
    """Tests Anime title cleaning, character profile attributes, and gender representation."""
    identifier = MediaIdentifier()
    dirty_name = "[SubsPlease] Sousou no Frieren - 01 (1080p) [ABCD1234].mkv"
    media_info = identifier.identify_media_info(dirty_name)
    assert "Sousou no Frieren" in media_info["title"]
    assert media_info["media_type"] == "anime"
    assert media_info["episode"] == "01"

    # Test CharacterProfile
    char = CharacterProfile(
        canonical_name="Frieren",
        arabic_name="فريرن",
        gender_info=GenderInfo(gender=GenderEnum.FEMALE, confidence=1.0, source="Database")
    )
    assert char.canonical_name == "Frieren"
    assert char.arabic_name == "فريرن"
    assert char.gender_info.gender == GenderEnum.FEMALE
    pronouns = char.get_pronouns()
    assert pronouns.get("subject") == "هي"


def test_6_ui_widgets_headless():
    """Tests GUI panels, character filtering, quick healing, and live preview."""
    import sys
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
    from app.ui.windows.main_window import MainWindow

    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication(sys.argv)
    win = MainWindow()
    assert win is not None
    assert win.tabs.count() == 4

    # Test character panel search/filter
    win.character_panel.add_character("Eren Yeager", "إيرين ييغر", "Male")
    win.character_panel.add_character("Mikasa Ackerman", "ميكاسا أكرمان", "Female")
    win.character_panel.add_character("Armin Arlert", "أرمين أرليرت", "Male")
    assert win.character_panel.table.rowCount() == 3

    # Filter for 'Mikasa'
    win.character_panel._filter_table("Mikasa")
    assert win.character_panel.table.isRowHidden(0) is True   # Eren hidden
    assert win.character_panel.table.isRowHidden(1) is False  # Mikasa shown
    assert win.character_panel.table.isRowHidden(2) is True   # Armin hidden

    # Reset filter
    win.character_panel._filter_table("")
    assert win.character_panel.table.isRowHidden(0) is False
    assert win.character_panel.table.isRowHidden(1) is False

    # Test Live Preview
    win.live_preview.update_preview("Hello", "مرحباً")
    assert win.live_preview.lbl_orig.text() == "Hello"
    assert win.live_preview.lbl_imp.text() == "مرحباً"
    win.live_preview.clear()
    assert "بانتظار" in win.live_preview.lbl_orig.text()

    # Test Stepper Plus / Minus Buttons
    init_b = win.settings_panel.sb_batch_size.value()
    win.settings_panel.sb_batch_size.btn_plus.click()
    assert win.settings_panel.sb_batch_size.value() == init_b + 1
    win.settings_panel.sb_batch_size.btn_minus.click()
    assert win.settings_panel.sb_batch_size.value() == init_b
    win.deleteLater()
    app.processEvents()
```

```python
import pytest
from app.models.subtitle import SubtitleEvent, SubtitleDocument, SubtitleFormat
from app.subtitle.effect_separator import EffectSeparator, EffectPayloadIsolator
from app.quality.healer import SubtitleHealer


def test_has_translatable_text_classification():
    # 1. Pure drawings must NOT be translatable
    raw_drawing = r"{\p1}m 0 0 l 100 0 100 100 0 100{\p0}"
    assert EffectPayloadIsolator.has_translatable_text(raw_drawing) is False

    # 2. Pure sound effects in asterisks must NOT be translatable
    raw_gasp = "*gasp*"
    assert EffectPayloadIsolator.has_translatable_text(raw_gasp) is False

    # 3. Pure bracketed music or sound cues must NOT be translatable
    raw_music = "[Music Playing]"
    assert EffectPayloadIsolator.has_translatable_text(raw_music) is False
    raw_sfx = r"{\pos(100,200)}SFX: BOOM"
    assert EffectPayloadIsolator.has_translatable_text(raw_sfx) is False

    # 4. Styled signs with human text MUST be translatable
    raw_sign = r"{\an7\pos(320,150)\frz-5\fad(200,200)\fnCairo\fs45\bord3\shad1\c&HFFFFFF&\3c&H000000&}Tokyo Central Hospital"
    assert EffectPayloadIsolator.has_translatable_text(raw_sign) is True

    # 5. On-screen episode titles MUST be translatable
    raw_title = r"{\an8\c&H00FFFF&}EPISODE 01: AWAKENING"
    assert EffectPayloadIsolator.has_translatable_text(raw_title) is True

    # 6. Styled multi-line letters/notes MUST be translatable
    raw_letter = r"{\an7}Dear Kaori,\NPlease forgive me for leaving."
    assert EffectPayloadIsolator.has_translatable_text(raw_letter) is True

    # 7. Standard dialogue MUST be translatable
    raw_diag = r"Where are you going, Conan?"
    assert EffectPayloadIsolator.has_translatable_text(raw_diag) is True


def test_extract_clean_payload_zero_tags():
    # Verify that clean payload sent to LLM has ZERO tags or coordinate noise
    raw = r"{\an7\pos(320,150)\frz-5\fad(200,200)\fnCairo\fs45\bord3\shad1\c&HFFFFFF&\3c&H000000&}Tokyo Central Hospital"
    clean, skeleton = EffectPayloadIsolator.extract_clean_payload(raw)

    # Absolutely no ASS tags or brackets in clean payload!
    assert "{" not in clean
    assert "}" not in clean
    assert "\\" not in clean
    assert clean == "Tokyo Central Hospital"

    # Skeleton must hold original lead tags
    assert skeleton["segments"][0]["lead_tags"] == r"{\an7\pos(320,150)\frz-5\fad(200,200)\fnCairo\fs45\bord3\shad1\c&HFFFFFF&\3c&H000000&}"


def test_reconstruct_effect_text_exact_restoration():
    # Single styled sign
    raw = r"{\an7\pos(320,150)\frz-5\fad(200,200)\fnCairo\fs45\bord3\shad1\c&HFFFFFF&\3c&H000000&}Tokyo Central Hospital"
    clean, skeleton = EffectPayloadIsolator.extract_clean_payload(raw)
    translated = "مستشفى طوكيو المركزي"

    reconstructed = EffectPayloadIsolator.reconstruct_effect_text(translated, skeleton)
    expected = r"{\an7\pos(320,150)\frz-5\fad(200,200)\fnCairo\fs45\bord3\shad1\c&HFFFFFF&\3c&H000000&}مستشفى طوكيو المركزي"
    assert reconstructed == expected


def test_multiline_sign_distinct_tags_per_segment():
    # Multi-line sign with different tags on each line
    raw = r"{\an8\fs24\c&HFFFFFF&}Warning:\N{\c&HFF0000&}High Voltage Area"
    clean, skeleton = EffectPayloadIsolator.extract_clean_payload(raw)

    assert "{" not in clean
    assert "}" not in clean
    assert clean == r"Warning:\NHigh Voltage Area"

    translated = r"تحذير:\Nمنطقة ذات جهد عالٍ"
    reconstructed = EffectPayloadIsolator.reconstruct_effect_text(translated, skeleton)
    expected = r"{\an8\fs24\c&HFFFFFF&}تحذير:\N{\c&HFF0000&}منطقة ذات جهد عالٍ"
    assert reconstructed == expected


def test_subtitle_event_get_clean_text_and_rebuild():
    ev = SubtitleEvent(
        id=1,
        style="Sign",
        original_text=r"{\an8\pos(960,100)\c&H00FFFF&}POLICE DEPARTMENT"
    )

    # get_clean_text must return pure words without tags
    clean = ev.get_clean_text()
    assert clean == "POLICE DEPARTMENT"
    assert "{" not in clean

    # rebuild_text must re-inject the tags and heal
    rebuilt = ev.rebuild_text("قسم الشرطة")
    assert r"{\an8\pos(960,100)\c&H00FFFF&}" in rebuilt
    assert "قسم الشرطة" in rebuilt


def test_document_includes_translatable_signs_when_requested():
    doc = SubtitleDocument(
        format=SubtitleFormat.ASS,
        events=[
            SubtitleEvent(id=1, style="Default", original_text="Hello world"),
            SubtitleEvent(id=2, style="Sign", original_text=r"{\pos(100,200)}Tokyo Hospital"),
            SubtitleEvent(id=3, style="Default", original_text=r"{\p1}m 0 0 l 10 10{\p0}"),
            SubtitleEvent(id=4, style="Default", original_text="*gasp*"),
        ]
    )

    # Event 1 is dialogue (translatable)
    # Event 2 is a styled sign with text (translatable when include_signs=True)
    # Event 3 is pure vector drawing (never translatable)
    # Event 4 is pure gasp sound (never translatable)
    translatable = doc.get_translatable_events(skip_effects=True, include_signs=True)
    assert len(translatable) == 2
    assert translatable[0].id == 1
    assert translatable[1].id == 2


def test_table_model_fx_classification_preserves_text_lines():
    from app.ui.models.subtitle_table_model import SubtitleTableModel
    from PySide6.QtCore import Qt

    model = SubtitleTableModel()
    events = [
        SubtitleEvent(id=1, style="Default", original_text="Normal dialogue"),
        SubtitleEvent(id=2, style="Sign", original_text=r"{\pos(100,200)}Tokyo Hospital"),
        SubtitleEvent(id=3, style="Default", original_text=r"{\p1}m 0 0 l 10 10{\p0}"),
        SubtitleEvent(id=4, style="Default", original_text="*gasp*"),
    ]
    model.set_events(events)

    # Line 1 (dialogue): Pending
    assert model.data(model.index(0, 6), Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole) == "Pending"
    # Line 2 (styled sign with text): Pending (NOT permanently locked to FX!)
    assert model.data(model.index(1, 6), Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole) == "Pending"
    # Line 3 (vector drawing): مؤثرات (FX)
    assert model.data(model.index(2, 6), Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole) == "مؤثرات (FX)"
    # Line 4 (pure gasp): مؤثرات (FX)
    assert model.data(model.index(3, 6), Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole) == "مؤثرات (FX)"

    # When line 2 is translated, status becomes Done
    model.update_event(1, "مستشفى طوكيو", "Done")
    assert model.data(model.index(1, 6), Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole) == "Done"
```

```python
import pytest
from app.models.subtitle import SubtitleEvent, SubtitleDocument, SubtitleFormat
from app.subtitle.effect_separator import EffectSeparator
from app.quality.healer import SubtitleHealer


def test_effect_separator_is_mixed_line():
    # 1. Mixed line with top sign (\an8) and bottom dialogue (\r\an2)
    ev1 = SubtitleEvent(id=1, original_text=r"{\an8\c&H00FFFF&}JAPANESE SIGN\N{\r\an2}Hello everyone!")
    assert EffectSeparator.is_mixed_line(ev1) is True

    # 2. Mixed line with dialogue first, then positioned explosion
    ev2 = SubtitleEvent(id=2, original_text=r"Hey, did you see that?\N{\pos(960,100)\c&H00FF00&}*EXPLOSION*")
    assert EffectSeparator.is_mixed_line(ev2) is True

    # 3. Mixed line with vector drawing ending in {\p0} followed by dialogue
    ev3 = SubtitleEvent(id=3, original_text=r"{\p1}m 0 0 l 10 10{\p0} Hello world")
    assert EffectSeparator.is_mixed_line(ev3) is True

    # 4. Mixed line with positioned sound effect and style reset {\r}
    ev4 = SubtitleEvent(id=4, original_text=r"{\pos(100,200)\c&H0000FF&}*Crash*{\r}What was that?")
    assert EffectSeparator.is_mixed_line(ev4) is True

    # 5. Normal two-speaker dialogue (NOT mixed)
    ev5 = SubtitleEvent(id=5, original_text=r"- Hello!\N- Hi there!")
    assert EffectSeparator.is_mixed_line(ev5) is False

    # 6. Normal multiline dialogue (NOT mixed)
    ev6 = SubtitleEvent(id=6, original_text=r"This is a long sentence\Nsplit across two lines.")
    assert EffectSeparator.is_mixed_line(ev6) is False

    # 7. Pure effect line (NOT mixed)
    ev7 = SubtitleEvent(id=7, original_text=r"{\an8\c&H00FFFF&}ONLY SIGN")
    assert EffectSeparator.is_mixed_line(ev7) is False


def test_effect_separator_separate_event():

        id=10,
        start="00:01:23.45",
        end="00:01:28.90",
        style="Default",

    )

    assert len(separated) == 2

    assert fx_ev.is_visual_effect() is True
    assert fx_ev.is_translatable() is False
    assert r"{\an8\c&H00FFFF&}JAPANESE SIGN" in fx_ev.original_text
    assert fx_ev.start == "00:01:23.45"
    assert fx_ev.end == "00:01:28.90"

    # Second event: The spoken dialogue
    diag_ev = separated[1]
    assert diag_ev.is_visual_effect() is False
    assert diag_ev.is_translatable() is True
    assert "Hello everyone!" in diag_ev.text
    assert diag_ev.start == "00:01:23.45"
    assert diag_ev.end == "00:01:28.90"

    # Event 2: Isolated FX sign
    assert separated_doc.events[1].is_visual_effect() is True
    assert "TOP SIGN" in separated_doc.events[1].original_text

    # Event 3: Isolated Dialogue
    assert separated_doc.events[2].is_translatable() is True
    assert "What are you doing?" in separated_doc.events[2].text

    # Event 4: Normal dialogue 2
    assert separated_doc.events[3].is_translatable() is True


def test_subtitle_event_get_clean_text_isolates_drawings():
```

```python
import os
import sys
import tempfile
import pytest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
from app.core.resources import resource_path, find_binary
from app.models.subtitle import SubtitleEvent, SubtitleFormat
from app.subtitle.video_extractor import VideoSubtitleExtractor
from app.translation.prompts import PromptBuilder
import main

def test_resource_path_and_find_binary():
    """Verify resource_path resolves paths and find_binary locates binaries."""
    # Test resource_path resolves existing icon
    resolved_icon = resource_path(os.path.join("app", "resources", "icons", "subnova_icon.ico"))
    assert os.path.isabs(resolved_icon)
    assert os.path.exists(resolved_icon)

    # Test find_binary for python executable on PATH or system
    py_bin = find_binary("python")
    assert py_bin is not None
    assert "python" in py_bin.lower()

    # VideoSubtitleExtractor should return non-empty binary strings
    assert VideoSubtitleExtractor.get_ffmpeg_bin() is not None
    assert VideoSubtitleExtractor.get_ffprobe_bin() is not None

def test_karaoke_tag_visual_effect_detection():
    """Verify karaoke tags are detected as visual effects to prevent translation mangling."""
    karaoke_event = SubtitleEvent(
        id=1,
        style="Default",
        original_text=r"{\k25}Hello {\k30}World",
        format_type=SubtitleFormat.ASS
    )
    assert karaoke_event.is_visual_effect() is True
    assert karaoke_event.is_translatable() is False

    dialogue_event = SubtitleEvent(
        id=2,
        style="Default",
        original_text=r"Hello World",
        format_type=SubtitleFormat.ASS
    )
    assert dialogue_event.is_visual_effect() is False
    assert dialogue_event.is_translatable() is True

def test_fatal_crash_logging():
    """Verify log_fatal_crash writes formatted crash dump to crash.log."""
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp_dir:
        fake_crash_log = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "crash.log")
        with patch.object(sys, "frozen", True, create=True), patch("sys.executable", os.path.join(tmp_dir, "app.exe")):
            try:
                raise ValueError("Simulated fatal test crash")
            except ValueError:
                exc_type, exc_val, tb = sys.exc_info()
                main.log_fatal_crash(exc_type, exc_val, tb, show_dialog=False)

        # Confirm crash.log exists and contains the trace
        assert os.path.exists(fake_crash_log)
        with open(fake_crash_log, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            content = f.read()
        assert "FATAL APPLICATION CRASH" in content
        assert "Simulated fatal test crash" in content

def test_prompt_anti_language_leakage():
    """Verify prompt builder includes strict anti-language-leakage rules."""
    pb = PromptBuilder()
    messages = pb.build_prompt(
        source_lang="Japanese",
        target_lang="Arabic",
        current_subtitles="[1] Konnichiwa"
    )
    sys_prompt = messages[0].content
    assert "Chinese" in sys_prompt
    assert "Japanese (kanji/kana)" in sys_prompt
    assert "Arabic" in sys_prompt
```

```python
import pytest
from app.quality.healer import SubtitleHealer

def test_protect_and_restore_ass_tags():
    text = r"{\an8}مرحباً بك يا صديقي!{\i1} كيف حالك؟{\i0}"
    protected, tags = SubtitleHealer.protect_ass_tags(text)
    assert r"{\an8}" in tags
    assert r"{\i1}" in tags
    assert r"{\i0}" in tags
    assert "___ASS_TAG_0___" in protected
    
    restored = SubtitleHealer.restore_ass_tags(protected, tags)
    assert restored == text

def test_dropped_ass_tag_restored():
    orig_text = r"{\an8}مرحباً بك"
    # LLM dropped the tag completely
    raw_translated = "مرحباً بك"
    healed = SubtitleHealer.heal(raw_translated, original_text=orig_text)
    assert r"{\an8}" in healed

def test_clean_stray_latin():
    dirty = r"{\an8}مرحباً \N I يا صديقي {Hmm.} a"
    cleaned = SubtitleHealer.clean_stray_latin(dirty)
    assert "{Hmm.}" not in cleaned
    assert r"\N I" not in cleaned
    assert "a" not in cleaned.split()

def test_normalize_arabic_punctuation():
    text = "مرحباً, كيف حالك? أنا بخير; شكراً لك."
    normalized = SubtitleHealer.normalize_arabic_punctuation(text)
    assert "،" in normalized
    assert "؟" in normalized
    assert "؛" in normalized
    assert "," not in normalized
    assert "?" not in normalized
    assert ";" not in normalized

def test_fix_orphan_quotes():
    text = '"هذا نص غير مغلق'
    fixed = SubtitleHealer.fix_orphan_quotes(text)
    assert '"' not in fixed

    balanced = '"هذا نص مغلق تماماً"'
    assert SubtitleHealer.fix_orphan_quotes(balanced) == balanced

def test_full_heal_pipeline():
    orig = r"{\an8\pos(192,20)}Wait, are you sure? {Sigh}"
    raw = r"انتظر, هل أنت متأكد? \N I {Sigh}"
    healed = SubtitleHealer.heal(raw, original_text=orig)
    assert r"{\an8\pos(192,20)}" in healed
    assert "،" in healed
    assert "؟" in healed
    assert "{Sigh}" not in healed
    assert r"\N I" not in healed

def test_empty_tags_purged():
    dirty = r"{\i1}{\i0}منذ ذلك اليوم، لم يعد يحاول شيئاً.{\b1}{\b0}"
    cleaned = SubtitleHealer.purge_corrupt_tags(dirty)
    assert r"{\i1}{\i0}" not in cleaned
    assert r"{\b1}{\b0}" not in cleaned
    assert "منذ ذلك اليوم" in cleaned

def test_italics_wrapped_properly_no_i1i0():
    orig = r"{\i1}Depuis ce jour,\NYoshioka n'a plus rien tenté.{\i0}"
    raw = "منذ ذلك اليوم، لم يعد يوشيوكا يحاول شيئاً."
    healed = SubtitleHealer.heal(raw, original_text=orig)

    assert healed.startswith(r"{\i1}")

def test_stray_latin_fused_prefix():
```

```python
    def __init__(self):

    async def list_models(self):
        return []

    async def chat_completion(self, messages, model, temperature=0.2, max_tokens=None, **kwargs):
        user_content = messages[-1].content
        lines = []
        for line in user_content.splitlines():
            if line.startswith("[") and "]" in line:
                idx = line[1:line.find("]")]
                lines.append(f"[{idx}] هذا نص محسن فائق الجودة خالي من الركاكة.")
        return ChatResponse(
            content="\n".join(lines),
            model=model,
            prompt_tokens=10,
            completion_tokens=20,
            total_tokens=30
        )

    async def test_connection(self):
        return True

@pytest.mark.asyncio

    doc.events = [
        SubtitleEvent(id=1, start_time="00:00:01,000", end_time="00:00:03,000", original_text="Wait, don't go!", translated_text="انتظر لا تذهب"),
        SubtitleEvent(id=2, start_time="00:00:03,500", end_time="00:00:05,000", original_text="I must go.", translated_text="يجب ان اذهب")
    ]
```

```python
def test_video_extractor_prefer_ass(tmp_path):
    """Verify that extract_subtitle respects prefer_ass and generates .ass target path."""
    dummy_video = tmp_path / "sample_video.mkv"
    dummy_video.write_bytes(b"dummy video content")

    fake_stream = SubtitleStreamInfo(
        index=0,
        global_index=2,
        codec_name="subrip",
        extension=".srt",
        language="eng",
        title="English Dialogues"
    )

    with patch.object(VideoSubtitleExtractor, "probe_subtitle_streams", return_value=[fake_stream]):
        with patch("subprocess.run") as mock_run:
            def fake_run(cmd, *args, **kwargs):
                if "-c:s" in cmd and "copy" in cmd:
                    return MagicMock(returncode=1, stderr="ass muxer supports only codec ass")
                elif "-c:s" in cmd and "ass" in cmd:
                    out_p = cmd[-1]
                    Path(out_p).write_text("[Script Info]\nTitle: Converted ASS\n", encoding="utf-8")
                    return MagicMock(returncode=0, stderr="")
                return MagicMock(returncode=0, stderr="")

            mock_run.side_effect = fake_run

            ok, out_path, err = VideoSubtitleExtractor.extract_subtitle(
                str(dummy_video), stream_index=0, prefer_ass=True
            )

            assert ok is True
            assert out_path.endswith(".ass")
            assert mock_run.call_count >= 1
            assert Path(out_path).exists()
            # Verify that for SRT source converting to ASS, it called ffmpeg with -c:s ass
            args = mock_run.call_args[0][0]
            assert "-c:s" in args
            assert "ass" in args

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_improvement_context_size_exceeded_binary_split():
    """Verify that when LM Studio returns 'Context size has been exceeded', engine triggers binary split immediately."""
    from app.translation.engine import TranslationEngine
    from app.translation.batcher import TokenBatcher
    from app.models.subtitle import SubtitleDocument, SubtitleEvent, SubtitleFormat
    from app.models.provider import ChatResponse

    doc = SubtitleDocument(
        format=SubtitleFormat.ASS,
        events=[
            SubtitleEvent(id="1", start_ms=0, end_ms=1000, text="First line", translated_text="السطر الأول"),
            SubtitleEvent(id="2", start_ms=1000, end_ms=2000, text="Second line", translated_text="السطر الثاني"),
        ]
    )

    batcher = TokenBatcher(max_tokens=2048, max_events=10)
    engine = TranslationEngine(batcher=batcher)

    mock_provider = MagicMock()
    mock_provider.provider_type = "lmstudio"
    call_count = 0

    async def fake_chat(messages, model, temperature=0.2, max_tokens=None, **kwargs):
        nonlocal call_count
        call_count += 1
        # First call with the combined batch of 2 lines fails with LM Studio context size error
        if call_count == 1:
            raise RuntimeError('HTTP 400 Error from LM Studio: {"error":"Context size has been exceeded."}')
        # Split calls with 1 line each succeed
        content = ""
        user_msg = messages[-1].content
        if "[1]" in user_msg:
            content += "[1] السطر الأول المحسن الفاخر\n"
        if "[2]" in user_msg:
            content += "[2] السطر الثاني المحسن الفاخر\n"
        return ChatResponse(content=content, input_tokens=50, output_tokens=30)

    mock_provider.chat_completion = AsyncMock(side_effect=fake_chat)

    await engine.improve_document(
        document=doc,
        provider=mock_provider,
        model="google/gemma-4-e2b",
        source_lang="English",
        target_lang="Arabic"
    )

    # Verify that binary split happened (1 failed call + 2 split calls = 3 calls total)
    assert call_count == 3
    assert doc.events[0].translated_text == "السطر الأول المحسن الفاخر"
    assert doc.events[1].translated_text == "السطر الثاني المحسن الفاخر"

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_fresh_session_no_cache_reuse(qapp, tmp_path):
    """
    Verify that when use_cache is False:
    1. Pre-existing event translations are completely purged.
    2. Checkpoints on disk are cleaned up and NOT loaded.
    3. Translation Memory lookups are bypassed.
    4. 100% of the lines are freshly dispatched to the AI provider.
    """
    from app.translation.engine import TranslationEngine
    from app.translation.batcher import TokenBatcher
    from app.models.subtitle import SubtitleDocument, SubtitleEvent, SubtitleFormat
    from app.storage.checkpoint import CheckpointManager
    from app.core.database import DatabaseManager
    from app.storage.memory_repo import TranslationMemoryRepository
    from app.models.provider import ChatResponse

    db = DatabaseManager()
    db.clear_cache()
    tm_repo = TranslationMemoryRepository(db)

    # Pre-populate TM with a translation
    tm_repo.save_translation("Hello", "ترجمة قديمة جداً من الذاكرة", "English", "Arabic")

    # Create dummy subtitle and checkpoint file
    sub_file = tmp_path / "test_session.ass"
    sub_file.write_text("[Script Info]\nTitle: Test\n", encoding="utf-8")
    
    # Save a checkpoint on disk
    ckpt_path = CheckpointManager.get_checkpoint_path(str(sub_file))
    CheckpointManager.save(str(sub_file), 2, {1: "ترجمة من نقطة التوقف القديمة"})
    assert Path(ckpt_path).exists()

    doc = SubtitleDocument(
        format=SubtitleFormat.ASS,
        file_path=str(sub_file),
        events=[
            SubtitleEvent(id=1, text="Hello", original_text="Hello", translated_text="ترجمة متبقية في الذاكرة"),
            SubtitleEvent(id=2, text="How are you?", original_text="How are you?", translated_text=None)
        ]
    )

    batcher = TokenBatcher(max_tokens=2048, max_events=10)
    engine = TranslationEngine(batcher=batcher, tm_repo=tm_repo)

    called_events = []
    async def fake_chat(messages, model, temperature=0.2, max_tokens=None, **kwargs):
        user_msg = messages[-1].content
        if "[001]" in user_msg or "[1]" in user_msg:
            called_events.append(1)
        if "[002]" in user_msg or "[2]" in user_msg:
            called_events.append(2)
        return ChatResponse(content="[001] مرحباً بك\n[002] كيف حالك اليوم؟", input_tokens=40, output_tokens=30)

    mock_provider = MagicMock()
    mock_provider.chat_completion = AsyncMock(side_effect=fake_chat)

    # Run translation with use_cache=False (default fresh mode)
    await engine.translate_document(
        document=doc,
        provider=mock_provider,
        model="gpt-4o",
        source_lang="English",
        target_lang="Arabic",
        source_file_path=str(sub_file),
        use_cache=False
    )

    # Verify both lines were freshly translated by AI and NOT pulled from TM or Checkpoint
    assert 1 in called_events
    assert 2 in called_events
    assert doc.events[0].translated_text == "مرحباً بك"
    assert doc.events[1].translated_text == "كيف حالك اليوم؟"
    assert "ترجمة قديمة" not in doc.events[0].translated_text
    assert "ترجمة متبقية" not in doc.events[0].translated_text
    assert not Path(ckpt_path).exists()


def test_ultra_strict_impurity_purification():
    r"""
    Tests SubtitleHealer against dirty subtitle text samples containing:
    - Markdown bold/italic/code syntax (**, *, _, `)
    - HTML tags (<i>, <b>, <br/>, <font>)
    - Verbose LLM explanatory prefixes & line numbers
    - SDH bracketed sound effects ([music], (sighs), {gasp}, [موسيقى])
    - Stray Latin words and fillers (\Nyeah, \Noh, \NI, stray Latin letters)
    - Punctuation errors (English commas/question marks, repeated punctuation)
    - Orphan quotes
    - Lonely dialogue dashes
    - Duplicate ASS tags
    """
    from app.quality.healer import SubtitleHealer

    # Sample 1: Markdown, HTML breaks, SDH sound effects, and English fillers
    dirty_1 = r"**1. الترجمة:** <i>مرحباً</i> بك يا صديقي! <br/> [music] (sighs) \Nyeah {gasp} هل أنت بخير? \NI"
    healed_1 = SubtitleHealer.heal(dirty_1)
    assert "**" not in healed_1
    assert "1. الترجمة:" not in healed_1
    assert "<i>" not in healed_1 and "</i>" not in healed_1
    assert "<br" not in healed_1
    assert "[music]" not in healed_1
    assert "(sighs)" not in healed_1
    assert "{gasp}" not in healed_1
    assert r"\Nyeah" not in healed_1
    assert r"\NI" not in healed_1
    assert "؟" in healed_1
    assert r"{\i1}مرحباً{\i0}" in healed_1
    assert "بك يا صديقي!" in healed_1

    # Sample 2: LLM pipe echo and leading labels
    dirty_2 = "[005] Original: I didn't want this. | Improved: لم أكن أريد هذا على الإطلاق."
    healed_2 = SubtitleHealer.heal(dirty_2)
    assert healed_2 == "لم أكن أريد هذا على الإطلاق."

    # Sample 3: Orphan quotes and duplicate punctuation
    dirty_3 = '"هذا نص غير مغلق،،، وجميل جداً؟؟!!'
    healed_3 = SubtitleHealer.heal(dirty_3)
    assert healed_3.count('"') == 0
    assert "،،" not in healed_3
    assert "؟؟" not in healed_3
    assert "؟!" in healed_3

    # Sample 4: Single speaker dialogue dash removal and ASS tag de-duplication
    dirty_4 = r"{\an8}{\an8}- مرحباً بك في منزلي\N"
    healed_4 = SubtitleHealer.heal(dirty_4)
    # Lonely leading dash removed because only 1 speaker
    assert healed_4.startswith(r"{\an8}مرحباً")
    assert not healed_4.endswith(r"\N")
    assert r"{\an8}{\an8}" not in healed_4

    # Sample 5: Multi-speaker dialogue dashes preserved correctly
    dirty_5 = r"-- أين أنت؟\N-- أنا في الغرفة."
    healed_5 = SubtitleHealer.heal(dirty_5)
    assert healed_5 == r"- أين أنت؟\N- أنا في الغرفة."


def test_rebuild_text_no_dangling_n_or_duplicate_tags():
    """Verify that SubtitleEvent.rebuild_text never duplicates tags or appends trailing \\N."""
    from app.models.subtitle import SubtitleEvent

    event = SubtitleEvent(
        id=1,
        original_text=r"{\an8\pos(100,200)}Hello world!",
        translated_text=""
    )

    llm_output = r"{\an8\pos(100,200)}مرحباً بالعالم!\N"
    rebuilt = event.rebuild_text(llm_output)
```
